Title: Senior Technical Project Manager
Description:
TELUS Health is empowering every person to live their healthiest life. Guided by our vision, we are leveraging the power of our leading edge technology and focusing on the uniqueness of each individual to create the future of health. As a global-leading health and well-being provider – encompassing physical, mental and financial health – TELUS Health is improving health outcomes for consumers, patients, healthcare professionals, employers and employees.
  
  
Join our team and what we'll accomplish together
  
  
At TELUS Health, we're reimagining how pension and benefits solutions are delivered. Our teams are shifting toward a product-led, multi-client delivery model—and we need someone who can bring clarity, momentum, and accountability to complex delivery at scale.
  
  
As a Senior Technical Project Manager, you'll be the connective tissue between product vision, engineering execution, and client success. You'll lead high-impact programs across platform enhancements, multi-client deployments, and technical initiatives—all while championing new ways of working that make delivery faster, smarter, and more predictable.
  
  
This role offers the unique opportunity to shape how TELUS Health delivers at scale—influencing product roadmaps, release strategies, and team practices that directly impact millions of Canadians and their retirement security.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
**Lead end-to-end product program delivery**

* Own complex product programs from initiation through post-launch, managing platform enhancements and multi-client deployments with clear outcomes
* Orchestrate release planning, rollout strategies, and delivery milestones that align product roadmaps with client commitments
* Balance multiple concurrent initiatives, dependencies, and competing priorities with discipline and transparency

**Orchestrate cross-functional execution**

* Partner across Product, Engineering, DevOps, QA, Data, Implementation, and delivery teams—acting as the central point of accountability
* Lead governance forums, alignment sessions, and delivery checkpoints that keep teams moving together
* Influence and align stakeholders without direct authority—a critical skill in our collaborative environment

**Drive technical readiness and continuous improvement**

* Manage technical risks: integrations, APIs, data migrations, and environment readiness
* Promote Agile, DevOps, and continuous delivery practices that improve speed, quality, and predictability
* Identify opportunities to standardize processes, reduce bottlenecks, and elevate delivery excellence across teams

**Enable smarter delivery through data and AI**

* Provide data-driven reporting to leadership—progress, risks, trade-offs, and decisions required
* Champion the practical adoption of AI-enabled tools for planning, risk identification, and delivery insights
* Turn delivery data into actionable intelligence that improves team effectiveness

What you bring
  
  
**Essential experience:**

* 5+ years managing technical projects, product programs, or platform delivery initiatives
* Proven track record delivering SaaS, product, or technology-enabled solutions
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery, DevOps practices, release planning, and technical dependencies
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders without direct authority
* Strong communication, governance, and risk management skills
* Comfort operating in complex, fast-paced environments with multiple priorities and competing stakeholder interests

**Nice to have:**

* Experience in pension, benefits, health, financial services, or regulated delivery environments
* Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar delivery management tools
* Bilingual English/French capability

Why TELUS Health? You'll work alongside product leaders, engineers, and client-success teams who are genuinely excited about transforming how benefits and pension solutions are delivered. We invest in your growth, encourage innovation, and create space for you to build delivery practices that will scale across the organization.
  
  
**Salary Range:**
$85,000 - $110,000
  
  
Actual total compensation will be determined based on factors such as knowledge, skills, performance and experience. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, even if the posted salary range doesn't match your expectations. We're open to discussing competitive compensation packages tailored to your experience level and expertise.
  
  
TELUS Health offers rewarding benefits, which may vary per job function, such as:
  
  
  

* Comprehensive total rewards package highlighting competitive salary and bonus structures, minimum 3 weeks of vacation, and flexible benefits plan to meet the needs of you and your family
* Flexibility to work in-office, virtually or a combination of both
* Generous company matched pension
* Opportunity to give back to communities in which we work, live and serve
* Career growth and learning & development opportunities to develop your skills

**Job Type:**
This is for a current vacancy.
  
  
What makes this different:
  
  
  

* Impact: Your work directly improves how millions of Canadians manage their retirement and benefits
* Growth: You'll shape delivery practices and processes that become the standard across TELUS Health
* Collaboration: You'll work with talented, mission-driven teams across product, technology, and client delivery
* Data-driven: We believe in transparency, reporting, and making decisions backed by evidence

**A Bit About Us**
We’re a people-focused, customer-first, purpose-driven team who works together every day to innovate and do good. We improve lives through our technology solutions and foster a culture of innovation that empowers team members to solve complex problems and create remarkable human outcomes in a digital world.
  
  
TELUS is proud to foster an inclusive culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to fair employment practices and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. We offer accommodation for applicants with disabilities, as required, during the recruitment process.
  
  
Disclaimer: In accordance with the TELUS Health Solutions Data Center Security Policy, as a condition of employment, all team members whose job functions require they work at a Data Center and/or have access to detailed knowledge of technology related to client service delivery, are subject to a Personnel Security Screening conducted through the Government of Canada.
  
  
Note for Quebec candidates: if knowledge of English is required for this position, it is because the team member will be asked, on a regular basis, to interact in English with external or internal parties or to use English applications or software as part of their tasks.
  
  
By applying to this role, you understand and agree that your information will be shared with the TELUS Group of Companies’ Talent Acquisition team(s) and/or any leader(s) who will be part of the selection process.

Title: Gestionnaire de Mandats | Engagement Manager, Services professionnels / Professional Services
Description:
**Description**
L'équipe des Services Professionnels d'Amazon Web Services (ProServe) recherche un Gestionnaire d'Engagement (EM) hautement qualifié et polyvalent pour rejoindre notre équipe et diriger la livraison de projets de solutions cloud complexes. Dans ce rôle, vous combinerez expertise technique et solides compétences en leadership de projet pour mener à bien des implémentations réussies de solutions basées sur AWS pour nos clients. Vous ferez le lien entre les exigences commerciales et les solutions techniques, facilitant les discussions techniques et assurant l'alignement avec les résultats attendus par les clients. En appliquant les cadres AWS tels que Well-Architected et Cloud Adoption Framework tout en démontrant une crédibilité technique auprès de diverses parties prenantes, vous traduirez les besoins des clients en exigences techniques claires, décomposerez des problèmes complexes et prendrez des décisions éclairées en tenant compte des compromis entre performance, évolutivité, sécurité et impact commercial.
  
  
Possédant une solide expérience en technologie et en gestion de programmes/projets, vous validerez les solutions techniques par rapport aux objectifs commerciaux, reconnaîtrez quand une évaluation technique supplémentaire est nécessaire et gérerez les risques techniques. On attendra de vous que vous obteniez et mainteniez les certifications AWS pertinentes, développiez une expertise spécifique à votre domaine et communiquiez efficacement les concepts techniques à des publics techniques et commerciaux. Au fur et à mesure de votre progression, vous dirigerez des projets techniques de plus en plus complexes, façonnerez des stratégies techniques inter-organisationnelles et établirez les meilleures pratiques dans votre domaine. Dans ce rôle, vous appliquerez vos capacités de gestion et de leadership pour exécuter avec succès les plans de projet, identifier et gérer proactivement les risques, résoudre les problèmes, escalader lorsque nécessaire et mener les projets à leur terme, tout en dépassant les attentes des clients.
  
  
L'organisation des Services Professionnels AWS est une équipe mondiale d'experts qui aident les clients à réaliser les résultats commerciaux souhaités lors de l'utilisation du Cloud AWS. Nous travaillons en collaboration avec les équipes des clients et le Réseau de Partenaires AWS (APN) pour exécuter des initiatives d'informatique en cloud d'entreprise. Notre équipe fournit une assistance à travers une collection d'offres qui aident les clients à atteindre des résultats spécifiques liés à l'adoption du cloud d'entreprise. Nous fournissons également des conseils ciblés à travers nos pratiques de spécialité mondiales, qui couvrent une variété de solutions, technologies et industries.
  
  
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a highly skilled and versatile Engagement Manager (EM) to join our team and lead the delivery of complex cloud solution projects. In this role you will combine technical expertise with strong project leadership skills to drive successful implementations of AWS-based solutions for our clients. You will bridge business requirements with technical solutions, facilitating technical discussions and ensuring alignment with customer outcomes. Applying AWS frameworks like Well-Architected and Cloud Adoption Framework while demonstrating technical credibility across diverse stakeholders, you will distill customer needs into clear technical requirements, decompose complex problems, and make informed trade-off decisions considering performance, scalability, security, and business impact.
  
  
Possessing strong technology and program/project management experience, you will validate technical solutions against business goals, recognize when additional technical evaluation is needed, and manage technical risks. You will be expected to achieve and maintain relevant AWS certifications, develop domain-specific expertise, and effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and business audiences. As you progress, you’ll lead increasingly complex technical projects, shape cross-organizational technical strategies, and establish best practices in your domain. In this role you will apply your management and leadership capabilities to successfully execute project plans, proactively identify and manage risks, resolve issues, escalate when appropriate, and drive projects to successful completion, while exceeding customer expectation
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
En tant que gestionnaire de programme/projet technologique expérimenté, vous serez responsable de :
  
  

* Diriger et gérer des projets complexes de migration et d'implémentation cloud
* Exploiter une connaissance approfondie des services AWS, des architectures et des meilleures pratiques pour guider les décisions techniques et la planification stratégique
* Faire le lien entre les exigences commerciales et les solutions techniques, faciliter les discussions d'ingénierie et assurer l'alignement avec les résultats commerciaux des clients
* Traduire les besoins des clients en exigences techniques claires et les associer aux résultats commerciaux
* Décomposer des problèmes techniques complexes en solutions réalisables et livrables
* Contribuer à la documentation technique et définir des normes de documentation

As an experienced technology program/project manager, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Leading and managing complex cloud migration and implementation projects
* Leveraging comprehensive knowledge of AWS services, architectures, and best practices to guide technical decisions and strategic planning
* Bridging business requirements with technical solutions, facilitating engineering discussions and ensuring alignment with customer business outcomes
* Distilling customer needs into clear technical requirements and map them to business outcomes
* Decomposing complex technical problems into actionable, deliverable solutions
* Contributing to technical documentation and define documentation standards

**About The Team**
À propos d'AWS (English description to follow)
  
  
Des expériences diverses
  
  
AWS accorde une grande importance à la diversité des expériences. Même si vous ne répondez pas à toutes les qualifications et compétences énumérées dans la description du poste, nous encourageons les candidats à postuler. Si votre carrière débute, si vous n'avez pas suivi un parcours traditionnel ou si vous avez des expériences alternatives, cela ne doit pas vous empêcher de postuler.

Description:
**Req Id:**
433622
  
  
Connection is everything. It drives us to innovate, explore, and stay close to what matters to us most. At Bell, we’re building a more connected future through world-class networks, AI-powered solutions, and digital experiences that elevate how people live, work, and play every day.
  
  
We believe in empowering people. That’s why we equip our teams with cutting-edge technology, AI tools, and a collaborative environment that supports creativity and growth. Want to be part of a diverse team where your work makes a real impact? If you’re inspired by innovation that advances how people connect and transforms what’s possible, you belong on #TeamBell.
  
  
On the Bell Business Markets team, you’ll be a vital part of making innovation happen for enterprise-scale customers. You’ll deliver advanced solutions in areas such as IoT, Mobility/5G, Cloud, Cyber Security, Voice, Collaboration & Contact Centre and Internet & Private Networks.
  
  
At Bell, your skills and expertise will help set us apart as we continue to be the leading provider of digital connections and next generation services to businesses and governments.
  
  
**Summary**
Bell AI Fabric is seeking a Senior Program Manager with proven data centre experience to act as the single accountable person for a data centre project or cluster of projects, from site identification through handover to Operations. The Senior Program Manager is the mesh between departments: connecting Business, Legal, Finance, Land and Regulatory, Power / IPP, Design, Procurement and Strategic Supply, Construction, Commissioning, Networking and Security, and Operations around one integrated plan.
  
  
The role owns the integrated plan, gate readiness, the cross-department interface log, RFS feasibility and recovery plans, and the weekly core team meeting. It coordinates and does not direct: functional leads keep their technical decisions, and contract and commercial approvals stay with Legal, Finance and the existing delegation of authority.
  
  
In the initial phase, one Senior Program Manager per project covers both the Integrated PM and Commercial PM responsibilities, and is the single point of contact for the client across all phases. Program Controls assures each gate independently.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Integrated Planning & Gate Readiness
  
  

* Own the integrated plan and Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) for the project, bringing together land, permit, power, design, procurement, construction, commissioning and operational readiness milestones.
* Manage the project through its full lifecycle, from site identification to handover to Operations: run kickoffs, hold readiness reviews about two weeks before each key decision point, and bring each one to a decision.
* Ensure each exit is met with evidence, and work with Program Controls, which assures every gate independently.
* Join early, at site identification, to frame the project plan and collect inputs from Land, Power, Design and Construction.

Cross-Functional Integration & Interface Management
  
  

* Maintain the interface log across departments, with clear owners, dates and closure evidence.
* Chair the weekly core team meeting and ensure decisions, actions and dependencies are tracked to closure.
* Ensure design and scope changes are communicated and assessed with all affected departments, Operations included, before they are decided.
* Surface gaps in ownership early, including OFCI versus CFCI scope, and escalate where functional teams are not aligned.

RFS Feasibility & Recovery

Description:

433622
  
  
Tout part d’une connexion. Elle nous pousse à innover, à explorer et à rester proches de ce qui compte le plus pour nous. Chez Bell, nous bâtissons un avenir plus connecté grâce à des réseaux de calibre mondial, à des solutions propulsées par l’IA et à des expériences numériques qui améliorent la façon dont les gens vivent, travaillent et se divertissent chaque jour.
  
  
Nous croyons à l’autonomisation de chacun. C’est pourquoi nous dotons nos équipes d’une technologie de pointe, d’outils d’IA et d’un environnement collaboratif qui soutient la créativité et la croissance. Voulez-vous faire partie d’une équipe diversifiée où votre travail a un réel impact? Si vous êtes inspiré par l’innovation qui fait progresser la façon dont les gens se connectent et transforme ce qui est possible, vous avez votre place au sein de l’#ÉquipeBell.
  
  
Au sein de l’équipe Bell Marchés Affaires, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel en matière d’innovation pour notre clientèle d’entreprises. Vous livrerez des solutions évoluées dans des domaines comme l’Internet des objets, la mobilité et la 5G, l’infonuagique, la cybersécurité, les services vocaux, la collaboration et les centres de contact, ainsi que l’Internet et les réseaux privés.
  
  
Vos compétences et votre expertise aideront Bell à se démarquer alors que nous restons le premier fournisseur de connexions numériques et de services de prochaine génération pour les entreprises et les gouvernements.
  
  
**Résumé**
**Bell AI Fabric**
est à la recherche d’un(e)
**gestionnaire principal(e) de programme**
possédant une expérience éprouvée dans le domaine des
**centres de données**
afin d’agir comme
**responsable unique imputable**
d’un projet de centre de données ou d’un portefeuille de projets, depuis l’identification du site jusqu’au transfert aux équipes des
**Opérations**
.
  
  
Le ou la gestionnaire principal(e) de programme agit comme le lien central entre les différents services, en réunissant les équipes des
**Affaires**
,
**Juridique**
,
**Finances**
,
**Terrains et Réglementation**
,
**Énergie/IPP (Independent Power Producer)**
,
**Conception**
,
**Approvisionnement et Chaîne d’approvisionnement stratégique**
,
**Construction**
,
**Mise en service (Commissioning)**
,
**Réseautique et Sécurité**
, ainsi que les
**Opérations**
, autour d’un plan intégré unique.
  
  
Ce rôle est responsable du
**plan intégré**
, de la préparation des jalons décisionnels (gates), du journal des interfaces interfonctionnelles, de la faisabilité de la
**mise en service (RFS - Ready for Service)**
et des plans de redressement, ainsi que de l’animation de la réunion hebdomadaire de l’équipe principale. Il assure la coordination sans exercer d’autorité directe : les responsables fonctionnels conservent leurs décisions techniques, tandis que les approbations contractuelles et commerciales demeurent sous la responsabilité des équipes
**Juridique**
,
**Finances**
et conformément à la délégation d’autorité en vigueur.
  
  
Dans la phase initiale, un(e) seul(e) gestionnaire principal(e) de programme est affecté(e) à chaque projet et assume à la fois les responsabilités de
**gestionnaire de projet intégré (Integrated PM)**
et de
**gestionnaire commercial (Commercial PM)**
. Cette personne agit également comme
**point de contact unique du client**
tout au long des différentes phases du projet.
  
  
L’équipe
**Program Controls**
assure quant à elle une validation indépendante de chaque jalon décisionnel (gate).
  
  
**Principales responsabilités**
Planification intégrée et préparation des jalons
  
  

* Être responsable du plan intégré et de l’échéancier directeur (IMS), en coordonnant les jalons liés au terrain, aux permis, à l’alimentation électrique, à la conception, à l’approvisionnement, à la construction, à la mise en service et à la préparation opérationnelle.
* Gérer le projet de bout en bout, de l’identification du site jusqu’au transfert aux Opérations, en animant les démarrages, les revues de préparation et les points de décision.
* S’assurer que les critères de sortie de chaque jalon sont respectés et validés avec Program Controls.
* Participer dès la sélection du site afin d’établir le plan du projet avec les équipes Foncier, Énergie, Conception et Construction.

Intégration interfonctionnelle et gestion des interfaces
  
  

* Maintenir le registre des interfaces entre les services, avec responsables, échéances et preuves de clôture.
* Présider la réunion hebdomadaire de l’équipe principale et assurer le suivi des décisions, actions et dépendances.
* Coordonner l’évaluation des changements de portée ou de conception avec toutes les parties concernées, y compris les Opérations.
* Identifier rapidement les écarts de responsabilités, notamment entre les équipements OFCI et CFCI, et escalader les enjeux d’alignement.

Faisabilité du RFS et plans de redressement
  
  

* Valider la faisabilité des dates de mise en service (RFS) avec Program Controls et les experts concernés avant tout engagement.
* Élaborer et piloter les plans de redressement lorsque des dépendances externes compromettent les échéanciers.
* Évaluer les impacts financiers des retards de RFS avec les équipes Juridiques et Finances et en rendre compte à la direction.
* Coordonner les communications liées aux retards de RFS auprès des parties prenantes.

Gestion de la relation client et alignement commercial
  
  

* Agir comme point de contact principal du client durant toutes les phases du projet.
* Confirmer la réalisabilité des dates de RFS avant leur intégration aux ententes clients et collaborer sur les SLA et critères d’acceptation.
* Diriger l’approbation de la conception et l’acceptation finale par le client. Soutenir la gestion des avis contractuels, réclamations et demandes de changement avec les équipes Juridiques et Finances.

Approvisionnement, construction et mise en service
  
  

* Aligner les attributions de contrats et les livraisons d’équipements avec les besoins du projet.
* Gérer les interfaces de construction, les changements et les plans de redressement.
* Coordonner la mise en service et la mise sous tension, tout en confirmant la préparation des équipes Réseaux, Sécurité et Opérations.
* Recueillir la documentation finale et les plans « tels que construits » (as-built).

Gouvernance et reddition de comptes
  
  

* Produire des rapports exécutifs sur l’avancement, les risques, les interfaces, les changements et les décisions requises.
* Présenter l’état du projet aux forums de gouvernance et escalader les enjeux selon les mécanismes établis.
* Assurer l’exactitude des données dans les outils de suivi de Program Controls et du portefeuille.
* Appliquer les normes, gabarits et processus de Program Controls de façon uniforme.

Préparation opérationnelle et clôture
  
  

* Valider la préparation opérationnelle, incluant la dotation et la préparation à la facturation.
* Gérer le transfert vers la Gestion des actifs et compléter la documentation de transition.
* Finaliser les coûts du projet et obtenir l’acceptation officielle des actifs.
* Documenter les leçons apprises et contribuer à l’amélioration continue des standards et pratiques futurs.

**Qualifications Essentielles**

* Expérience directe et démontrée dans le domaine des centres de données, incluant la réalisation de projets de centres de données critiques ou hyperscale, depuis l’identification du site jusqu’à la mise en service et le transfert aux équipes d’exploitation.
* Expérience progressive dans la direction de projets ou programmes d’investissement complexes et multidisciplinaires à travers les différentes phases du cycle de vie d’un projet.
* Capacité démontrée à intégrer les informations liées à l’échéancier, aux coûts, aux risques, aux changements et aux interfaces dans une vision consolidée du projet.
* Expérience dans la coordination d’équipes internes, de consultants, d’entrepreneurs et de fournisseurs sans autorité hiérarchique directe.
* Excellente compréhension des méthodologies de gestion par jalons (Stage-Gate/Phase-Gate), des revues de préparation et des processus de transfert aux opérations.
* Expérience dans la gestion des plans de redressement d’échéancier, de l’escalade des enjeux et des attentes des parties prenantes dans des projets retardés ou soumis à des contraintes.
* Bonne connaissance des structures contractuelles, des stratégies d’approvisionnement et de la coordination des équipements fournis par le propriétaire (OFCI – Owner Furnished Contractor Installed).
* Excellentes compétences en communication avec la haute direction, en animation de réunions et en gestion des parties prenantes.
* Maîtrise des outils Microsoft 365 et connaissance des systèmes de contrôle de projets, de suivi de performance et de production de rapports.

**Qualifications Souhaitées**

* Expérience avec des projets hyperscale, infonuagiques (cloud) ou d’intelligence artificielle (IA) de grande envergure, ainsi qu’avec des infrastructures de télécommunications ou d’autres environnements critiques.
* Connaissance des systèmes critiques liés à l’alimentation électrique, aux équipements mécaniques, au refroidissement, à l’automatisation et au contrôle, aux réseaux et à la sécurité, y compris les raccordements aux réseaux électriques et aux services publics.
* Expérience dans la gestion d’engagements contractuels envers les clients, notamment les dates de mise en service (RFS), les ententes de niveau de service (SLA) ainsi que les crédits ou pénalités associés à la performance.
* Expérience avec des plateformes telles que Primavera P6, Power BI, EcoSys, Procore, SAP, SharePoint ou d’autres outils équivalents de gestion de projets et de contrôle des coûts.
* Certification professionnelle reconnue telle que PMP (Project Management Professional), PgMP (Program Management Professional), PSP (Planning & Scheduling Professional) ou toute certification équivalente.

**Exigences supplémentaires**

* Capacité à exercer un leadership d’influence et à mobiliser des équipes multidisciplinaires sans autorité hiérarchique directe.
* Excellentes aptitudes en coordination interfonctionnelle, en collaboration et en gestion des parties prenantes dans des environnements complexes.
* Forte capacité à adopter une vision globale du projet, à comprendre les interdépendances et à assurer une gestion efficace des risques et des interfaces.
* Sens élevé des responsabilités, rigueur dans l’exécution, suivi constant des dossiers et grande attention aux détails.
* Solide jugement et capacité à prendre des décisions éclairées dans des contextes où les contraintes d’échéancier, de budget ou les enjeux commerciaux sont importantes.
* Habileté à remettre en question de façon constructive, à résoudre les enjeux avec diplomatie et à effectuer les escalades nécessaires de manière claire et efficace.
* Excellentes compétences en communication avec la direction et les parties prenantes, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit.
* Capacité à présenter des informations complexes de façon concise et percutante en s’appuyant sur des données, des indicateurs de performance et des analyses factuelles.
* Forte aptitude à animer des réunions, faciliter la prise de décision et favoriser l’alignement entre les différentes équipes impliquées dans le projet.

Title: Solution Delivery Manager
Description:

We drive large-scale, complex, and high-visibility technology projects and programs that shape the future of technology in Canada and expand connectivity from coast to coast. If you are interested in being a part of this, consider applying for the following opportunity:

  

**Who we're looking for:**

We are seeking a Solution Delivery Manager reporting to the Senior Manager, Residential Solution Delivery. In this role as Solution Delivery Manager, you will provide end-to-end leadership for the planning, solutioning, sequencing, and delivery of initiatives within an assigned workstream, squad, or program. You will establish trusted relationships with Product, Business, Architecture, Delivery, Security, Quality Assurance, and domain teams, translating product roadmaps and project requirements into aligned, executable delivery plans.

  

You will balance business outcomes, technical feasibility, risk, capacity, and release constraints. The role is accountable for driving clarity across scope, solution, estimates, dependencies, approvals, quality, and timelines while supporting teams through execution and issue resolution.

  

**What you'll do:**

  

Stakeholder Partnership and Roadmap Alignment

* Build and sustain trusted relationships with Product and Business stakeholders, creating transparency on priorities, trade-offs, risks, and delivery outcomes.
* Develop a detailed understanding of the product roadmap for the assigned workstream, squad, or program and translate it into actionable delivery priorities.
* Partner closely with the Product Owner to shape the backlog, negotiate priorities, clarify acceptance outcomes, and maintain alignment to business value.
* Represent Solution Delivery in cross-functional discussions and ensure decisions, dependencies, and commitments are documented and communicated.
  

Requirements, Scope, and Solution Leadership

* Read and understand project requirements; challenge assumptions, identify gaps and dependencies, provide feedback, and sign off on the scope committed for delivery.
* Provide direction and guidance to the Business Analyst throughout project execution, including requirements clarification, dependency management, decision tracking, and issue resolution.
* Work closely with the Solution Architect to finalize the end-to-end solution, ensuring alignment across business requirements, architecture, integration, data, operations, security, and support considerations.
* Coordinate solution reviews with domain teams and Business stakeholders and obtain the required sign-offs before delivery proceeds.
* Work closely with the Cyber Security prime and the Business Systems Analyst to close security requirements, risks, assessments, and required approvals.
  

Integrated Planning and Delivery Management

* Work with domain leads and the Project Manager to sequence deliveries and formulate the Plan of Intent and Plan of Release in alignment with business goals, dependencies, team capacity, and release windows.
* Negotiate delivery timelines with domain teams, release dates, and other delivery commitments, while clearly identifying prerequisites and trade-offs.
* Obtain and consolidate estimates from all contributing teams; validate assumptions, dependencies, and resource needs to support an achievable integrated plan.
* Proactively identify delivery risks, scope gaps, resource constraints, and cross-team dependencies, and drive timely mitigation or escalation.
* Maintain clear delivery governance, decision records, status reporting, and accountability across the end-to-end lifecycle.
  

Facilitation, Decisions, and Governance

* Schedule and lead Joint Application Design (JAD) sessions with domain teams and relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure every JAD session and key delivery meeting has a clear agenda, required pre-work, appropriate decision-makers, and a specific outcome to be achieved.
* Drive timely decisions and sign-offs by surfacing options, impacts, risks, and recommendations in a concise and fact-based manner.
* Promote collaborative ways of working across Business and Technology teams, resolving conflict constructively and keeping teams focused on shared outcomes.
  

Quality Assurance and Delivery Support

* Ensure the QA Test Plan and Test Cases fully cover the approved project scope and end-to-end solution and align with expected business and technical results.
* Provide technical or process support during QA to help resolve defects, clarify intended behaviour, remove major blockers, and coordinate the appropriate domain expertise.
* Validate readiness for release by confirming scope completion, solution and security sign-offs, test evidence, operational readiness, dependencies, and outstanding risks.
* Support post-release reviews and continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned and strengthening delivery practices.
  

**What you bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of progressive experience in technology delivery, solution delivery, program delivery, systems implementation, or a related discipline, including demonstrated leadership across complex initiatives.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional delivery involving Product, Business, Architecture, Engineering, Security, Quality Assurance, Operations, vendors, and multiple technology domains.
* Strong understanding of the software delivery lifecycle, requirements practices, solution design, estimation, release planning, testing, defect management, and operational readiness.
* Demonstrated ability to understand technical and business requirements, evaluate end-to-end impacts, and make sound scope and delivery decisions.
* Experience facilitating JAD or solution-design sessions and driving groups toward clear, documented decisions and accountabilities.
* Strong negotiation and influencing skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, timelines, capacity constraints, and stakeholder expectations.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills; able to communicate complex topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail and a bias for action.
* Working knowledge of cybersecurity, privacy, risk, and governance requirements within enterprise technology delivery.
* Experience working in Agile, hybrid, and project-based delivery models; familiarity with backlog management and iterative planning practices.
* A collaborative leadership style that builds trust, protects sustainable team capacity, and creates accountability without compromising quality.
  

**What Success Looks Like**

* Stakeholders have a shared understanding of scope, solution, priorities, dependencies, timelines, and decisions.
* Delivery plans are integrated, realistic, and aligned to roadmap outcomes, team capacity, security obligations, and release constraints.
* JAD and governance forums produce clear decisions, owners, and next steps.
* Quality plans provide full coverage of the committed scope and defects are resolved through coordinated, timely support.

Title: Information Technology Project Manager

Description:

* Lead IT projects end-to-end: initiation, requirements, planning, execution, testing, go-live, handover and closure.
* Build and maintain project plans, milestones, budgets, resource plans, RAID logs and dependency maps.

* Work with business departments to understand processes and pain points, and translate requirements into functional and technical solutions.

* Keep application documentation, support procedures, access controls and vendor contacts current.
* Coordinate integrations across Microsoft 365, Azure, GCP and ERP, HR, property, finance and other systems.

**3. Microsoft 365 & Licensing**

* Manage Microsoft 365 subscriptions, license allocation, renewals, utilization and cost optimization.
* Work with Microsoft partners on licensing, technical issues and service changes.
* Oversee identity, access, administrative roles, security controls and compliance for Microsoft 365, together with the infrastructure and security teams.

**4. Cloud & Infrastructure**

* Coordinate the group's Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform environments with providers, vendors and internal technical teams.
* Support cloud migration, modernization, integration and disaster recovery initiatives.
* Track cloud usage and cost, and act on optimization opportunities.
* Ensure cloud environments follow approved architecture, security, access, backup and governance standards.

**5. Network, Server & Cybersecurity Coordination**

* Coordinate support of networks, servers, firewalls, VPN, backup and endpoint services with the IT technical team.
* Coordinate cybersecurity tooling, including Trend Micro XDR and other security technologies.
* Drive vulnerability remediation, security updates, monitoring, access control, backup and DR improvements.
* Ensure infrastructure and security issues affecting business applications are escalated, tracked and resolved.

**6. Business Relationship & Solution Management**

* Act as the primary IT contact for business stakeholders across the group.
* Run workshops and requirement-gathering sessions with users and process owners.
* Prepare business cases, solution comparisons and vendor evaluations for management approval.
* Coordinate demonstrations, proofs of concept and technical assessments.

* Establish and maintain IT project governance standards, templates, reporting and controls.
* Develop, review and implement IT policies, procedures and operating guidelines.
* Ensure projects and IT services comply with policies, security requirements and internal controls.
* Maintain documentation for management, audit and compliance; support IT audits and close findings.
* Ensure approval, change, access and vendor management processes are followed.

**8. Vendor & Contract Management**

* Manage relationships with IT vendors, system integrators, software providers, cloud providers and managed service providers.
* Monitor vendor performance against SLAs, deliverables and milestones; lead service reviews and improvement plans.
* Support procurement: RFP/RFQ preparation, technical and commercial evaluation, negotiation, renewals and contract review.
* Identify opportunities to reduce vendor dependency and optimize IT spend.

**9. IT Service Management & Operational Support**

* Coordinate incidents, service requests, problems and escalations that need project or application management involvement.
* Ensure projects transition into operations with documentation, SLAs, support models and knowledge transfer.
* Analyze recurring incidents and drive permanent fixes, automation and process improvement.
* Coordinate business continuity, disaster recovery, backup and service restoration for critical IT services.

**10. Team & Stakeholder Coordination**

* Coordinate application, infrastructure, network, system administration and service desk (L1/L2) resources as required.
* Prioritize work by business criticality, project commitments, risk and available capacity.
* Provide direction and escalation support to technical teams and external providers.
* Promote collaboration between IT, business departments, vendors and senior management.

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration or a related field.
* Proven end-to-end delivery of enterprise IT projects.
* Mandatory: hands-on or strong functional/project experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365.
* Experience managing enterprise business applications, including support, enhancements, integrations and rollouts.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 administration/licensing and Azure and/or GCP.
* Sound understanding of network, server, firewall, backup, endpoint and cybersecurity environments.
* Experience managing IT vendors, implementation partners, SLAs, contracts and technology evaluations.
* Experience in IT governance, policies, change management, risk management and project reporting.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, problem-solving and analytical skills.

**Preferred Certifications**

* PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent project management certification.
* ITIL certification.

Microsoft Dynamics 365, Ramco HCM, Focus, Sage and other enterprise applications

**Cloud Platforms**

Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

**Productivity & Collaboration**

Microsoft 365

**Infrastructure**

Network, servers, firewalls, backup, connectivity, endpoint services

Trend Micro XDR and other security technologies

Title: Vice President - Technology Commercials and Delivery
Description:
Established in 2004, Dubai Holding is a global investment company with investments in more than 34 countries and a combined workforce of nearly 45,000 individuals. In line with the vision of Dubai’s leadership and economic diversification strategy, Dubai Holding companies have nurtured sectors, irrevocably transforming Dubai’s socio-economic landscape and positioning Dubai as a diversified, globally integrated economy.

Dubai Holding is committed to the diversification of Dubai’s non-oil economy. Our portfolio, valued at over AED 284+ billion, spans 10 sectors, including real estate, hospitality, leisure & entertainment, ICT, design, education, media, retail, manufacturing & logistics, and science.

**For the Good of Tomorrow**

Dubai Holding is looking to hire a
**Vice President – Technology Commercials & Delivery**
at Dubai Holding. The role holder is responsible for the commercial performance and delivery reliability of Dubai Holding Group IT. The role owns the Group IT sourcing strategy, vendor and contract commercials, and the Group IT delivery model, ensuring that every service, programme and supplier relationship delivers measurable value for its cost.

The role puts Group IT's “How We Operate” principles into practice: explicit ownership, deliberate sourcing choices, realistic delivery commitments through Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM), and supplier management that connects service performance with commercial value. It manages the end-to-end commercial lifecycle – from sourcing strategy and negotiation through contract performance, renewal and exit – and the delivery governance that turns approved demand into on-time, on-budget outcomes.

The role acts as the Group CTO's lead for commercials and delivery, partnering with Group Procurement, Group Finance, Legal, Strategy & Value Creation and the Verticals to reduce cost-to-serve, remove duplication across contracts, and ensure Group IT commits only to what it can deliver.

**Key Accountabilities:**

**Commercial Strategy & Sourcing**

* Define and own the Group IT commercial and sourcing strategy, aligned to Group CTO priorities and Dubai Holding procurement policy
* Make deliberate retain, partner, automate or buy decisions for each service area, based on operational criticality, control requirements, cost, flexibility and knowledge retention
* Consolidate demand across Central IT and the Verticals to use Group-wide buying power and remove duplicate contracts
* Lead category strategies for software, cloud, infrastructure, telecoms, professional services and managed services

**Vendor Negotiation & Contract Management**

* Lead commercial negotiations for strategic technology agreements, including enterprise licensing, cloud commitments, multi-year and outcome-based contracts
* Own the contract portfolio lifecycle: renewals calendar, true-ups, price reviews, benchmarking and exit planning
* Ensure contracts include clear SLAs, KPIs, service credits, termination rights, IP and data protection terms, in partnership with Legal and Procurement
* Review contract terms, consumption and duplication to identify renegotiation, consolidation and termination opportunities

**Supplier Performance & Value Realisation**

* Establish a tiered supplier management framework with regular business reviews for strategic suppliers
* Connect supplier service performance with commercial value, tracking SLA compliance, service credits, penalties and delivered outcomes
* Track savings and cost avoidance, validated with IT Finance
* Manage supplier risk, including concentration, financial stability and third-party cyber risk, with Information Security and IT GRC

**Delivery Model & Portfolio Execution**

* Own the Group IT delivery model, ensuring programmes and projects are delivered on time, on budget and to agreed scope
* Run delivery planning through SPM, using effort estimates and capacity checks so that commitments are realistic
* Set common delivery discipline for ownership, progress, risk and commitments, while allowing teams to use suitable execution methods (agile, waterfall or hybrid)
* Drive transparent reprioritisation when capacity or demand changes materially, escalating trade-offs to the Group CTO

**Partner & System Integrator Delivery Oversight**

* Oversee delivery by system integrators and managed service partners, with clear internal accountability and effective interfaces
* Define statements of work, acceptance criteria, milestone payments and change control that protect Dubai Holding's commercial position
* Intervene early on underperforming engagements and apply commercial levers where needed
* Ensure knowledge transfer and avoid unhealthy dependency on any single partner

**Commercial & Financial Governance**

* Ensure all sourcing and contracting complies with Dubai Holding procurement policy, Delegation of Authority (DOA) and audit requirements
* Partner with IT Finance on budgets, commitments, accruals and the commercial basis for chargeback to the Verticals
* Maintain a complete, auditable record of contracts, approvals and commercial decisions, and support Internal Audit and external audit reviews
* Build business cases with clear total cost of ownership (TCO), ROI and payback for major sourcing decisions

**Deliver Agentic AI Capabilities**

* Manage delivery of strategic group-level AI agentic projects and initiatives
* Support and deliver vertical-level implementations of strategic AI platforms
* Deliver business transformation projects to meet group-level value creation and efficiency objectives

**AI-Enabled Commercial & Delivery Operations**

* Evaluate and negotiate agentic AI and automation platforms, including consumption- and credit-based pricing models
* Apply AI and analytics to contract intelligence, spend analytics, renewal risk and delivery forecasting
* Apply “Right Work, Right Owner” in sourcing decisions, moving repetitive work to automation where it creates value
* Ensure AI vendor contracts address data ownership, model use, IP, responsible use and exit terms

**Leadership, Stakeholder Management & Reporting**

* Build and lead a high-performing commercial, vendor management and delivery team
* Act as a trusted advisor to the Group CTO and Group IT leadership on commercial and delivery matters
* Provide executive reporting on the contract portfolio, supplier performance, savings and delivery status for leadership forums, steering committees and quarterly business reviews
* Build strong working relationships with Procurement, Finance, Legal and Vertical leadership

**What we’re looking for:**

* 15+ years in technology commercial management, sourcing, vendor management and/or IT delivery in large, complex organisations
* 8+ years in senior leadership roles leading commercial and delivery teams
* Proven record of negotiating high-value technology contracts and delivering measurable, validated savings
* Experience leading portfolio and programme delivery at scale, including oversight of system integrators and managed service partners
* Experience in complex, multi-entity organisations (real estate, hospitality, investment or similar sectors preferred); GCC/UAE experience preferred

**Education/Professional Certification:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Finance or a related field
* MBA or relevant Master's degree strongly preferred
* CIPS or IAOP (COP) certification preferred
* PMP / MSP / PRINCE2, ITIL v4 or SAFe certifications
* FinOps Certified Practitioner is an advantage

**Technical Competencies:**

* Strong analytical thinking and commercial judgement
* Deep knowledge of technology commercial models: enterprise licensing, SaaS, cloud consumption, outcome-based and managed services
* Contract fundamentals, negotiation strategy and commercial risk management
* Vendor and third-party risk management frameworks
* Portfolio and programme management, including SPM tools (e.g., ServiceNow SPM or equivalent)
* Financial acumen: TCO, ROI, CapEx/OpEx, budgeting and forecasting
* Familiarity with Oracle Fusion procurement and contract processes
* Data-driven reporting and dashboards (e.g., Power BI)
* Understanding of AI and agentic platform pricing and commercial structures

**Behavioural Competencies:**

* Strong executive presence and influence at C-suite level
* Tough, fair negotiator who protects Dubai Holding's interests while building long-term partnerships
* Strategic thinking with strong execution discipline
* Clear, direct communicator who makes trade-offs and commitments explicit
* Results-oriented with high personal accountability and integrity
* Proven ability to build and lead high-performing teams

Title: D365 Project Manager
Description:
**About Lumovy Technology Solutions, LLC**
At Lumovy Technology Solutions, we are a Microsoft Solutions Partner delivering Dynamics 365, Azure and Power Platform solutions to enterprise clients across the Middle East, North America and South Asia. With delivery teams in the UAE, the USA, Canada, India and Pakistan, we help organizations modernize their finance, supply chain and retail operations on the Microsoft cloud. Visit us at www.lumovy.com
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead Microsoft Dynamics 365 implementations onsite with our enterprise clients in the UAE. You will own delivery end to end, from mobilization and fit-gap through go-live and hypercare, leading a blended onsite and offshore team and acting as the primary point of accountability for the client.
  
  
This is a client-facing role for a delivery leader who combines ERP lifecycle experience with commercial discipline: someone who protects scope, manages change formally, and keeps senior stakeholders aligned through to a successful go-live.
  
  
**Role Details**

* Location: United Arab Emirates, based onsite at client premises
* Travel: Within the UAE and wider GCC, as required by the engagement
* Employment type: Full-time, permanent

**Essential Functions**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations and/or Commerce implementations, from mobilization and requirements through go-live and hypercare, within agreed scope, timeline, budget and quality.
* Build and maintain the integrated project plan covering workstreams, milestones, dependencies, resource allocation and key decision points, aligned to Microsoft Success by Design.
* Govern the core ERP lifecycle: fit-gap analysis, solution design sign-off, conference room pilots, SIT and UAT, data migration, cutover planning, go-live readiness and transition to support.
* Act as the primary onsite point of contact for client stakeholders, from executive sponsors to process owners, ensuring transparent communication, expectation management and timely decisions.
* Run project governance through weekly status reporting, steering committee packs, RAID and decision logs, and formal milestone acceptance.
* Own project financials, including budget tracking, forecast versus actuals, milestone billing, resource utilization and margin protection.
* Enforce SOW scope through formal change control: assess impact, raise change requests, secure client approval and re-baseline plans accordingly.
* Identify and manage risks, issues and dependencies, including third-party vendors and integration partners such as POS, payment and banking providers, escalating early with clear mitigation options.
* Lead a blended onsite and offshore team, managing handoffs, time-zone coordination and the quality of offshore deliverables.
* Apply Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery approaches as appropriate, using Azure DevOps for backlog, sprint and test management.
* Coordinate with Microsoft, including FastTrack where applicable, on solution reviews, go-live readiness assessments and support escalations.
* Support account growth by contributing to estimates, delivery approaches and change proposals, and by identifying extension opportunities with the client.
* Mentor team members and build a culture of ownership, accountability and delivery quality.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration or a related field.
* 7+ years of project management experience in IT or technology consulting, including at least 4 years managing ERP implementations.
* A minimum of two full-lifecycle Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (or Dynamics AX) implementations as Project Manager, including at least one go-live.
* Hands-on experience managing data migration, cutover and hypercare for enterprise ERP programmes.
* Working knowledge of the core D365 F&O modules (Finance, Supply Chain Management) and how they integrate with surrounding systems.
* Proven ownership of project budgets, change requests and milestone billing in a client services or Microsoft partner environment.
* Experience leading blended onsite and offshore delivery teams.
* Proficiency in Azure DevOps and Microsoft Project or equivalent planning tools.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills, with experience presenting to steering committees and C-level sponsors.
* Based in the UAE or able to relocate at short notice.

**Nice To Have**

* Delivery experience with enterprise clients in the UAE or wider GCC (strongly preferred).
* PMP, PRINCE2 or Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) certification.
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 certifications, such as MB-300 or MB-700.
* Experience with Dynamics 365 Commerce, POS platforms (e.g. LS Central, NCR) or payment integrations.
* Exposure to Azure integration services, Power Platform and Dual-write.
* Industry experience in retail, distribution or manufacturing.
* Arabic language skills.
* Valid UAE driving licence.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive, market-aligned compensation package.
* UAE employment visa and medical insurance.
* The opportunity to lead high-profile Dynamics 365 programmes for leading enterprises in the region.
* Career growth within a fast-growing Microsoft partner, with access to Microsoft certification and learning programmes.

Title: IT Project Manager

+ Working knowledge of security frameworks and controls (e.g., ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, or equivalent) is an advantage.

+ PRINCE2 (Projects IN Controlled Environments).
+ Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or similar Agile certifications.

* Strong understanding of both Agile and traditional project management principles and practices.
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Technical Acumen
* Familiarity with system integrations, software development processes, and IT infrastructure.
* Ability to translate business needs into technical requirements.

* Working understanding of core security domains, including threat and vulnerability management, identity and access management, network and endpoint security, and incident response.

* Skilled in risk analysis, contingency planning, and problem resolution.

* Proven ability to build rapport with clients, vendors, and team members.
* Effective negotiation skills to address conflicting requirements and manage expectations.
* Attention to Detail
* Meticulous tracking of project documentation, ensuring consistency and accuracy.
* Strong attention to timelines, resources, and quality standards.

Title: Senior Manager, Technology Portfolio Governance
Description:
Join our Global Technology & Cyber Security (GTCS) team!

  
  

The Senior Manager, Technology Portfolio Governance helps Global Architecture & Engineering turn portfolio priorities into focused, measurable execution. Working across senior leadership and technology teams, you will provide the governance, insights, and portfolio discipline needed to support informed decisions about priorities, capacity, investment, risk, and delivery.

  
  

In this role, you will bring together data, perspectives, and competing priorities to help leaders understand trade-offs, make timely decisions, and follow through on commitments. You will also help modernize how portfolio governance works by improving processes, analytics, workflows, and automation, increasing transparency while reducing unnecessary administrative effort.

  
  

**Position Responsibilities:**

  
  

**Portfolio Strategy & Planning**

* Coordinate portfolio intake, prioritization, capacity planning, dependencies, risks, and commitments across Global Architecture & Engineering.
* Provide leaders with a clear, integrated view of portfolio priorities, performance, risks, dependencies, and overall health.
* Enable portfolio planning and rebalancing by identifying capacity constraints, competing priorities, dependencies, and trade-offs.
* Partner with portfolio and delivery teams to strengthen data quality and ensure portfolio information supports timely, informed decisions.
  

  

**Governance & Executive Decision Support**

* Lead and continuously improve portfolio governance practices across Global Architecture & Engineering.
* Establish clear governance routines, decision points, ownership, and accountability across portfolio activities.
* Coordinate portfolio governance across leadership teams and business areas while maintaining clear ownership with the teams responsible for delivery.
* Translate complex portfolio information into concise insights, recommendations, and decision points for senior leaders.
* Surface material risks, capacity constraints, dependencies, and trade-offs requiring leadership attention.

Title: Manager, Field Services Operations
Description:
PowerON Energy Solutions
  
  
Full-time
  
  
In-Office | Toronto, ON, Canada
  
  
This posting is for a newly created position
  
  
Salary range $120,000 - 140,000
  
  
PowerON delivers comprehensive electrification solutions, including infrastructure development and operations and maintenance (O&M). The Manager, Field Services Operations is a frontline operational owner responsible for ensuring that all preventive and corrective maintenance activities across PowerON's assets, including DC fast charging infrastructure, electrical distribution and protection equipment, Distributed Energy Resources (DERs), communications/SCADA platforms, and balance-of-plant infrastructure, are performed properly, safely, and to the required technical standard, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. This role directs PowerON's technician workforce across all shifts and all associated sub-contractors, including final decision and resource allocation for field based priorities.
  
  
The Manager is the single point of accountability for dispatch, technical execution, quality, safety and environmental compliance, supporting strategic customer relationships and ensuring exceptional service delivery across our portfolio. Working closely with our O&M, projects and 24/7 monitoring teams, this role reports to the Senior Manager, Asset Management & Operations, escalating complex, high impact or systemic issues while independently owning the day to day execution of field maintenance operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Leadership and Team Development**

* Lead and develop a team of field based technicians and sub-contractor specialists locally and nationally as the business grows, with an emphasis on self performing whenever possible
* Establish performance expectations and accountability measures aligned with the company objectives
* Coach, mentor and develop employees to support career growth and succession planning, managing performance and aligning with both HR policies and company objectives
* Manage recruitment, onboarding, performance reviews and employee engagement initiatives
* Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, safety and continuous improvement
* Manage within existing or new Collective Agreements where relevant to unionized employees

**Service Operations Management**

* Manage day to day field services locally and across our wider Canada portfolio for in house field technicians and sub-contractors over 24/7 operations, dealing with emergencies safely and promptly should they arise, including outside of normal business hours
* Exercise the final, independent managerial decision making authority over field operational priorities, technician and contractor assignments, remaining fully accountable through to completion of the task, project or activity
* Review Planned Maintenance schedules and tasking annually or more frequently as needed, updating to reflect equipment changes, historical trends, countermeasures from safety incidents, root cause analysis, industry best practice and OEM recommendations
* Ensure timely and effective support of customer installations with respect to planned maintenance, troubleshooting, corrective maintenance and emergency mobilization and response
* Ensure fulsome and accurate client and PowerON internal team communication in relation to unexpected failures, emergencies and subsequent safe return to normal operation
* Establish and maintain inventory control processes for spare parts across all client portfolios, including stocking strategy, purchasing approval, periodic audits and reconciliation, ensuring availability of critical spares and cost-effective use of inventory without compromising quality or reliability. Ensure resources, materials and equipment are available ahead of planned work, manage warranty claims/disputes and spare parts planning with vendors and OEM partners
* Drive service efficiency through effective resource scheduling, allocation, workload balancing and capacity planning
* Develop operational strategies to improve response times and customer satisfaction
* Monitor and report on service metrics, resource utilization, productivity and performance trends including but not limited to equipment availability, uptime, MTTR, MTBF

**Customer and Contractor Engagement**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with OEMs, sub-contractors, technical consultants and end users
* Act as the initial escalation point for critical customer impacting and technical issues
* Support strategic accounts through proactive service planning and relationship management while still maintaining suitable focus on less strategic client accounts and service delivery
* Collaborate with bid team to identify service growth and strengthen customer partnerships, contribute to new business proposals from O&M perspective

**Technical Leadership**

* Provide leadership and guidance on charging systems, DERS, electrical infrastructure and all equipment associated with client electrification systems
* Support field team with complex technical troubleshooting and problem resolution, ensuring adequate support and resources are available whenever required across a 24/7 operation
* Conduct root cause analysis and other appropriate investigations through to conclusion and implementation of approved countermeasures, updating all stakeholders throughout the process ensuring accurate and timely communication
* Ensure consistent adherence to associated technical standards, OEM recommendations and industry best practice

**Financial and Business Management**

* Manage departmental budget from planning through to execution
* Conduct regular financial analysis to identify efficiency improvements, gaps and forecast to adjust or recover as appropriate
* Monitor service revenues, costs and profitability
* Identify opportunities to expand service offerings and increase customer value
* Review resources on a continual basis to ensure efficiency and forecast future growth and demand
* Ensure timely and accurate completion of team timesheets, expenses and purchase card documentation, reviewing and approving with accuracy within the required payroll timeframes, avoiding errors to ensure correct payment and financial compliance
* Develop scope and draft agreements for third party sub-contractors for internal review prior to approval and sign off

**Health, Safety, Environmental and Quality Compliance**

* Maintain continual oversight of team safety performance, ensuring legislative compliance and PowerON and client policies are followed at all times promoting a strong safety conscious culture and achieving a zero-harm environment
* Serve as the final point of accountability for the safe and compliant execution of all preventive and corrective maintenance activities, including lock-out/tag-out, energized work controls and applicable codes and regulations
* Develop and lead safety initiatives including internal audits, deliver in house safety training in the form of ToolBox Talks and other available materials and media
* Fully investigate and document all issues utilizing PowerON’s Health, Safety and Environmental reporting platform, implementing root cause analysis and gaining approval for appropriate countermeasures from all stakeholders
* Develop and maintain a register of all licensing and certification requirements in relation to field technician and associated team member training, sub-contractor conformance. Plan and oversee training for internal and external requirements and build and maintain a technical library of SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and statements of work appropriate for PowerON’s O&M business

**Qualifications**

* Technical diploma or degree in electrical engineering, electromechanical, or a related discipline or equivalent field operations experience including critical infrastructure and systems
* Minimum of 5 years experience directly managing technical service related mobile and static teams both unionized and non unionized, prioritizing field based dispatch
* Strong working knowledge of good Health, Safety and Environmental practices aligning with ISO45001 and ISO14001 and including but not limited to practical applications of emergency response, spill management and lock-out/tag-out procedures across low/medium/high voltage systems
* Demonstrated knowledge of DC fast charging or similar electrification infrastructure, including electrical distribution, switchgear, power conversion equipment, and SCADA/communications platforms, or a strong ability to quickly build this expertise
* Working knowledge of DERs including emergency generators, BESS and solar systems
* Experience managing sub-contractors and OEM/vendor relationships, including statements of work, contract performance, warranty claims and spare parts control
* Experience with CMMS/EAM platforms (e.g. MaintainX or equivalent) for work planning, scheduling, dispatch, and work order control
* Awareness of ISO55000 in relation to asset management and the practical application in a field based environment
* Financial management experience in planning and operating budgets including labour, external partner costs, spare parts inventory, emergency response and future growth forecasting
* Project management and commissioning experience desirable
* Strong client-facing communication skills, with experience managing stakeholder updates and service review meetings
* Willingness to be available across shifts, including evenings, weekends, and on-call rotations, as required by a 24/7 operating environment
* Strong organizational and documentation skills, with the adaptability to take on new or evolving responsibilities as the role and business grow
* Flexibility to travel occasionally outside of the Toronto/GTA and Ontario, across Canada for the management of third party service providers and client relationships
* Hold valid driver’s license and be able to use own vehicle where appropriate to navigate around local sites

While all qualified candidates are invited to apply, we particularly welcome applications from women, persons with disabilities, First Nations, Métis and Inuit peoples, members of visible minorities, and 2SLGBTQ+ persons.
  
  
*We thank all applicants for their interest, however only those candidates selected for interviews will be contacted. PowerON will accommodate candidates under the AODA legislation in all aspects of the hiring process. Please notify us if accommodation is required.*

Title: Customer Success Manager - UAE
Description:

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.
  
  
We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We’re seeking an exceptional Customer Success Manager with deep expertise in the UAE private sector enterprise landscape to lead our most strategic accounts across these dynamic markets. This role requires an individual who understands both the transformative potential of frontier AI and the unique requirements of private sector organizations in Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Strategic Customer Partnership**

* Own the success, adoption, and growth of Cohere’s UAE private sector customers, ensuring they realize maximum value from our AI solutions.
* Build deep, trusted relationships with senior enterprise stakeholders, including CXOs, VPs, Directors, and digital transformation leads.
* Develop comprehensive success plans tailored to each organization’s mission, digital strategy, budget cycles, and unique constraints.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and executive sponsor for your accounts, managing escalations and ensuring customer satisfaction.

**AI Adoption & Implementation Leadership**

* Guide customers through the full lifecycle of AI adoption—from use case identification and pilot design through production deployment and scaling.

* Create and execute change management strategies to drive user adoption and value realization across diverse enterprise workforces.
* Conduct regular executive business reviews with senior stakeholders, demonstrating ROI, impact, and strategic value.
* Drive contract renewals and account growth by consistently delivering value and building trusted relationships.

* Share customer insights to inform Cohere’s regional go-to-market strategy and positioning.

* 8+ years of experience in customer success, account management, strategic consulting, or technology delivery roles within enterprise or private sector contexts.
* At least 3-5 years working directly with UAE enterprises across industries such as finance, healthcare, logistics, or technology.
* Proven track record of managing complex, strategic accounts with multiple stakeholders, long sales cycles, and multi-year implementation timelines.
* Experience leading AI/ML, cloud, or enterprise software implementations in secure or highly regulated environments.
* Experience developing and executing customer success strategies, QBRs, and executive engagement programs.
* Deep understanding of how UAE enterprises evaluate, procure, and govern technology solutions.
* Fluent Arabic and English language proficiency—essential for working across regional markets.

**Regional Expertise**

* Understanding of the UAE business environment: free zones, mainland companies, and multinational operations.
* Knowledge of relevant regulations: UAE Labour Law (Federal Decree Law No. 33 of 2021), Saudi business regulations, and data protection frameworks.
* Familiarity with national initiatives: Saudi Vision 2030, UAE Digital Transformation Strategy, and Smart Dubai.
* Experience with regional cloud strategies and security frameworks.

**Nice to Have**

* 3+ years specifically managing GenAI, LLM, or conversational AI implementations.
* Experience with UAE enterprise digital transformation initiatives.
* Direct experience with regional defense, financial services, or healthcare sectors.
* Background in management consulting, systems integration, or digital transformation consulting for regional clients.

Title: Technology Application Services Manager
Description:
**Purpose of the role:**

The Technology Application Services Manager is accountable for the architectural integrity, operational support, service continuity, and long-term health of the Bank's business applications. The role owns portfolio rationalization, internal application support, vendor-provided support, vendor management, and leadership of the Application Services team.

**B. ROLE ACCOUNTABILITIES**

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Application Ownership & Solution Architecture**

* Own solution design and architecture across the Bank's business applications estate.
* Hold design authority and provide sign-off on proposed solutions, upgrades, and customizations.
* Define and enforce integration and API standards across the portfolio, maintaining architectural coherence between systems.
* Partner with the Cybersecurity & Infrastructure Lead and Delivery Leads on cross-domain initiatives.

**Portfolio Health & Rationalization**

* Maintain an ongoing view of the applications portfolio's health, identifying underperforming systems, technical debt, and enhancement, upgrade, or replacement requirements.
* Translate findings into recommendations that feed budget and roadmap planning.

**Deployment, Release & Quality Management**

* Establish and maintain a DevOps methodology and toolset spanning version control and build management.
* Hold vendors accountable for build and release quality.
* Ensure application health monitoring and operational support controls are in place, with accountability for uptime, incident rates, support performance, and service improvement across the estate.

**Application Support & Vendor Management**

* Own the end-to-end application support model across the estate, covering support delivered internally by the Application Services team and support provided by vendors or other third parties.
* Ensure incidents, service requests, recurring problems, and user issues are triaged, investigated, resolved, escalated, and communicated in line with agreed service levels.
* Act as the senior escalation point for application support issues, coordinating internal technical resources and vendors through to resolution and ensuring root-cause analysis and corrective actions are completed.
* Manage vendor-provided support, including support agreements, SLAs, service performance, escalations, and value for money.

**Budget & Portfolio Planning**

* Own the annual applications budget, linking funding requirements to portfolio rationalization findings.

**Delivery Support**

* Provide technical input and estimates during planning.
* Ensure environments, builds and integration points are ready ahead of milestones.
* Ensure quality gates are met before release.

**People Leadership**

* Manage, develop and lead the Application Services team.
* Own hiring input, performance management and development planning.
* Establish cross-training to reduce key-man dependency.
* Foster technical excellence and ownership.

**C. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPI)**

*To measure and monitor the performance of the role in the context of the Section/Department's activities*

* System uptime & incident rates (estate-wide)
* Architecture standards adherence
* Portfolio health & rationalization
* Internal and vendor-provided application support performance
* Vendor performance, SLA compliance & cost
* Portfolio & budget management
* Team capability & engagement

**D. EXPERIENCE, QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS**

**Minimum Experience & Essential Knowledge**

* 15 years progressive experience in Information Technology, with at least 5 years in a people leadership / team lead capacity
* Financial services background in a similar environment (investment management, core banking, or private wealth) in a lead capacity is a mandatory requirement
* Experience within a bank, investment firm, or other regulated financial services environment
* Expertise across core banking, CRM/ERP, integration/middleware, and investment management platforms desirable (e.g. T24/Temenos, Microsoft Dynamics)
* Proven experience in solution architecture and integration/API design across enterprise applications
* Experience establishing and maturing DevOps practices, including deployment governance and release management
* Experience leading internal application support operations and managing vendor-provided support, including incident, problem, request, escalation, and SLA management

**Minimum Entry Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline

**Certifications desirable:**

* Temenos T24 certification
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 certification
* TOGAF
* ITIL Foundation
* Azure/cloud DevOps certification

* Proven experience delivering Identity & Access Management (IAM) or Cybersecurity projects.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies, frameworks, and governance practices.
* Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional teams and multiple stakeholders.
