As Vertech's NERC CIP Program Director, you will build and lead our new NERC CIP compliance practice inside our Industrial Networking and Cybersecurity (INCS) Managed OT Security Services offering.

This is a builder's role. You will shape the services we offer, design how we deliver them, hire and lead the team, and own client compliance programs from registration through audit. You won't be doing it alone: our 24/7/365 OT Network and Security Operations Center already delivers the monitoring and recurring technical work behind CIP compliance. You bring the program and audit leadership that turns that work into audit-ready programs for utilities and renewable energy owners.

This position is remote, with regular travel to client sites, control centers, generation sites, and audits.

**Who We Are**

At Vertech, not only do we develop world class industrial automation solutions for some of the top US companies, we also strive to be the team of choice for the best and brightest talent. I mean, we call ourselves control freaks for a reason. The passion (and intelligence) our employees have is truly mind-blowing. In turn, we work hard to take care of our own with excellent benefits and pay, personal development, and transparent communication. We also know that you can be great at what you do and still have fun. If that sounds like a good fit, help us bring the next generation of automation solutions to industries including data centers, renewable energy, manufacturing, food and beverage, water and wastewater, and more.

Our Industrial Networking & Cybersecurity team helps clients assess, secure, modernize, and support Operational Technology environments, then protects them around the clock through our managed OT security services. NERC CIP compliance is the next service we're adding for the energy and renewable clients we already support.

**Top Reasons to Work with Us**

* Flexible work schedule with work from home options for many roles
* Weekly communication from management in our internally famous Friday morning meeting
* Competitive compensation including a bonus plan
* No more than a 4 week waiting period on all benefits including the 401k
* A really rad Christmas Party each year
* A manager that is cool…most of the time, because no one is perfect
* A path for growth, a great culture, PTO, AND MORE!

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Build our NERC CIP practice: the service catalog, delivery model, methodologies, templates, policy libraries, and evidence frameworks
* Lead client CIP programs from end to end, from NERC and Regional Entity registration, CFRs, and CIP-002 categorization through policies, procedures, and internal controls across CIP-003 through CIP-013 and CIP-015
* Manage evidence collection and document management, RSAWs, self-certifications, and Evidence Request Tool submissions
* Run mock audits and gap analyses, and lead clients through Regional Entity audits
* Guide clients through enforcement, including self-reports, mitigation plans, and Regional Entity discussions
* Deliver supply chain risk management (CIP-013 and CIP-003 vendor remote access) and BES Cyber System Information protection (CIP-011) services
* Lead readiness work for upcoming requirements, including the CIP virtualization revisions and CIP-015 internal network security monitoring
* Serve as a Fractional CIP Senior Manager for clients that can't staff the role themselves
* Partner with our SOC and OT security engineers so our managed services produce complete, audit-ready evidence
* Hire, lead, and develop a team of CIP compliance consultants
* Be the NERC CIP expert behind our sales and marketing team: scope engagements, shape proposals, and build trusted relationships with client compliance and executive leaders
* Develop and deliver NERC CIP training for client personnel, contractors, and vendors
* Track NERC, FERC, and Regional Entity developments and turn them into client guidance and new offerings

**What You Need for this Position**

**Job Description**

As Head of Business Systems Product & Transformation for Fiix, Rockwell Automation's cloud-based maintenance management (CMMS) and asset management software business, you will own the systems and processes that run our software business from lead to cash to renewal.

  
  
  

Your first and most important priority is to perform: stabilize and run the business systems that support Fiix today. You will reduce a significant backlog, bring clear ownership and priorities, strengthen platform reliability and deliver at high velocity for Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success and Support.

  
  
  

Once the foundation is stable, you will lead the transformation: working with Rockwell Automation's enterprise commercial transformation program to define the future-state operating model for the Fiix business (how our processes, systems and teams work across the Rockwell Automation organization) and to deliver coordinated outcomes across the software portfolio, including FactoryTalk Hub.

  
  
  

You will lead a team of Lead Product Managers across three areas – Go-to-Market & Salesforce CRM, Product & Integration (including FactoryTalk Hub), and Revenue & Support Operations – and partner closely with a dedicated PMO and a business systems engineering team to turn strategy into delivered results.

  
  
  

**What Fiix Business Systems Does**

Our business systems connect how Fiix markets, sells, quotes, provisions, bills and supports its customers. The platform spans Salesforce (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ), revenue and billing systems, middleware and integrations, product provisioning, and marketing and customer success tools. Today these systems are dedicated to Fiix. As Rockwell Automation's enterprise systems and software portfolio evolve, including FactoryTalk Hub, this role will help determine how Fiix systems and processes should work alongside them.

  
  
  

**Your Responsibilities**

Perform: Stabilize & Execute

* Stabilize the Fiix business systems in the first 6–12 months: triage and reduce the backlog, fix the highest-impact issues and restore confidence with business stakeholders.
* Establish clear ownership, service levels and measures of success for core systems and processes (e.g., backlog age, quote-to-cash cycle time, system reliability, data quality).
* Partner with the PMO on a single intake process, prioritization, capacity planning, budget and status reporting.
* Partner with the business systems engineering lead on release planning, platform stability and delivery quality.
* Run a regular operating rhythm: weekly prioritization, regular delivery cycles and monthly roadmap reviews with business stakeholders.
* Reduce backlog and operational friction through clear ownership, process simplification and automation.
* Keep near-term delivery aligned with the enterprise direction so today's work does not create rework later.
  

  
  

Strategy & Roadmap

* Own the end-to-end vision, multi-quarter roadmap and architecture principles across nine domains: go-to-market, Salesforce enterprise architecture, product provisioning, middleware and integration, case management and support, finance systems (FinTech), marketing technology, customer technology and data.
* Set priorities across the three product areas, balancing business value, risk, cost and engineering capacity.
* Translate company and business-unit goals into a clear roadmap and measurable outcomes (e.g., quote-to-cash cycle time, forecast accuracy, data quality, backlog age, system adoption).
* Establish architectural standards and governance for changes that cross systems and teams.
  

  
  

Leadership & Team Development

* Lead, coach and develop Lead Product Managers; set clear decision rights, priorities and performance expectations.
* Build a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Recruit for open roles and strengthen capability through talent development and succession planning.
  

  
  

Cross-Functional Partnership

* Be a trusted advisor to Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, Support, Product and IT leaders.
* Balance stakeholder priorities and facilitate cross-functional governance and communication.
* Coordinate with Product Engineering and IT on product provisioning, integrations, identity and access.
* Keep management, peers and team members informed on priorities, progress and risks. Transform: Future-State Operating Model
* As the business stabilizes, lead the shift to transformation in partnership with Rockwell Automation's enterprise commercial transformation team.
* Serve as the Fiix business systems lead with Rockwell Automation's enterprise commercial transformation team, representing Fiix requirements in future-state design, release planning and roadmap decisions.
* Develop a multi-year strategy that evaluates, process by process, the right future-state approach for Fiix (keeping Fiix-specific systems, connecting with Rockwell Automation enterprise systems, or adopting shared capabilities as they become ready), with clear decision points, sequencing and risks.
* Define the architecture and data model needed to give customers a seamless experience across Fiix, Rockwell Automation enterprise systems and the software portfolio, including FactoryTalk Hub, across quoting, ordering, provisioning, billing, renewal and support.
* Lead change management for the Fiix business as the operating model evolves, protecting business continuity and customer experience.
* Build strong working relationships with enterprise transformation, IT, Finance and portfolio product leaders to deliver coordinated outcomes.
  

  
  

**The Essentials - You Will Have:**

Description:

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

----------------

The **Applications Development Group Manager** is a senior technology management role responsible for directing and delivering large-scale, high-performance payment applications, enterprise middleware architecture, and cloud/DevOps modernization initiatives. This role manages distributed engineering and infrastructure teams to design, build, and deploy resilient, mission-critical systems across hybrid cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP, and on-premises enterprise platforms). * **Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) & Performance Engineering:** Spearhead system performance optimization, capacity planning, latency reduction, high availability, disaster recovery (DR), and Continuity of Business (COB) operations.
  

  

**Governance, Risk Assessment & Compliance**
--------------------------------------------

* **Authentication & Security Standards:** Enforce rigorous enterprise security standards, including identity and access management (IAM), SSO, SAML, OIDC, OAuth2, and container vulnerability scanning.

* **Risk & Control Adherence:** Assess operational and technological risks in architectural decisions, ensuring full compliance with regulatory requirements, change management controls, and internal governance frameworks.

* **10+ years of extensive IT experience** in enterprise software development, middleware infrastructure engineering, and cloud platforms.

* **8+ years in technical leadership and people management**, leading cross-functional teams in banking, FinTech, or financial services environments.

* Proven track record architecting and modernizing **high-throughput payments processing platforms** and distributed transaction systems.

* Demonstrated experience leading **datacenter-to-cloud migrations** (e.g., Azure AKS, AWS, GCP) and containerization strategies using Docker, OpenShift, and Kubernetes.

* Deep hands-on background in **enterprise middleware and application servers** (IBM WebSphere, Oracle WebLogic, Apache Tomcat, Nginx).

* In-depth understanding of enterprise messaging architectures (Kafka, IBM MQ, Solace) and database platforms (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MS SQL).
  

  

**Technical Competencies & Certifications**
-------------------------------------------

* **Container & Orchestration Platforms:** Red Hat OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker, Helm.

* **DevOps / Automation:** Terraform, Ansible, Azure Pipelines, Jenkins, Python, Shell Scripting.

* **Security & Identity:** LDAP, SSO, SAML, OAuth2, OIDC.

* **Certifications (Preferred / Highly Regarded):**

* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) / Application Developer (CKAD) / Security Specialist (CKS)

* Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration (EX280)

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) or Cloud Architecture certifications

* **Master’s degree:** Master of Computer Applications (M.C.A.), M.S., or equivalent advanced degree preferred.

Title: Senior Manager/Director of IT & Security
Description:
**About Neurophos**
===================

The demand for new data centers and AI compute is rapidly outpacing the planet's energy capacity. Digital solutions are hitting a power wall as we approach the physical limits of traditional silicon. Conquering this bottleneck means rethinking the fundamental architecture of inference compute. The industry's current path can't meet the need, so we're taking a different approach.

Instead of traditional electronic circuits, we use silicon photonics and an active, programmable metasurface to perform matrix multiplications at the speed of light. Our optical cells are 10,000x smaller than traditional photonic components, enabling unprecedented density. By using photonics instead of electricity, our chips become more efficient as they scale. This architecture will deliver up to 100 times the energy efficiency of existing solutions while significantly improving performance for large-scale AI inference.

We’ve assembled a world-class team of industry veterans and recently raised a $110M Series A led by Gates Frontier. Participants include M12 (Microsoft’s Venture Fund), Carbon Direct Capital, Aramco Ventures, Bosch Ventures, Tectonic Ventures, Space Capital, and others.

Join us and shape the future of computing!

**Location:** Austin, TX or Sunnyvale, CA. Full-time onsite position.

**Reports To**: SVP of Engineering

**FLSA Status**: Exempt

**Position Overview**
---------------------

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Manager or Director of IT & Security to own Neurophos's IT infrastructure and information security programs across our Sunnyvale and Austin sites. Today, an external managed service provider (MSP) delivers help desk, endpoint protection, and around-the-clock security monitoring. You will own architecture, security posture, and compliance. You will direct the MSP for routine operations and decide what to bring in-house, in what order, and with what staffing.

Much of this does not exist yet. You will define it as the company grows past 150 people.

This is a builder role. You start as the senior-most IT and security voice in the company with no internal team, and you will do much of the hands-on work yourself. That includes standing up servers, writing configuration code, and running incident response. As the function grows, you will hire and lead the team that runs it.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Engineering Compute & Private Cloud**

  + Design, deploy, and operate on-premises Linux servers and clusters for EDA/CAD tools, photonic simulation, and performance modeling.
  + Run batch scheduling (SLURM, LSF, or equivalent), floating license servers (FlexNet/FlexLM), and license-aware queue policy. Forecast compute, storage, and license demand ahead of tapeouts and program milestones.
  + Operate shared storage, scratch tiering, snapshots, and backup, with restore and disaster recovery procedures tested on a set schedule.
  + Manage provisioning and configuration as code (PXE, standard images, Ansible or equivalent), and own patch and lifecycle cadence across the fleet.

  **Identity, Access & Developer Platform**

  + Own SSO and identity architecture in Okta: SAML application onboarding, SCIM provisioning, verified deprovisioning, group and role design, MFA, and privileged access.
  + Administer GitHub Enterprise, Google Workspace, Dropbox, Atlassian, and engineering and AI tooling. This covers sharing controls, retention, external-collaborator policy, license inventory, and renewals.
  + Run periodic access reviews and enforce least-privilege access to chip design repositories, process design kits (PDKs), and other high-value engineering data.

  **Network, Cloud & Sites**

  + Design and stand up wired and wireless networks at both sites, covering switching, VLANs, firewalls, VPN, and zero-trust access. Keep lab, corporate, and customer-facing environments segmented.
  + Administer public cloud (Azure preferred), covering account structure, IAM, networking, and cost visibility. Own hybrid connectivity between sites and cloud.
  + Lead the IT build-out for new office and lab space, including ISPs, circuits, and conference room A/V and video conferencing standards.

  **Security Operations & Incident Response**

  + Own SIEM/EDR, logging, and intrusion detection across endpoints, servers, and cloud, and direct the MSP's 24x7 monitoring.
  + Run vulnerability management end-to-end, covering asset scanning, prioritization, and remediation tracking with engineering teams.
  + Own the incident response runbook and serve as incident commander during security events, including forensic analysis and post-mortems.

  **Governance, Risk & Compliance**

  + Author and enforce security policy: acceptable use, data classification, network segmentation, backup and disaster recovery, and AI tool usage.
  + Lead the SOC 2 Type II program (Vanta, Drata, or similar) with engineering, the General Counsel, and external auditors.
  + Work with the General Counsel on export control (EAR/ITAR) access controls, foundry and IP-vendor data handling obligations, and customer data protection.
  + Lead customer security reviews, questionnaires, and technical due diligence with customers and investors. Assess the security risk of new SaaS and infrastructure vendors.

  **Endpoints**

  + Own the Mac, Windows, and Linux fleet: standards, imaging, MDM, encryption, patch compliance, procurement, asset tracking, and secure disposal.
  + Provide escalation support for the issues the MSP help desk cannot resolve, especially on Linux and engineering workstations.

  **MSP Governance, Budget & Team**

  + Serve as the single accountable owner of the MSP relationship: scope, SLAs, escalation paths, quarterly reviews, and cost.
  + Own the IT and security budget, report posture and roadmap to engineering leadership, and hire and develop the internal team as functions move in-house.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 10+ years in IT infrastructure, systems engineering, or security engineering, including 3+ years leading an IT or security function, team, or outsourced provider.
* Experience as the primary IT or security owner at a company under 200 people, or building a function from near zero through rapid growth.
* Hands-on Linux administration below the application layer, including storage, networking, kernel and driver troubleshooting, and fleet-scale configuration management.
* Experience operating HPC or EDA compute, including batch schedulers (SLURM, LSF, or equivalent) and floating license servers.
* Demonstrated ownership of SSO/IdP and IAM/PAM architecture (Okta strongly preferred), including SCIM provisioning and verified deprovisioning.
* Hands-on ownership of a SIEM/EDR stack, a vulnerability management program, and incident response.
* Direct experience leading at least one SOC 2 Type II audit cycle and responding to customer security questionnaires or technical due diligence.
* Practical network engineering: switching, VLANs, enterprise Wi-Fi, firewall policy, VPN, and DNS/DHCP. Able to design a site network and stand it up.
* Working proficiency in at least one major public cloud (Azure preferred) and working knowledge of export control frameworks (EAR/ITAR) as applied to technical data.
* Willingness to work onsite and travel between Sunnyvale and Austin as needed.

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

* Experience supporting semiconductor or hardware engineering organizations, including Cadence, Synopsys, or Siemens EDA environments, foundry PDK access requirements, and lab/test networks.
* Experience moving outsourced IT or security operations in-house, including standing up an internal help desk, MDM, or endpoint program.
* Enterprise storage and data protection (NetApp, Pure, Rubrik, Veeam, or similar) with multi-site replication and disaster recovery testing.
* High-performance networking (RoCE, InfiniBand) or rack-scale hardware bring-up.
* CISSP, CISM, CCSP, or OSCP, and familiarity with NIST CSF or ISO 27001.

**What We Offer**
=================

This is an opportunity to play a pivotal role in an innovative startup redefining the future of AI hardware. Work on game-changing technology at the intersection of photonics and AI as part of a collaborative, brilliant team. You’ll contribute to a platform that redefines computational performance and accelerates the future of artificial intelligence. Come help us bring this transformative technology to the world.

**Benefits**
------------

Join a team that invests in your future and your well-being. At Neurophos, we offer:

* 100% coverage of base health plan premiums for you and your dependents, plus HSA contributions.
* Unlimited PTO. No rigid vacation banks, just a focus on delivery.
* 401(k) matching and stock option opportunities to ensure our success is your success.
* Full suite of voluntary benefits, including Dental, Vision, Life, Hospital, Critical Illness, and Accident insurance.
* Personalized Benefits. Choose the plans that fit your life and take the cash back for those that don’t.

Compensation Range: $225K - $275K

Title: Senior Manager, Operations Analytics
Description:
**About Wonder**

Everything’s on the menu at Wonder. Except compromise.

Wonder is the mealtime platform built to feed every craving in one order. With Wonder, you can mix and match hundreds of dishes from 20+ exclusive restaurants in a single order, so everyone gets exactly what they’re craving. Enjoy everything from tacos to Thai with $0 delivery fees, plus dine-in or pick up at a Wonder location near you. Each dish is made to order on-site by our culinary team and served hot.

Behind the scenes, Wonder owns and operates every step of the dining experience, from recipe development to the technology that powers our experience, allowing us to deliver quality, variety, and consistency at scale.

*Join us as we work to make great food more accessible.*

**About the team**
------------------

IKC Product owns the software that runs Wonder's kitchen operations: order sequencing, kitchen display systems, dispatch, forecasting, and the tools culinary and ops teams use every day across our portfolio of brands. We build for a "reliability beats delight" standard — the systems have to work on the worst day, not just the average one.

**About the role**
------------------

The Senior Manager Operations Analytics will own the data layer behind our operations products. This isn't a general BI role. You'll work directly with the teams building our menu, item, kitchen and courier systems to define what "good" looks like for each product, build the pipelines and models that measure it, and turn that into throughput, and reliability signals the business actually acts on.

You'll be the analytical backbone for a product org that is actively rearchitecting how kitchen operations data flows and you'll have real input into where that architecture goes next. **This is a product-facing role, not an operations-reporting role.** This person sits inside Product: partnering with PMs to decide what gets built next.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own the data models and pipelines that power our operations products, from raw kitchen event data to the metrics that go in front of leadership
* Partner with product managers on item, menu, kitchen and courier systems define KPIs and North Star metrics per product, then build the instrumentation to track them and use that data to inform what each product should do next, not just how it's performing today
* Help design and influence models for kitchen order volume and improve accuracy as new IKCs (Infinite Kitchen Centers) come online.
* Stand up throughput and reliability reporting for dispatch and delivery — the kind of thing that catches a rerouting or capacity problem before it becomes a customer issue.
* Own data quality and definitional consistency across products that currently sit on different systems, as we consolidate onto a unified data and Jira structure.
* Translate ambiguous operational questions ("why did Chelsea's delivery volume drop") into a repeatable analysis, not a one-off pull.
* Work closely with engineering on schema and event design so the data you need is captured at the source, not reconstructed after the fact.
* Build the business case for ops product investments: quantify the cost of the current state, model expected impact of a proposed change, and give leadership a clear, numbers-backed basis for prioritization.
* Partner with finance and product leadership to size ROI on major initiatives before they're greenlit, then track actuals against the case post-launch so we know what actually paid off.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

  

* 5+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a hybrid analyst/engineer role, ideally in operations, logistics, or marketplace/on-demand environments.
* Strong SQL and experience with a modern data stack (dbt or equivalent transformation layer, a cloud warehouse, and pipeline orchestration).
* Track record of building metrics frameworks from scratch for a product or operational domain, not just maintaining existing dashboards.
* Comfort working directly with product managers and engineers to define what should be measured, not just how to measure it.
* Experience with forecasting or demand-planning models, or a clear ability to pick that up fast.
* A bias toward practical, durable data models over one-off analysis — you'd rather build the pipeline once than pull the same report five times.

**Nice to have**
----------------

  

* Experience in food, delivery, or physical operations (kitchens, warehouses, fulfillment centers) where the data reflects a real-world process with failure modes.
* Familiarity with multi-brand or multi-entity data environments where the same metric can mean different things in different systems.
* Exposure to computer vision or IoT data pipelines (we're integrating kitchen CV data as part of our roadmap).

NYC: $193,500 - $213,500

Title: SOC Project Manager – SOC Lead (Secret Clearance)
Description:

ShorePoint is a fast-growing, industry-recognized and award-winning cybersecurity services firm focused on high-profile, high-threat public and private sector customers who demand experience and proven security models to protect their data. We embrace a “work hard, play hard” mentality and celebrate individual and company successes. **Who we’re looking for:**

We are seeking a **SOC Project Manager – SOC Lead (Secret Clearance)** to lead and manage all Security Operations Center functions. The SOC Lead will ensure unified service delivery across sub-task areas, provide operational direction and influence executive leadership to align security operations with enterprise objectives. The **SOC Project Manager – SOC Lead** role requires deep expertise in SOC management, incident response and hybrid on-premises/cloud environments. This is a unique opportunity to shape the growth, development and culture of an exciting and fast-growing company in the cybersecurity market.

**What you’ll be doing:**

  

* Lead a 24x7x365 SOC for unclassified environments. Ensure shift managers and escalation contacts cover every shift and on-call support is available for incident response.
* Coordinate task execution across sub-task leads to achieve enterprise-level objectives.
* Oversee the integration and coordination of on-premises and cloud-based SOC capabilities.
* Communicate effectively with executive leadership and stakeholders on SOC performance and posture.
* Ensure SOC operations adhere to the full NIST Cybersecurity Framework: Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond and Recover.
* Manage dedicated business-hours coverage commitments for specific customer offices, including staggered shift scheduling.
* Serve as, or direct, the Incident Commander for significant and widespread incidents. Responsibilities include:
  + Lead incident calls.
  + Coordinate response across all teams and task orders.
  + Manage government notifications and stakeholder communications.
  + Track after-action items through remediation.
* Direct the task order incident coordinators within each sub-task area. Ensure playbook adherence and full incident lifecycle documentation in the ticketing system.
* Oversee required reporting to federal oversight bodies, the Inspector General and law enforcement. Oversee reporting of classified spills onto unclassified systems.
* Coordinate with interagency and intelligence community partners such as CISA, the FBI and DHS.
* Execute the operational side of SOC consolidation:
  + Onboarding new customer organizations’ log sources and alerting.
  + Standardizing detection logic, escalation protocols and playbooks.
  + Transitioning onboarded organizations into steady-state operations and maintenance.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, incident response playbooks, an alert severity and triage framework, and standardized reporting templates.
* Own SOC performance metrics: mean time to detect, mean time to respond, alert volumes, false positive rates, ticket closure rates and SLA compliance. Explain any deviations and propose corrective actions.
* Build a centralized incident knowledge base and lessons-learned repository that is shared across customer organizations.
* Lead adoption of AI-enabled analytics and next-generation security automation.

  

**What you need to know:**

  

* Strong background in cybersecurity incident response across large, complex enterprise environments.
* Proven ability to align SOC functions with the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
* Experience coordinating subordinate managers and technical leads to deliver cohesive operations.
* Skilled at influencing executive leadership and driving organizational adoption of SOC best practices
* Hands-on SOC leadership experience with Splunk/Splunk ES and EDR platforms such as Trellix/FireEye HX and Microsoft Defender.
* Experience with ServiceNow-based incident management, network intrusion detection (Snort/Zeek), threat intelligence platforms (MISP, STIX/TAXII) and vulnerability tools (Tenable, Qualys).
* Experience managing 24x7 shift-based workforces, including scheduling, coverage, retention and escalation structures.
* Familiarity with federal incident reporting requirements and OMB M-21-31 event logging maturity.

  

**Must have’s:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree or 3+ additional years of relevant experience in lieu of degree.
* 10+ years managing SOC operations and incident response for enterprise environments (50,000+ endpoints), including 5+ years leading hybrid on-premises/cloud SOCs with full NIST Cybersecurity Framework coverage.
* Proven ability to analyze complex requirements and translate them into clear, actionable tasks and processes through critical thinking.

Title: Digitalisation & Technology Manager
Description:

The company combines the efforts of a highly skilled workforce, along with strategic planning and innovative use of technology to overcome the most complex business challenges. Six Construct is a multi-services company that operates in the construction of commercial and residential buildings, sport and leisure facilities, infrastructure and marine-related projects. The company currently employs a workforce of approximately 4,000 in the Middle East, and a total of 10,000 worldwide.

**Job Description**

**Why This Role Matters**

We are seeking a forward-thinking
**Digital & Technology Manager**
to drive the digital transformation agenda across our business. This role will be responsible for identifying, evaluating, and implementing innovative technologies that improve operational efficiency, project delivery, collaboration, and data-driven decision-making.

* Ensure security and confidentiality by design, making these requirements an integral part of technology selection and digital processes rather than an obstacle to innovation. Confidentiality and control of information are foundational principles of the new Construction Company.
* Connect business, construction and technology, acting as the interface between management, project teams, technical functions, technology providers and specialist partners.

**Qualifications**

**You're a Great Fit If You Have**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
* Proven experience leading digital transformation, innovation, or technology-driven business improvement initiatives.
* Experience implementing digital platforms, automation tools, AI solutions, analytics platforms, or enterprise technologies.
* Strong understanding of change management and technology adoption.
* Demonstrated ability to bridge business needs and technology solutions.
* Experience within construction, engineering, infrastructure, industrial, manufacturing, energy, logistics, or other project-based industries is preferred but not mandatory.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Passion for innovation, emerging technologies, and continuous improvement.

**Preferred**

* Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Generative AI
* Automation and Digital Workflows
* Data Analytics and Business Intelligence (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)
* BIM and Digital Construction Technologies
* Common Data Environments (ACC, BIM 360, ProjectWise, etc.)
* Digital Twins, IoT, Reality Capture, or Smart Infrastructure Solutions
* Cloud-based collaboration and enterprise platforms

**Additional Information**

**What Success Looks Like**

* Digital principles are embedded into the company's operating model from day one.
* Core business systems and digital platforms are successfully implemented.
* Manual and repetitive processes are reduced through automation and digital workflows.
* Measurable productivity improvements are achieved through technology adoption.
* Data-driven decision-making becomes part of everyday operations.
* The organization develops a sustainable culture of innovation and continuous improvement.
* A secure, scalable, and integrated digital ecosystem supports future business growth.

Title: Group Operational Asset Lifecycle Manager
Description:
Job description:
  
  

**Group Operational Asset Lifecycle Manager**

We are a leading independent telecoms infrastructure company, with one of the most extensive tower portfolios across Africa and the Middle East. Our business model promotes tower infrastructure sharing and enables mobile network operators (MNOs) to deliver mobile connectivity more quickly, reliably, cost-effectively and with a lower carbon footprint. In turn, this supports the expansion and quality of mobile connectivity, driving sustainable development in our markets.

**What we do**

We build, acquire, lease-up and operate telecommunications towers that can accommodate and power the needs of multiple tenants. Our tenants are major mobile network operators (MNOs), and we serve them across nine high-growth markets: eight in Africa and Oman in the Middle East. Our purpose, mission and sustainable business strategy are underpinned by our values of integrity, partnership and excellence.

**Overview**

Reporting into the Operations & Performance Engineering function, you will develop, govern and improve Group operational asset lifecycle strategies for telecommunications infrastructure assets. You will help ensure strong operational performance, reliability, safety, QHSE compliance and long-term value across the asset portfolio.

Working with Engineering, Operations, Finance, Procurement, IT and Maintenance Partners, you will lead lifecycle planning, asset performance optimisation, change governance, capital investment planning and asset information management. You will use data-led decision-making and digital asset management to improve lifecycle costs, governance and engineering standards across the Group.

**Location:**
UAE or South Africa
  
**Travel:**
Approximately 6–12 times per year

**Role responsibilities**

As Group Operational Asset Lifecycle Manager, you will be responsible for:

* Developing Group lifecycle and governance strategies for power systems, shelters and associated infrastructure.
* Preparing and implementing long-term asset replacement, refurbishment and renewal plans.
* Establishing and governing asset refurbishment programmes across operating companies.
* Improving preventive, predictive and condition-based maintenance strategies to strengthen reliability and extend asset life.
* Optimising total cost of ownership, return on invested capital and asset utilisation through effective lifecycle investment decisions.
* Owning the Group Asset Change Governance process for engineering modifications, integrations, transfers, refurbishments, relocations and disposals.
* Establishing and improving the Group Asset Governance Framework, including asset ownership, approval authorities, engineering acceptance and retirement controls.
* Developing the annual maintenance CAPEX investment programme and prioritising work according to asset condition, criticality and operational risk.
* Monitoring and reporting asset health, reliability, utilisation and effectiveness, using analytics to identify improvement opportunities.
* Governing asset information standards and data quality across Group systems, including asset master data, serialisation, configuration records and technical documentation.

**Requirements for the role**

To succeed in the role, you will have:

* A degree in Engineering, Business, Asset Management or a related technical discipline.
* 7–10 years’ experience in telecommunications infrastructure or another asset-intensive industry.
* At least five years’ experience leading asset management, asset governance or engineering lifecycle management in a multi-site environment.
* Experience with enterprise asset management (EAM), lifecycle costing, asset master data governance and engineering change control.
* Experience in digital asset management, asset analytics and using data to inform lifecycle decisions.
* A background in telecommunications infrastructure, power systems or utilities.

**Desired skills and qualifications**

* ISO 55001 Asset Management qualification or experience applying its principles.
* IAM Certificate or Diploma.
* Certified Asset Management Assessor (CAMA) qualification.
* Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP) qualification.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 qualification.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt.

**Benefits**

* Competitive basic salary
* Discretionary bonus
* Health insurance
* Life insurance

Please submit your application within four weeks of the advert being published.

Helios Towers is committed to promoting equal opportunities in employment. You and all job applicants will receive equal treatment regardless of age, disability, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief.

Title: IT Director of Operations
Description:
**Job Summary**
Reporting to the VP of Infrastructure, the IT Director of Operations provides strategic and operational leadership for the organization's Service Desk, Field Services, IT Service Management, Change Control, Major Incident Management, Problem Management, service request fulfillment, and end-user support functions. This role is accountable for delivering reliable, responsive, secure, and consistent technology support to corporate offices, service centers, remote workers, and operating locations.
  
  
The Director establishes a customer-focused operating model, develops high-performing support teams, improves service quality through standardization and automation, and ensures operational processes produce measurable improvements in user experience, service availability, response time, resolution time, change success, and cost efficiency. The position partners closely with Infrastructure Engineering, Information Security, Enterprise Applications, Clinical Applications, Human Resources, Compliance, Finance, vendors, and business leaders, and serves as a senior leader during major incidents and high-risk changes.
  
  
**Duties & Responsibilities**

* Provide leadership, direction, and accountability for Service Desk, Field Services, IT Service Management, Change Control, Major Incident Management, Problem Management, and related operational support functions, including organizational design, workforce planning, recruiting, coaching, succession planning, performance management, and professional development.
* Develop and maintain a multi-year IT operations strategy and service improvement roadmap aligned with business growth, acquisitions, technology modernization, cybersecurity requirements, financial objectives, employee experience, and operational risk tolerance.
* Own the Service Desk operating model, including intake channels, call handling, ticket triage, prioritization, escalation, request fulfillment, knowledge management, shift coverage, quality assurance, customer communications, and service-level performance.
* Lead Field Services and deskside support across distributed locations, including onsite incident resolution, device deployment and recovery, site support, technology readiness for openings and relocations, executive support, inventory coordination, and local vendor management.
* Own IT service management practices and governance, including incident, request, major incident, problem, change, knowledge, service catalog, configuration, and continual improvement processes, using ITIL-aligned practices and clearly defined ownership, controls, and measures.
* Lead enterprise Change Control and the Change Advisory Board process. Establish risk and impact criteria, approval thresholds, peer and technical review requirements, testing expectations, implementation and rollback standards, maintenance-window governance, emergency change controls, post-implementation validation, and reporting.
* Serve as the senior operational leader for major technology incidents. Ensure rapid business-impact assessment, clear command and escalation structures, timely stakeholder communications, cross-team coordination, service restoration, executive updates, after-action reviews, root-cause analysis, and completion of corrective actions.
* Establish problem management practices that identify recurring incidents and service degradation, prioritize root-cause investigation, assign accountable owners, track known errors and workarounds, and verify that permanent corrective actions reduce repeat demand.
* Build and govern a usable service catalog, supported by defined services, request offerings, ownership, fulfillment workflows, service targets, knowledge articles, and customer-facing expectations.
* Improve employee technology experience through self-service, automation, shift-left support, remote-support tools, standardized knowledge, proactive communications, customer feedback, and reduction of avoidable contacts and repeat incidents.
* Partner with engineering, security, and application teams to establish effective operational handoffs, support readiness, monitoring and alert response, escalation paths, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria before new or changed services enter production.
* Ensure effective joiner, mover, and leaver support in coordination with Human Resources, Identity and Access Management, Security, and business leaders, including equipment, access requests, onboarding readiness, transfers, and timely recovery of company assets.
* Establish asset and endpoint support controls, including device inventory accuracy, stock and depot processes, warranty and repair coordination, refresh planning, secure disposal, loaner equipment, peripheral standards, and accountability for equipment assigned to users and locations.
* Define and report meaningful operational metrics, including contact volume, abandonment rate, speed to answer, first contact resolution, response and resolution attainment, mean time to restore, backlog age, reopen rate, escalation rate, customer satisfaction, change success rate, emergency change rate, incident recurrence, field dispatch performance, and cost per contact.
* Use performance data, customer feedback, quality reviews, trend analysis, and process audits to identify service gaps, prioritize improvements, and hold teams accountable for measurable outcomes rather than activity alone.
* Manage operating budgets, forecasts, staffing models, contracts, licensing, support tools, managed-service providers, hardware support partners, and vendor performance. Identify opportunities to reduce total cost of ownership without creating unacceptable service, security, compliance, or resilience risk.
* Lead operational due diligence and integration for acquisitions, divestitures, new locations, relocations, and major business initiatives, including support discovery, staffing impacts, device and asset planning, service onboarding, cutover support, communications, and stabilization.
* Ensure operational services comply with company policies, contractual requirements, data-protection obligations, records requirements, and healthcare-related security and privacy requirements, including HIPAA where applicable.
* Communicate service performance, customer-impacting risks, staffing needs, process maturity, investment priorities, and improvement progress clearly to technical teams, business leaders, executive leadership, auditors, and other stakeholders.
* Perform other job-related duties as assigned and provide hands-on operational leadership when business-critical conditions require it.

*The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. The employee may be asked to perform other job-related duties consistent with the role.*
**Job Requirements**
**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Management, Computer Science, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience.
* Eight or more years of progressive experience in IT service delivery, service desk, field services, or technology operations, including at least five years leading technical teams or managers in a complex, multi-site enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading Service Desk, Field Services, IT service management, change enablement, major incident management, problem management, and service improvement functions.
* Experience establishing service levels, operating procedures, quality controls, staffing models, escalation structures, knowledge management, service catalogs, and performance reporting.

* Experience managing operating budgets, strategic vendors, managed-service providers, and distributed support delivery. Experience in healthcare, home health, hospice, post-acute care, or another regulated industry is strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting acquisitions, site openings or relocations, large technology deployments, endpoint refreshes, organizational change, and critical-incident response is preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Strong working knowledge of ITIL-aligned incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, service catalog, major incident, configuration, and continual improvement practices.
* Strong knowledge of service desk and field support operations, including call and ticket workflows, prioritization, escalation, workforce planning, queue management, remote support, deskside support, asset handling, and customer communications.

Title: IT Operations Manager
Description:
**Job Description**

The Texas General Land Office is seeking a Manager VII (IT Operations Manager) within the Information Technology Services Department of the agency.

Performs highly advanced managerial work administering the daily operations and activities of the Information Technology Services (ITS) Cloud Operations function. The Cloud Operations Manager leads staff responsible for the agency's cloud, infrastructure, and technology operations and ensures services support GLO programs reliably, securely, and efficiently.

Work involves establishing goals, priorities, guidelines, procedures, and service standards; directing staff performance and development; coordinating daily operations and modernization initiatives; evaluating service performance and operational risk; developing and monitoring budget requests and expenditures; and recommending improvements. The position coordinates with ITS teams, security and governance partners, vendors, and business stakeholders to align services and resources with agency needs.

**Our Mission:**

The Texas General Land Office primarily serves the schoolchildren, veterans, and the environment of Texas. The agency does so by preserving our history, maximizing state revenue through innovative administration, and through the prudent stewardship of state lands and natural resources.

**What Your Contributions to the GLO Will be:**

* People Leadership & Team Management: Directly supervises and supports individual contributors by setting expectations, assigning and prioritizing work, monitoring performance, providing coaching and feedback, and supporting professional development. Builds a cohesive, accountable team environment; addresses performance issues; and ensures staff have the skills, tools, and resources needed to meet operational objectives.
* Operational Execution & Team Delivery: Executes established strategies and plans by coordinating day-to-day team activities, managing priorities and schedules, tracking progress against goals, and resolving operational issues. Ensures work is completed accurately, on time, and in alignment with agency policies, standards, and service expectations.
* Cloud Strategy & Infrastructure Modernization: Leads planning and modernization of the agency's cloud and infrastructure environments. Sets priorities for cloud readiness, migration, platform lifecycle, capacity, and technical debt reduction. Coordinates with technology teams and business stakeholders to align work with agency needs.
* Infrastructure Reliability, Continuity & Disaster Recovery: Oversees the reliability and availability of infrastructure services, including continuity and disaster recovery planning and testing. Directs work to improve backup, recovery, monitoring, capacity, and service resilience, and tracks recovery objectives for critical systems.
* Security, Risk & Compliance: Coordinates with security and governance partners to reduce operational risk and support compliance. Oversees implementation of approved controls for access management, secure configuration, network protection, logging, vulnerability remediation, and audit response across infrastructure services.
* Budget, Procurement & Vendor Oversight: Monitors budgets, procurement, contracts, and vendor performance for CloudOps services. Evaluates resource needs and technology options, monitors expenditures, and recommends investments that support agency priorities and operational efficiency.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, information systems, engineering, business administration, or a related field; relevant education and experience may be considered in combination.
* At least eight (8) years of progressively responsible experience in information technology operations, infrastructure, cloud services, systems administration, or a closely related field.
* At least three (3) years of experience supervising or leading technical staff, including assigning work, setting expectations, monitoring performance, and supporting staff development.
* Experience coordinating technology operations or modernization work across teams, assessing service risks, and communicating status and recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.
* Experience supporting infrastructure reliability, security controls, service continuity, or disaster recovery in an enterprise environment.

**Location Requirement:**
This position is based in Austin, TX. Candidates must be currently located in the Austin area or willing to relocate at their own expense. Relocation assistance is not provided.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Ten or more years of progressively responsible experience in IT operations, cloud or infrastructure services, or technology service delivery, including several years in a management role.
* Experience in a state agency, public-sector, or similarly regulated environment, including familiarity with security, audit, procurement, and records requirements.
* Experience with cloud adoption and migration, hybrid infrastructure, identity and access management, enterprise networking, backup and recovery, and monitoring or observability.
* Experience managing operating budgets, service contracts, vendors, and technology lifecycle planning.
* Experience with IT service management, change control, incident response, and service performance measures.

**Physical Requirements:**

This position requires the employee to primarily perform sedentary office work; however, mobility (moving around the worksite) is routinely required to carry out some duties. This position requires extensive computer, telephone and client/ customer contact and communication. It requires the ability to move and position oneself as needed for filing and similar routine office duties. The job also requires normal cognitive abilities requiring the ability to learn, recall, and apply certain practices and policies. It requires the stamina to maintain attention to detail despite interruptions. Ability to read printed materials and computer screens. The individual must be able to move and transport records, documents, boxes, and all related information and materials, weighing up to 20 pounds when required.

Every connected car, every industrial sensor, every IoT device that needs to talk to the cloud reliably and securely — that’s where we come in. * Track and help drive regulatory and carrier certification requirements (e.g., FCC, PTCRB, carrier certification) to support program milestones.

* Prepare and present program status reports, timelines, and risk assessments to internal leadership and customers.
* Identify and drive process improvements within the PMO to improve program predictability and delivery.

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of experience in program or project management, including 2+ years specifically managing hardware products through phase-gate NPI (EVT/DVT/PVT or equivalent).
* Demonstrated experience managing an engineered hardware product — such as a cellular/wireless module, networking device, or IoT end device — through a phase-gate development cycle to manufacturing release, from concept/design through qualification and into volume production.
* Experience working with contract manufacturers or external manufacturing partners.
* Strong understanding of phase-gate/stage-gate NPI processes (EVT/DVT/PVT or equivalent), BOM/ECO management, DFx (DFM/DFT/DFA), and manufacturing readiness gates.
* Excellent cross-functional coordination skills, with the ability to work across engineering, supply chain, quality, and manufacturing teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting program status to customers and leadership.
* Proficiency with program/project tracking tools (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet, Jira/Confluence, or similar) and standard office/productivity software.
* Experience in the cellular/IoT module, networking/telecom equipment, automotive electronics, or wireless communications industry.
* Familiarity with regulatory and carrier certification processes
* Experience with ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite) for BOM, inventory, and production tracking.
* Experience managing programs across multiple manufacturing sites or geographies.

**Our work environment is collaborative, and we offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, which includes medical/dental/vision, generous PTO and paid parental leave programs.**

Title: IT PMO Manager
Description:
**Job Overview:**

The
**Senior PMO Manager**
will establish and lead a fit-for-purpose Enterprise PMO that converts business demand into a transparent, prioritized and executable project portfolio. The role owns the operating model, governance, controls, tools and management information for Demand Management, Portfolio and Prioritization Management, Cost Management, Resource Management and project delivery assurance. Working across Albatha Group businesses, IT leadership, Finance, HR, Procurement and delivery partners, the role will provide decision-quality insight, strengthen accountability and optimize investment, capacity and benefits realization.

This is a hands-on leadership position for an experienced PMO practitioner who can design new processes from the ground up, embed adoption across diverse stakeholders, and progressively mature the PMO from project reporting to enterprise portfolio management.

**Key Accountabilities:**

PMO Setup, Operating Model and Governance

* Design and implement the Enterprise PMO charter, service catalogue, governance model, decision rights, RACI, policies, standards, stage gates and delivery lifecycle.
* Establish integrated PMO processes, templates, controls, calendars and forums covering idea intake through prioritization, approval, delivery, benefits tracking and closure.
* Create a pragmatic PMO maturity roadmap, baseline current capabilities and deliver prioritized improvements in 30, 60, 90 days and annual horizons.

Demand Management

* Create a single demand intake process and demand register for strategic initiatives, regulatory work, business requests, technology lifecycle needs and operational improvements.
* Define minimum data requirements including business problem, strategic alignment, sponsor, expected benefits, urgency, dependencies, high-level cost, capacity needs and risk.
* Introduce demand triage, qualification and routing with benefit targets, ensuring incomplete or low-value requests are challenged before entering the portfolio pipeline.
* Facilitate demand discovery with business and technology teams
* Monitor demand ageing, conversion, rejection and backlog health; provide transparent feedback to requestors

Portfolio and Prioritization Management

* Build and maintain a single source of truth for the project portfolio, including approved, proposed, paused, at risk and completed initiatives.
* evelop and administer a transparent scoring model using strategic alignment, value, risk/compliance, customer impact, urgency, feasibility, dependency and capacity criteria.
* Facilitate prioritization sessions; model scenarios and trade-offs within budget and resource constraints.
* Provide independent challenge and assurance at stage gates, ensuring continued investment is supported by evidence and agreed tolerances.

Cost and Investment Management

* Establish portfolio financial controls for business cases, annual planning, budget baselines, forecasts, actuals, commitments, accruals and estimate-at-completion.
* Partner with Finance, Procurement, project managers and vendors to reconcile project costs and improve the timeliness and accuracy of financial reporting.
* Monitor budget variance, burn rate, and financial risk; escalate exceptions and support corrective actions.
* Create investment views by strategic theme, business unit, platform and delivery status.
* Coordinate benefits baselining, ownership, measurement and post-implementation realization reporting.

Resource and Capacity Management

* Create a consolidated resource and skills inventory covering internal teams, contractors and strategic partners.
* Implement role-based capacity planning, allocation, demand forecasting and resource heatmaps across projects and operational priorities.
* Facilitate periodic resource reviews with functional leaders and delivery managers; maintain agreed allocations and forward-looking capacity forecasts.
* Define resource planning standards, utilization measures and data ownership while avoiding counterproductive activity-level timesheet administration.

Stakeholder and Team Management

* Lead, coach and develop PMO analysts, project coordinators and portfolio specialists; set objectives, quality standards and development plans.
* Build trusted relationships with Group and business-unit executives, sponsors, Finance, HR, Procurement, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity and delivery teams.
* Facilitate evidence-based decisions, constructively challenge optimistic assumptions and communicate difficult trade-offs with clarity.
* Manage PMO service quality and stakeholder satisfaction; drive adoption through communications, training and change management.

AI-Enabled PMO and Intelligent Automation

* Define and implement an AI-enabled PMO roadmap that applies generative AI, predictive analytics and workflow automation to demand intake, portfolio planning, reporting and governance.
* Use AI-assisted analysis to identify delivery risks, schedule slippage, cost anomalies, resource constraints, dependency conflicts and emerging portfolio trends, while retaining accountable human review.
* Introduce intelligent automation for project status consolidation, data-quality checks, meeting summaries, action tracking, RAID updates, executive reporting and portfolio insights.
* Build AI literacy within the PMO, coach project teams on effective use of approved AI tools, and measure adoption, efficiency gains, decision quality and realized value.

**Key Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline; a postgraduate qualification is advantageous.
* Strong knowledge of project, program and portfolio methods. PMP, PgMP, PfMP, PRINCE2, MSP, PMI OCP, MoP or equivalent certification is strongly preferred.
* Experience with IT financial management, business cases, CAPEX/OPEX, forecasting, benefits realization and vendor-commercial governance.
* Advanced proficiency in portfolio reporting and analytics using Power BI and Excel; practical experience with PPM and delivery tools such as Planview, ServiceNow SPM, Jira, Azure DevOps or Microsoft Project Online is advantageous.
* Exposure to SAP S/4HANA and large-scale ERP or digital transformation portfolios is advantageous.
* Excellent written and spoken English, presentation, facilitation, negotiation and conflict-resolution skills.

Title: Manager, Strategic Sourcing Capital Markets & Wealth Systems
Description:
Requisition ID: 272273
  
  
Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

  

Join Scotiabank at a pivotal time of transformation, where Procurement is driving strategic value and innovation. As the Bank accelerates its adoption of AI and digital capabilities, you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of sourcing within a global organization.

  

**The Role**

  

Help Scotiabank source the technologies shaping the future of banking.

  

Scotiabank's Procurement function is at a pivotal moment – driving strategic value, commercial discipline, and innovation as the Bank accelerates its digital and AI transformation. As Manager, Strategic Sourcing – covering business line software (e.g., Capital Markets & Wealth Systems) within Technology Sourcing – you'll lead high-impact sourcing strategies across some of the Bank's most complex and fastest-evolving technology domains.

  

You'll partner with Technology, Risk, Legal, Finance, and senior business leaders to unlock enterprise value across SaaS, cloud & hyperscalers, infrastructure, software, networks. This is a role for a commercially sharp procurement leader who thrives on solving complex problems, influencing spend decisions, and delivering measurable outcomes beyond savings.

  

**Is this role right for you? In this role you will:**

  

* Lead end-to-end sourcing for enterprise technology categories from opportunity assessment and market intelligence through negotiation, contracting, and benefits realization.
* Build category strategies across SaaS, cloud, software licensing, infrastructure, and telecom anchored in spend analysis, supplier capability, and market trends.
* Design and run competitive events (RFI/RFP/RFQ), including evaluation frameworks, shortlisting, negotiation strategy, and award recommendations.
* Negotiate commercially strong agreements balancing TCO, consumption vs. subscription models, service levels, flexibility, exit rights, and long-term business needs.
* Optimize the existing portfolio: identify renewal, consolidation, license rationalization, and vendor rationalization opportunities.
* Partner with Third-Party Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Finance to ensure alignment with policy, regulatory expectations, and the Bank's risk appetite.
* Manage strategic supplier relationships – performance, escalations, executive engagement, and continuous improvement.
* Track and report pipeline, benefits, milestones, and commitments with discipline and transparency.
* Act as a trusted advisor to Technology stakeholders and an escalation point on commercial and supplier matters with enterprise impact.
* Understand how the Bank’s risk appetite, risk culture and risk policies & processes should be considered/adhered to in day-to-day activities and decisions.
* Create an environment in which his/her team pursues effective and efficient operations of his/her respective areas, while ensuring the adequacy, adherence to and effectiveness of day-to-day business controls to meet obligations with respect to operational risk, regulatory compliance risk, AML/ATF risk and conduct risk, including but not limited to responsibilities under the Operational Risk Management Framework, Regulatory Compliance Risk Management Framework, AML/ATF Global Handbook and the Guidelines for Business Conduct.
* Build a high-performance environment and implements a people strategy that attracts, retains, develops and motivates their team by fostering an inclusive work environment and using a coaching mindset and behaviors; communicating vison/values/business strategy; and, managing succession and development planning for the team.

  

**Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We’d love to work with you if you have:**

  

* MBA or Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or related; CPSM, CIPS, or equivalent is preferred.
* 3–5+ years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing, category management, or supplier management — with meaningful experience across technology categories and/or a specific business: ie: capital markets, wealth management, or retail banking.
* Deep familiarity with SaaS pricing models, cloud consumption economics, software licensing (perpetual, subscription, token-based), and MSA/SOW constructs.
* Strong commercial acumen and negotiation capability, backed by data-driven recommendations.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders (VP/SVP) and lead cross-functional teams through ambiguity.
* Hands-on with spend analytics, supplier segmentation, TCO modelling, and benchmarking .
* Understanding of third-party risk and regulatory expectations in financial services (or another regulated environment) is an asset.
* Familiarity with e-sourcing, CLM, and supplier management platforms.

  

**What’s in it for you?**

  

* A rewarding career path with diverse opportunities for professional development
* An organization committed to making a difference in our communities – for you and our customers.
* A competitive rewards program includes annual bonus, flexible vacation, personal and sick days, and comprehensive benefits that start on your first day.
* Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employees to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.
* Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences every individual brings to the Bank and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.

  

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto
  
  
Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.
  
  
At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. If you require accommodation (including, but not limited to, an accessible interview site, alternate format documents, ASL Interpreter, or Assistive Technology) during the recruitment and selection process, please let our Recruitment team know. Candidates must apply directly online to be considered for this role. We thank all applicants for their interest in a career at Scotiabank; however, only those candidates who are selected for an interview will be contacted.

Title: Director of Technical Operations
Description:
**Department:**
IT Group
  
  
**Location:**
Clackamas
  
  
****Description****
At Pacific Seafood, we do more than just provide the world with the healthiest proteins on the planet. We are a family-owned, excellence-driven organization committed to being the brand of choice in the marketplace and the employer of choice in the community. We believe in servant leadership, investing in our team members’ personal and professional growth, and rewarding performance. We live by the core values of our Diamond Philosophy: Teamwork, Productivity, Quality, and Excellence—which means consistently doing your best and
*always*
striving to do better.
  
  
****Summary:****
We are seeking a dynamic, solutions-oriented
**Director of Technology Operations**
to lead, scale, and optimize IT operations for our enterprise. Serving as a strategic partner to leadership and business unit heads across geographies, this role is accountable for the reliability, agility, and continuous evolution of our enterprise technology ecosystem.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a transformative, hands-on leader who blends deep technical fluency with strong financial stewardship and operational maturity. Rather than introducing rigid bureaucracy, this leader takes a pragmatic, evolutionary approach—fine-tuning existing workflows, aligning IT service delivery with measurable business outcomes, and fostering an empowering, "Best in Class" culture across Service Desk, Project Management Office (PMO), Infrastructure, and Enterprise Applications.
  
  
Because our team members are our greatest asset and strength, this role directly assesses the VP’s direct reports and the next level of leaders, identifies strengths and gaps, and ensures each leader has a practical development plan. The Director also evaluates reporting relationships, spans of control, role clarity, and succession depth, and uses a working knowledge of income statements and balance sheets to connect people decisions to business results.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**1. Enterprise IT Service Delivery & Service Desk Operations**

* Support Leadership: Direct the strategy and daily execution of end-user support, including the IT Service Desk, Desktop Support, Field Services, Depot/Procurement, and VIP/Executive Support across multiple time zones.
* SLA & Throughput Excellence: Establish, monitor, and enforce aggressive Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to ensure consistent, predictable service throughput—even during critical end-of-month, end-of-quarter, or high-volume operational periods.
* End-to-End Lifecycle Management: Oversee the complete IT lifecycle of internal and customer-facing systems, including enterprise workstations, telephony, infrastructure, and specialized operational/manufacturing hardware.
* Operational Readiness & Business Continuity: Lead contingency planning, risk surfacing, and operational readiness initiatives to protect business continuity and minimize disruptions during organizational transitions or major system cutovers.

**2. ITSM, ITIL Frameworks & IT Governance**

* ITSM & ITIL Maturity: Own, design, and continuously optimize core ITIL processes—including Incident, Problem, Request, Change, Escalation, and Knowledge Management—within enterprise platforms.
* IT Intake & Demand Management: Architect and govern a centralized IT Intake process to evaluate, prioritize, and route incoming business requests, ensuring resource allocation aligns with strategic corporate objectives and operational capacity.
* Enterprise Governance & Compliance: Establish pragmatic IT governance models, internal controls, and compliance frameworks that safeguard enterprise data and infrastructure without impeding business agility.
* Knowledge & Self-Service Enablement: Drive continuous improvement in knowledge base creation, documentation standards, and automated self-service tools to empower end-users and accelerate first-contact resolution.

**3. Project Management Office (PMO) & Digital Transformation**

* PMO Leadership & Tollgate Governance: Develop, deploy, and oversee formalized project management methodologies and tools. Serve as the executive tollgate for technology initiatives to ensure requirements are rigorously defined, scoped, and aligned with strategic goals.
* Enterprise System Implementations: Lead cross-functional execution for major digital transformation initiatives, including ERP migrations, CRM rollouts, and M&A technology integrations.
* AI & Automation Readiness: Champion the pragmatic adoption of emerging technologies and AI-driven workflows across IT operations to automate routine tasks, enhance reporting accuracy, and elevate enterprise productivity.

**4. Continuous Improvement & Lean Operations**

* Lean Six Sigma Execution: Embed Lean and Continuous Improvement methodologies into daily IT operations to eliminate waste, reduce turnaround times, and streamline cross-departmental workflows.
* Root Cause & Corrective Action: Partner closely with all IT Operations teams on deep failure-mode analysis and root-cause corrective actions to permanently resolve recurring technical issues and business impacts.
* Asset & Inventory Optimization: Reframe IT hardware, spare parts, and demo/recon pools as actively managed operational assets—optimizing space utilization, procurement costing, redistribution, and lifecycle disposition.

**5. Customer Satisfaction & Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Customer-Centric Culture: Champion an unwavering focus on internal and external customer satisfaction, transforming IT from a transactional support function into a proactive, trusted business enabler.
* Executive & Departmental Alignment: Foster transparent, collaborative partnerships with Finance, Manufacturing, Distribution, Quality, Engineering, and Sales leadership to ensure technology roadmaps directly support revenue and operational goals.
* Voice of the Customer: Implement regular satisfaction tracking, feedback loops, and executive business reviews to measure stakeholder sentiment and drive targeted service enhancements.

**6. Financial Stewardship & Resource Optimization**

* Multi-Million-Dollar P&L Management: Develop, justify, and manage a $15M–$30M+ IT operations budget, maintaining strict fiscal discipline across OPEX, CAPEX, vendor contracts, and software licensing.
* Data-Driven Economics: Apply rigorous cost-benefit and repair-versus-replace analyses to hardware maintenance, vendor agreements, and service models, identifying opportunities to reduce operational costs while improving service quality.
* Vendor & Outsourced Partner Management: Negotiate and manage contracts with third-party vendors, hardware suppliers, and managed service providers to ensure accountability and maximum return on investment.

**7. Talent Development & Organizational Leadership**

* Inspirational People Leadership: Lead, mentor, and coach a diverse, geographically dispersed organization of managers, engineers, analysts, and technicians.
* Cross-Training & Team Resilience: Eliminate single-point dependencies by building structured cross-training programs, clear career pathways, and flexible skill coverage across teams.
* High-Accountability & Morale: Cultivate a high-morale, low-turnover environment rooted in psychological safety, diversity, equity, and inclusion, while holding staff to clear performance standards through active coaching and accountability.

****Required:****
**What you bring to Pacific Seafood**

* Executive or Senior Leadership Track Record: 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in IT Operations, Service Delivery, or Technical Operations, including 5+ years at the Director or Senior level within a complex, multi-site, or enterprise environment.
* Proven Operational Impact: Demonstrated history of scaling support teams, managing multi-million-dollar budgets, and delivering measurable reductions in operational costs and ticket turnaround times.
* Enterprise Transformation: Hands-on experience leading large-scale ERP/CRM transitions, ITIL/ITSM framework implementations, and post-M&A systems integration.
* Cross-Industry Fluency: Strong operational understanding of corporate IT alongside manufacturing, distribution, engineering, or field-service environments.

**Education & Certifications**

* Education: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related technical discipline. Preferred; advanced degrees, e.g., Master of Business Administration (MBA)

**Certifications, not required, but highly desired:**

* ITIL Certification
* Lean Six Sigma Certification
* Project Management Professional or active PMI affiliation strongly preferred.
