* Maintain complete knowledge of hotel and residence services, room types and layouts, rates, packages, promotions, occupancy, arrivals and departures, pickup, availability and scheduled group activities.
* Oversee departmental rosters and Manager on Duty schedules in line with staffing guidelines and labour forecasts, adjusting coverage to business demand.
* Coordinate Front Office, Housekeeping, Royal Service and related teams to deliver timely room readiness, accurate room status, smooth arrivals and departures, and effective handling of guest requests.
* Anticipate sell-out and overbooking situations, coordinate alternative accommodation when required, and ensure affected guests receive appropriate communication and follow-up under hotel policy.
* Review out-of-order and out-of-service rooms daily with Engineering and Housekeeping, track defects and work orders, and confirm completion dates and readiness before returning rooms to inventory.

**Housekeeping & Laundry**

* Set and enforce cleaning, presentation and inspection standards for guestrooms, suites, villas, hotel-managed residences and all assigned public and back-of-house areas, including washrooms and leisure areas.
* Conduct regular inspections with the Director of Housekeeping, review room and public-area audit results, and ensure corrective actions are completed and checked.
* Oversee daily cleaning, turndown, deep cleaning and periodic maintenance programmes, coordinating access and timing with Front Office, residences services and Engineering.
* Approve departmental staffing plans and monitor productivity, attendance, overtime and casual or outsourced labour against approved budgets and required service standards.
* Control linen, uniforms, guest supplies, cleaning chemicals and amenities through agreed stock levels, secure stores, accurate inventories, controlled issuance and regular consumption reviews.
* Oversee Laundry quality, turnaround times, equipment care and outsourced service performance; investigate losses, damage, excessive consumption and recurring service failures.
* Ensure safe cleaning practices, appropriate chemical handling, pest-control coordination, lost-property procedures and respect for guest and resident privacy and property.

**Service Quality And Guest Experience**

* Work closely with Guest Experience and Butler leadership to anticipate preferences, coordinate personalised service and resolve complaints promptly, with clear follow-up and corrective action.
* Develop and enforce SOPs, review guest feedback and TrustYou results, and lead action plans for LQA, Forbes service standards and other applicable quality audits.
* Tour the property regularly, act as a Raffles brand ambassador and introduce relevant best practices that improve service consistency and operational efficiency.

**Residences operations and resident relations**

* Lead the delivery of hotel-managed residences services within the agreed operating scope, ensuring that service commitments, responsibilities and escalation routes are documented and understood.
* Serve as the senior operational contact for individual residence owners and residents, maintain regular communication and manage expectations with discretion and professionalism.
* Coordinate resident onboarding, arrivals, planned absences, departures and move-in or move-out arrangements with relevant hotel teams and appointed property representatives.
* Maintain accurate records of authorised occupants, contact details, preferences, contracted services and access permissions, with appropriate confidentiality and controlled access to information.
* Oversee residence cleaning arrangements, service schedules, inspections and optional services; clearly communicate agreed inclusions, additional charges and access requirements.
* Ensure resident requests and complaints are logged, assigned and tracked through to closure, with response and resolution targets, updates and escalation for overdue or recurring issues.
* Coordinate maintenance and preventive works with Engineering, monitor progress and communicate disruption and completion arrangements to residents; escalate unresolved defects to the Hotel Manager.
* Work with Security and relevant teams on authorised access, contractor visits, key control, emergency arrangements and protection of resident privacy and belongings.
* Monitor residential service providers within the role's remit, review service quality and coordinate matters affecting agreed common areas with the appointed property-management representatives.
* Review residence service arrangements and propose operational improvements that protect service quality and profitability; ensure approved changes are communicated clearly and applied in line with the relevant service agreements.

**Financial management and asset care**

* Prepare annual operating expense budgets and monthly, quarterly and yearly expense forecasts for the Rooms Division and residences services, using approved business forecasts; monitor profitability, explain cost variances and implement corrective actions.
* Review departmental profitability, occupancy, payroll, cost per occupied room, residence service costs, accruals and operating expenses, including uniforms, linen, supplies and amenities.
* Align staffing, supplies and service delivery with approved occupancy and business forecasts, working with Finance and relevant departments to protect profitability and maintain service standards.
* Define and monitor the allocation of shared staff, supplies and service costs between hotel and residences activities with Finance, and ensure residence service charges are supported and recorded accurately.
* Coordinate billing and payment follow-up for approved residential services with Finance; investigate discrepancies and ensure concessions or changes to charges follow delegated approval limits.
* Prepare annual capital expenditure proposals, prioritise replacement and refurbishment needs, and coordinate preventive care and defect reporting to protect rooms, residences and divisional assets.
* Review outsourced service requirements, supplier performance and costs with Procurement and Finance, ensuring commitments remain within approved budgets and authority.
* Provide the Hotel Manager with a monthly report on Rooms Division and residences profitability, Housekeeping quality, operating expenditure, guest and resident feedback, outstanding issues and corrective actions.

**People leadership**

* Lead and develop departmental managers, including the Director of Housekeeping, through coaching, training, clear objectives and regular performance feedback.
* Oversee recruitment, induction and succession planning with People and Culture, ensuring sufficient management capability across hotel and residences operations.
* Conduct annual and semi-annual management performance reviews, address performance and disciplinary matters under hotel policy, and recognise strong service delivery.
* Build an engaged, accountable and collaborative multicultural team; provide development opportunities and prepare suitable colleagues for progression.
* Ensure teams understand the different needs of hotel guests and long-term residents, including discretion, continuity of service, cultural sensitivities and ownership of requests.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum five years of luxury hotel experience in Rooms Division leadership, ideally within a resort or ultra-luxury brand, with a strong Front Office background.
* Proven experience overseeing housekeeping and laundry operations, including cleaning standards, staffing, productivity, inventories and cost control.
* Experience in branded residences, serviced residences or comparable owner and resident relations is strongly preferred.
* Ability to interpret operational service agreements, define service responsibilities and coordinate residential services with Finance, Engineering, Security and property representatives.

-------------------

Requisition ID: 1759846

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  

**The opportunity**

  

EY’s Canada Tax & Law Technology Group (CTTG) is seeking an experienced Associate Director / Senior Manager, Data Strategy & Data-Enabled Solutions to help define and scale our data strategy, capabilities, offerings, and solutions.

  

This is a strategic and hands-on role that will play a pivotal part in shaping how data is leveraged as a strategic asset across Tax & Law. The role will focus on identifying new opportunities, enabling data-driven insights and decision-making, developing new solutions and services, strengthening existing offerings, and enabling smarter and more scalable service delivery.

We are looking for a senior data professional who can move comfortably between strategy and execution. The successful candidate will be expected to help set direction while also working directly with data to explore opportunities, develop analyses, test hypotheses, prototype solutions, and evaluate new approaches and technologies. They will leverage CTTG development and delivery resources to help engineer, productionize, and scale solutions where needed.

  

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Partner with Tax & Law leadership to define and execute a data strategy that advances service delivery, managed services, growth, and new market offerings, including opportunities to connect data and insights across competencies and services.
* Identify, prioritize, and shape data-enabled opportunities, use cases, and solutions aligned with business priorities, client needs, and the long-term technology and platform strategy.

* Help strengthen data capability and maturity across service line by establishing reusable approaches, sharing leading practices, and helping teams understand how data can be more effectively leveraged.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

  

The successful candidate will bring a strong background in data strategy, analytics, data architecture, and hands-on solution development, and will operate as a connector between business leadership, data and technology teams, and solution delivery. They’ll combine the mindset of a strategist, problem solver, and builder: someone who can identify where data can create value, determine how to solve the problem, prove what is possible, and work with a broader team to turn successful ideas into scalable solutions, services, and market offerings.

**What we look for**

Title: Manager, Enterprise Data Platform & Governance
Company: Vacances Air Canada / Air Canada Vacations
Description:
WHO WE ARE
  
  
At Air Canada Vacations, we’re in the business of making dreams travel. That’s why we offer vacation packages, tours, cruises and more tailored to everyone’s individual needs. We like to say we have a vacation for every traveller because we do!
  
If you're someone who's passionate about exploring the world and sharing that enthusiasm with our customers, we'd love to welcome you to our team.
  
For over 50 years, Air Canada Vacations has been making travel easy, so come and join us in helping fellow Canadians create unforgettable memories wherever they go.
  
  
Don’t miss this opportunity! Submit your application by November 20, 2026 to be considered for this exciting opportunity.
  
  
The Manager, Enterprise Data Platform & Governance will lead the team responsible for building, operating, scaling, and securing ACV’s core data infrastructure. In this role, you will be the custodian of the company’s data assets, ensuring that data is seamlessly ingested, reliably transformed, robustly secured, and strictly governed.
  
  
This is a foundational infrastructure and operational leadership role reporting to head of IT. It serves as the bridge between IT and business units, making secure, high-quality data readily available to the enterprise while proactively aligning with evolving business needs.
  
  
The role combines platform leadership, governance authority, Implementation and evolutionary leadership, operational accountability and business enablement, ensuring that ACV’s data becomes a strategic asset.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  
Data Platform Management & Operations
  

* Ingestion & Architecture: Oversee the design and scaling of robust ETL/ELT data pipelines to ingest structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data from disparate sources.
* Transformation: Manage the development, standardization and optimization data transformation layers (raw/curated/sematic) within the data lake/warehouse to ensure the data is clean, performant, and structured for downstream use.
* Infrastructure & Operations: Own the integrity, availability, reliability and performance of the end-to-end enterprise data platform. Manage the cloud data infrastructure footprint and optimize computing/storage costs. Oversee incident management and be the escalation point.
* Continuous Improvement: Establish a run / grow / transform operating model, striving to improve data onboarding speed, time-to-insight, operating cost, data quality and trust.

Data Governance, Security, & Compliance
  

* Data Governance: Define, promote and enforce an enterprise data governance framework.
* Data Security: Partner with Information Security to implement strict access controls, data masking, table/row/column-level security, and encryption standards.
* Compliance: Ensure the data platform strictly complies with relevant regulations (e.g., GDPR, PIPEDA, Law 25, SOC2, PCI-DSS)
* Quality & Lineage: Establish automated data quality monitoring, alerting, and data lineage mapping to track data from source to target.
* Retention: Define and enforce data life cycle management policies to manage the retention and deletion of sensitive data.

**Data Strategy & Evangelization:**  

* Data Vision: Define and evolve ACV’s overarching enterprise data platform roadmap and strategy.
* Culture Champion: Act as a data evangelist, driving adoption across business units. Promote a data-driven culture and educate stakeholders on platform capabilities.
* Strategic Integration: Align enterprise data strategy with broader business transformation initiatives (CRM, CDP, reservation systems).

Team Leadership & Business Enablement
  

* People Management: Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of Data specialists, and Semantic Modelers, platform & operations roles
* Vendor Management: Manage internal and external (vendor / SI) resources.
* Internal SLA Management: Define and maintain Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for data availability and freshness for downstream data consumers.
* Interface Lead: Act as the primary interface between business and IT data teams. Intake, prioritize, and enable new data and analytics use cases from the business teams.
* Stewardship: Drive accountability and clarity between IT platform and business data ownership roles.
* Insight Driving: Proactively identify opportunities with business units to leverage data and improve revenue optimization, customer insights or operational efficiency.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TEAM
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field
* 10+ years in of data platform, or data analytics experience
* 5+ years of experience in years in leadership roles managing teams and delivery
* Microsoft Azure certifications (Azure Solutions Architect, Azure Data Engineer, or equivalent preferred)
* Strong ownership mindset with operational rigor
* Ability to influence vendors and senior business stakeholders
* Proven ability to bridge business and technical stakeholders
* Pragmatic decision making and problem solving
* Strong mentorship abilities
* Proven experience implementing data lake / lakehouse / data warehouse architectures
* Demonstrated ability to operate in lean IT organizations with partner led delivery models
* Experience with privacy laws, data security, governance, and compliance concepts (GDPR, Canadian privacy act, PCI-DSS, PII)
* Knowledge of agility principles.
* Bilingual French and English (verbal and written)

WHY WORK WITH US?
  
  

* Our team loves to travel, and we have one of the most generous employee travel programs in the industry. You’ll be eligible for travel privileges for yourself and other eligible persons once you’ve completed 6 months of service
* Hybrid work model: Corporate Mandate of 4 days in office (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday + 4th day of your choice) and 1 day from home

* We offer training and development tools to help unlock your full potential

Please note that these benefits apply to permanent, full-time employees.

Title: GIS Technician II - Utility Pole Program Lead
Description:
**Job Title:** GIS Technician II - Utility Pole Program Lead  
**Department:** Operations – Electric Utilities  
**Reports To:** Senior Survey Technician/Project Manager  
  
The GIS Technician II - Utility Pole Program Lead is responsible for managing, processing, and analyzing utility infrastructure data collected in the field for electric utility programs. This role supports pole inventory, joint-use audits, and distribution system mapping initiatives by transforming field-collected data into accurate datasets used for engineering design, asset management, and utility planning.  
  
Working closely with field crews and project managers, the GIS Technician II reviews incoming data for accuracy, coordinates data collection requirements, and processes information within platforms such as Katapult Pro, ESRI Field Maps, GIS systems, and related software tools.  
  
This position plays a critical role in ensuring utility infrastructure data is accurate, complete, and delivered in accordance with client standards.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**Field Data Coordination**

* Coordinate with field crews responsible for collecting pole inventory and utility infrastructure data.
* Develop and distribute field data collection packages and project instructions.
* Provide ongoing support to field personnel regarding data collection requirements and standards.
* Track project progress and field data submission status.

  
**Data Processing & Analysis**

* Process field data within Katapult Pro workflows including pole modeling, attachment identification, and field verification review.
* Validate field photos and measurements to ensure pole loading analysis requirements are met.

  
**Pole Inventory & Joint-Use Analysis**

* Review pole inventory data to confirm attachment ownership and pole characteristics.
* Analyze joint-use attachment data including telecommunications and cable infrastructure.
* Ensure collected data meets utility and engineering requirements for pole loading analysis and design.

**Software & Data Management**

* Manage and process data within industry platforms including:
  + Katapult Pro
  + ESRI Field Maps
  + GIS systems
  + CAD or mapping software as required
* Maintain organized project data repositories and ensure proper version control.

**Quality Assurance**

* Perform quality checks on incoming field data including photo documentation, GPS data, and asset attributes.
* Identify discrepancies or missing data and coordinate corrections with field crews.
* Ensure deliverables meet internal QC standards and client specifications.

  
**Project Coordination**

* Work closely with Project Managers to ensure project schedules and deliverables are met.
* Provide technical support to field crews collecting pole inventory data.
* Review incoming field data daily to identify missing attributes, incorrect measurements, or documentation gaps.
* Coordinate data corrections and re-collection when necessary.

  
**Qualifications**

* 2+ years experience processing utility data, GIS datasets, or pole inventory/joint-use programs.
* Experience supporting electric utility infrastructure projects preferred.
* Experience working with pole inventory or joint-use datasets highly preferred.
* An educational background in Land Surveying, Geomatics, or a related field is preferred.
* In-depth knowledge of surveying principles, techniques, and procedures.
* Problem solving and organizational skills are necessary.
* Strong communication and leadership abilities.

  
The GIS Technician II - Utility Pole Program Lead works in the office, providing technical support and leadership in surveying operations. This role involves data processing and collaboration with survey teams.  
  
This job description is intended to provide an overview of the responsibilities and qualifications for the GIS Technician II - Utility Pole Program Lead position. It is not an exhaustive list, and responsibilities may evolve to meet the changing needs of the organization.

Title: Director — BAU (Business-As-Usual), Payroll & SaaS Operations
Description:
**We're Hiring**

**Director — BAU (Business-As-Usual), Payroll & SaaS Operations**

*Re-engineer a global payroll operation: platform-led, offshore-first, automated, advisory.*

**Department:**
Payroll & SaaS

**Reports To:**
Initially the Group CEO; transitioning to the Business Unit Managing Director

**Location:**
Dubai, UAE (onsite preferred); hybrid considered for the right candidate. Travel required.

**About Mercans**

Mercans is a global workforce solutions company. Through technology-led payroll and SaaS services, we help organizations pay and manage their people across borders — compliantly and at scale. We are re-engineering how our global payroll operation runs, and this role leads that transformation.

**The Opportunity**

**This is a hands-on transformation role, not a back-office management one.**
We are looking for a leader to re-engineer Mercans' managed-payroll operation into a country-agnostic, offshore-first, product-led model — one where country knowledge lives in the platform and a central compliance center of excellence rather than in individuals, where automation and AI remove manual work, and where customers own and control their data and execution through self-service. The goal is a standardized run-cycle where any consultant can run any payroll anywhere, and an operation that partners with clients strategically rather than just processing their payroll.

**This is a hands-on, grass-roots role.**
You will learn the product deeply, get close to clients and the operation, resolve issues at the grass-root level, and lead by doing rather than delegating. You will report initially to the Group CEO and, in due course, to the Business Unit Managing Director.

**What You'll Own**

Your mission is to deliver a new operating model. You will:

1. **Build a country-agnostic operating model**
   — codify country rules and knowledge into the platform and a central compliance center of excellence, with one standardized run-cycle and no single-expert dependency.
2. **Build an offshore-first, fungible workforce**
   — cross-trained and “2-deep” in every country, delivering high productivity at scale.
3. **Put customers in control**
   — self-service and data ownership through the product, and a strategic, advisory relationship instead of support ping-pong.
4. **Automate relentlessly**
   — automate manual and country-variable steps, deploy AI as a knowledge layer, and use anomaly detection for visibility and quality.
5. **Run a leaner, focused delivery core**
   with disciplined quality and performance governance.
6. **Migrate all clients onto a single platform**
   to eliminate manual processes and enable people to move freely between clients.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Country-Agnostic, Platform-Led Operating Model**

* Relocate country knowledge out of individuals into the platform (codified rules, wage-type catalogs, formulas) and a central compliance center of excellence.
* Establish one standardized, country-agnostic run-cycle so any consultant can run any payroll anywhere, eliminating single-expert dependency.
* Migrate all clients onto a single platform to remove manual processes and enable free movement of people between clients.

**Offshore-First, Fungible Workforce**

* Make offshore the primary delivery model; cross-train so no client depends on a single person and every country is “2-deep.”
* Drive consultant productivity toward best-in-class levels at scale.

**Customer Experience, Self-Service & Data Ownership**

* Give customers ownership and control of their data, timelines, and execution through self-service.
* Shift client engagement from tactical execution to a strategic, advisory partnership, and drive changes to customer data toward zero for compliance.

**Automation & AI**

* Automate every manual and country-variable step (statutory reports, integrations, bank files, and more) using a deliberate map → automate → internalize approach.
* Deploy AI as an on-demand knowledge layer and anomaly-detection tooling for visibility and quality.

**Scope, Quality & Performance Governance**

* Run a leaner, focused managed-payroll delivery core with clear scope discipline.
* Stand up a business-assurance / QA function with process audits, SLA monitoring, a regional RAG on stability, scalability, and resilience, and a disciplined review, coaching, and appraisal cadence.

**How You'll Work — Hands-On & Grass-Roots**

* Learn the product and the operation first-hand, stay close to clients, and resolve issues at root cause rather than delegating.

**What You'll Bring**

* **Hands-on and grass-roots by nature —**
  you learn the product deeply, get close to clients and operations, and resolve issues at root-cause level rather than delegating.
* **Operating-model transformation —**
  proven design and delivery of a standardized, offshore-first, platform-led payroll/operations model that removes country-knowledge and single-expert dependency.
* **Automation and AI expertise —**
  process standardization, product adoption, automation, and applied AI (including agentic AI) to eliminate manual work.
* **A customer-advisory and self-service orientation —**
  you move clients to self-service and strategic partnership, delivering an unparalleled client experience.
* **Operations leadership at scale —**
  10+ years in global payroll outsourcing or SaaS operations, including multi-regional and offshore delivery leadership.
* **Technology and compliance fluency —**
  deep understanding of payroll/SaaS platforms, config-driven operations, integrations, and multi-country payroll compliance.
* **Leadership and resilience —**
  proven ability to coach teams, influence stakeholders at all levels, and stay composed under pressure.
* **Education —**
  Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations Management, or a related field; MBA preferred.

**What Success Looks Like**

In your first 12–18 months, success means:

* A standardized, country-agnostic run-cycle is live — any consultant can run any payroll anywhere, with no single-expert dependency.
* Delivery is offshore-first and “2-deep,” with strong consultant productivity.
* Customers self-serve and own their data, and the relationship is strategic and advisory — with excellent CSAT and retention.
* Manual and country-variable steps are automated, and clients are migrated onto a single platform.
* The delivery core is leaner and well-governed, with clean compliance and strong quality assurance.

**Why Mercans**

* Lead a genuine transformation of a global operation at the center of how the world pays its people.
* A real mandate to re-engineer the model — this is a role for a builder, not a caretaker.
* A global, fast-moving, technology-led environment with a direct line to senior leadership.
* Competitive compensation aligned to the seniority and impact of the role.

**How to Apply**

To apply, please submit your CV and a short note outlining an operation you have transformed through the Mercans careers portal. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

*Mercans is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce.*

Title: Senior Portfolio & Program Manager, Operational Technology & Controls
Description:
**Who are we?**
Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
  
  
A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
  
  
A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Senior Portfolio & Program Manager, Operational Technology & Controls is responsible for the integrated portfolio of Operational Technology & Engineering (OT&E) initiatives across controls, central monitoring, OT infrastructure, cybersecurity, data, and automation, ensuring programs are sequenced, governed, funded, and transitioned to operations as one connected roadmap rather than as separate projects.
  
  
This role combines disciplined portfolio and program management with proven, hands-on expertise in industrial controls and operational technology, including how controls systems integrate across critical facilities. It does not replace technical owners: engineering owns design, architecture, and engineering acceptance, while this role owns portfolio governance, integration, and transition to operations, and recommends sequencing, funding, and prioritization decisions to leadership. This position collaborates with engineering, operations, cybersecurity, IT, network, architecture, finance, procurement, vendors, system integrators, and regional teams across Global Operations Excellence to deliver key initiatives such as GMCC and central SCADA, and to strengthen the reliability, security, and supportability of Equinix’s critical facilities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Maintain a single, current view of all OT&E initiatives, including scope, funding, dependencies, risk, and expected value
* Run intake, scoring, and prioritization of new work against strategy, architectural standards, and capacity
* Lead quarterly and annual planning, roadmap development, and investment cases, partnering with Finance on forecasting and variance reporting
* Lead multi-team programs end to end, including integrated plans, critical paths, and phased global rollouts to site teams
* Define and enforce stage gates and readiness criteria (design, security review, pilot, production)
* Ensure programs conform to approved architecture and engineering standards, working closely with architecture and review boards
* Run program governance, including steering committees, status cadences, RAID logs, and decision records
* Creates clarity from complexity by turning strategy, competing priorities, and incomplete information into an executable roadmap
* Balances pace, cost, technical quality, cybersecurity, and long-term supportability in program decisions
* Translate technical detail into executive-ready narratives, dashboards, and decision requests
* Manage vendor and integrator engagements, including SOWs, deliverables, and performance
* Track benefits realization and report whether delivered programs achieved their intended outcomes.

**Qualifications**

* Typically, 10+ years in program or portfolio management, including 5+ years leading complex technical programs
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, technology, or a related field is desired.
* Nice to Have: PMP or PMI certification, P.Eng., Lean, or Agile certification; ITIL Foundation or ServiceNow experience
* Experience managing concurrent programs with shared dependencies and constrained resources
* Proven, hands-on expertise in industrial controls and operational technology within data centre or critical facilities environments
* Brings solid controls and OT expertise to engage engineers as a credible peer, challenge plans, and recognize material technical dependencies, while respecting engineering as the technical authority
* Technical knowledge of Building Management Systems (BMS), power monitoring, SCADA, telemetry, and OT/IT network segmentation, including how these systems integrate, sufficient to challenge estimates and technical plans and spot risk
* Strong financial acumen, including budget ownership and business case development
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive decisions without direct authority
* Experience with both stage-gate and agile delivery approaches
* Excellent facilitation, negotiation, written communication, and executive presentation skills, able to influence in a global, matrixed environment without direct authority

Title: Director of IT Services
Description:
**About Innovas**
At Innovas, we are transforming the way government innovates by delivering the mechanisms that turn ideas into action. We bring together the right people, processes, and technologies to accelerate progress where it matters most.
  
  
With a focus on impact over bureaucracy, collaboration over silos, and solutions over status quo, we we're built to act. Our team is made up of passionate problem-solvers, innovators, and experts who thrive on tackling meaningful challenges and delivering results. At Innovas, every role contributes to something bigger. Whether you’re supporting technology acquisition, improving processes, or enabling collaboration across organizations, your work helps move critical missions forward.
  
  
Join Innovas and help shape the future of government innovation.
  
  
**Why Work At Innovas**
****Work on problems that matter.****
At Innovas, your work directly supports innovation that shapes our nation’s future and delivers solutions with real-world impact.
  
  
****Be part of something built differently.****
Our teams are empowered to focus on solving problems, creating value, and exceeding expectations.
  
  
****Bring ideas to life.****
Work alongside passionate problem-solvers who thrive on tackling complex challenges and turning possibilities into progress.
  
  
****Grow alongside a team of experts.****
Our people bring diverse experiences from government, military, industry, technology, and entrepreneurship.
  
  
In this position, the hired individual will be part of a team supporting NSTXL activities.
  
  
The Director of IT Services will lead and strengthen the company’s technology operations as the organization grows. This leader will be accountable for reliable IT services, effective security practices, responsive employee support, and the performance of internal staff and external service providers. This is primarily a leadership role, with approximately 70% or more of the focus on directing staff and service providers. The Director must bring sufficient practical technical experience to evaluate recommendations, hold teams and vendors accountable, and contribute directly during critical incidents or other situations requiring additional technical support.
  
  
Reporting to the CTO, the Director will lead internal IT staff supported by outsourced partners across service desk operations, security, infrastructure, and business applications. They will partner across the business to support rapid growth, improve operational discipline, and strengthen security across the organization.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Partner with HR, Finance, Engineering, Marketing, Contracting and Program Management, Operations, and other business functions to understand their needs and ensure IT services support their work.
* Assess systems, services, processes, staffing, and vendor capabilities; develop and execute a prioritized improvement roadmap in partnership with the CTO.
* Make staffing, sourcing, technology, and investment decisions in partnership with the CTO, supported by clear business needs and financial considerations. Communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and investment needs to the CTO.
* Infrastructure Monitoring and Service Reliability
* Own the reliability, security, performance, and lifecycle management of IT infrastructure, cloud services, networks, connectivity, and endpoints.
* Establish and maintain internal monitoring capabilities that provide useful visibility into the availability, health, capacity, and performance of critical systems and services.
* Define service criticality, availability targets, support commitments, and escalation procedures with business stakeholders; measure uptime and SLA attainment and address performance gaps.
* Establish recovery time and data-loss objectives with business owners; maintain and test backup, restoration, and disaster recovery capabilities across SaaS, cloud, and internally operated systems.
* Partner with Engineering on production hosting, shared infrastructure, and local inference systems, establishing clear responsibilities for operation, security, monitoring, and recovery.

Security Governance and Incident Readiness
  
  

* Own IT security policies, risk management, compliance readiness, and control effectiveness in collaboration with team members, the CTO, and business stakeholders.
* Lead improvements supporting applicable CMMC requirements and NIST standards, including documentation, evidence collection, remediation, and management of exceptions.
* Maintain SIEM capabilities and SOC services with the MSSP, ensuring appropriate monitoring coverage, alert handling, escalation, and response.
* Own patching and vulnerability remediation outcomes, coordinating with the MSP on prioritization, testing, deployment, verification, and reporting.
* Oversee EDR, ZTNA, identity security, and other protective controls, ensuring effective coverage, configuration, and ongoing operation.
* Establish and maintain a standardized incident response plan and a coordinated computer security incident response team involving internal staff and relevant vendors.
* Conduct regular incident response exercises, validate readiness, lead the response to significant incidents, and ensure corrective actions are completed.

Enterprise Applications and Information Governance
  
  

* Lead the implementation, adoption, and effective operation of enterprise technology platforms and services through internal staff and service providers.
* Oversee identity providers, single sign-on, multifactor authentication, privileged access, and account lifecycle management.
* Own the technical administration and lifecycle of business applications, websites, and other enterprise systems, in partnership with the departments that use them.
* Identify opportunities to connect systems and improve workflows across departments, including application selection, integration, implementation, and ongoing improvement.
* Lead development and implementation of data classification and retention practices with business departments and external counsel.
* Direct the effective use of DLP, retention, legal holds, and eDiscovery capabilities, coordinating authorization, execution, and documentation with external counsel and designated business stakeholders.
* Partner closely with the Director of Operations to align technology strategy, systems, integrations, and automation with business needs, streamline workflows, improve operational efficiency, and drive enterprise modernization initiatives

Service Desk and Employee Technology
  
  

* Own internal service desk operations, including staffing, ticket intake, prioritization, request fulfillment, escalation, communication, and service quality.
* Improve ticketing, documentation, knowledge management, and support processes to provide consistent service and useful operational data.
* Use employee feedback, service metrics, and incident reviews to identify recurring problems and address their underlying causes.
* Ensure new hires receive equipment before their start date and have the access needed when they begin work.
* Partner with HR, hiring managers, and service providers to connect hiring workflows with device ordering, depot fulfillment, secure provisioning, and access preparation.
* Oversee corporate and personally owned devices used for company work, including enrollment, configuration, security, support, inventory, replacement, and retirement.
* Maintain effective transfer and offboarding processes, including timely access changes, account removal, and equipment recovery.
* Apply automation and AI-assisted tools to improve service speed, consistency, and staff effectiveness, with appropriate security controls and human oversight.
* Lead end-user training on business applications, effective use of technology, and security awareness to improve productivity, support adoption, and strengthen secure working practices.

Vendor Financial and Performance Management
  
  

* Manage MSP, MSSP, software, infrastructure, depot, and other technology providers, retaining clear internal accountability for service outcomes.
* Track vendor obligations against contracts, statements of work, service levels, and agreed deliverables; verify fulfillment and resolve gaps through documented corrective actions and escalation.
* Ensure Innovas retains appropriate administrative access, operational visibility, documentation, and continuity arrangements for vendor-managed services.
* Develop and execute the IT budget in partnership with the CTO, maintaining fiscal responsibility across procurement, licensing, renewals, projects, and operating costs.
* Maintain accurate hardware and software inventories, reconcile license entitlements and usage, and forecast requirements as the organization grows.
* Establish baselines and performance targets using recognized IT service management and security KPIs appropriate to the business.
* Produce monthly executive summaries and detailed operational reports covering service levels, monitoring, patching, backups, security, compliance, inventories, vendor performance, and spending.
* Review performance, risks, corrective actions, and investment needs monthly with the CTO and quarterly with the executive team.

Leadership and Team Development
  
  

* Lead and develop the IT and Security teams, establishing clear responsibilities, service expectations, and accountability across service desk operations, security, infrastructure, and business applications.
* Set departmental and individual goals and priorities in partnership with the CTO and other leaders, aligning staff capacity, vendor support, and improvement initiatives with business needs.
* Provide regular coaching, actionable feedback, and performance reviews; recognize contributions, address performance gaps, and support employee career development.
* Assess team capabilities and training needs; establish development and cross-training plans that strengthen technical skills, improve service delivery, and maintain coverage for critical IT functions.
* Recruit, onboard, and retain qualified IT professionals; promote knowledge transfer between internal staff and service providers so the organization maintains the expertise needed to operate its systems effectively.
* Develop, manage, and forecast the IT budget in partnership with the CTO, aligning staffing, training, technology investments, and vendor spending with approved priorities.
* Build a culture of responsive service, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement; delegate effectively while remaining accountable for team and service outcomes.

Supervisory Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead internal IT staff and coordinate outsourced partners across service desk operations, security, infrastructure, and business applications, with clear accountability for performance and service outcomes.
* Establish clear responsibilities, service expectations, and performance standards for internal staff and external providers.
* Recruit, develop, and retain experienced IT professionals through effective hiring, coaching, feedback, training, and performance management, aligning team capabilities and service capacity with organizational growth.

**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years of IT experience, including substantial practical experience across infrastructure, enterprise services, and IT operations.
* 7+ years of experience leading technical teams, including responsibility for staff performance, service delivery, and external service providers.
* Demonstrated success improving an established IT function, with measurable results in service quality, reliability, security, team effectiveness, or vendor performance.
* Experience leading internal service desk operations and managing services delivered through MSPs, MSSPs, and other partners.
* Experience owning security policies, risk remediation, incident response readiness, and compliance or audit preparation.
* Experience establishing service expectations, measuring uptime and SLA attainment, evaluating vendor obligations, and reporting performance to business leadership.
* Demonstrated financial discipline in budgeting, procurement, licensing, asset management, and vendor oversight.
* Strong communication, people leadership, and change management skills, supported by curiosity and a practical approach to solving business problems.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance.
* US Citizenship

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 15+ years of IT experience, including substantial practical experience across infrastructure, enterprise services, and IT operations.
* 10+ years of experience leading technical teams, including responsibility for staff performance, service delivery, and external service providers.
* Experience leading the adoption and effective use of Microsoft 365 G5 services and GCC High environments.
* Broad technical depth across cloud services, networking, identity, endpoints, enterprise applications, monitoring, and security, sufficient to evaluate technical work and contribute during significant incidents.
* Experience supporting government contracting organizations and CMMC or NIST-based security programs.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 security and information governance capabilities, including DLP, retention, legal holds, and eDiscovery, and the ability to direct their effective use.
* Experience improving IT operations and security maturity in a growing organization with a small internal staff and multiple outsourced partners.
* Experience with business application integration, HR-driven onboarding automation, depot services, and scalable device provisioning.
* Experience applying automation and AI-assisted capabilities to IT administration, service delivery, and employee support.
* Experience with Windows Server, Linux, cloud infrastructure, and network security.
* An active security clearance.

Work Location: Remote/
  
  
Travel: Up to six weeks per year
  
  
Travel requirements reflect an estimate and are subject to change dependent on business needs.
  
  
**Availability**
This position is not assigned to a scheduled on-call rotation. Critical incidents may require availability outside normal business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays. When a critical incident is escalated, the Director is expected to be available to lead the response within their area of responsibility, coordinate internal teams and external providers, support timely decisions and stakeholder communications, and help drive service restoration and incident resolution through closure in accordance with established incident response and escalation procedures.
  
  
**What We Offer**
We strive to be one of the best places to work in America. We offer competitive salaries and benefits that include:

* Vision Insurance: Fully covered

Join us at RealManage and be part of a thriving environment where growth, innovation, and supportive teamwork define our everyday operations.

Ranked among the top firms in the community management industry (#3 out of 5,000+), RealManage distinguishes itself by delivering exceptional solutions at competitive prices. We leverage cutting-edge cloud-based technologies and mobile apps, supported by industry-leading practices and a highly skilled workforce.

Our mission at RealManage is to offer comprehensive and innovative solutions that consistently surpass customer expectations. We prioritize transparency and visibility in all client interactions, continuously measuring our performance to achieve rapid improvement. We foster a workplace culture that promotes professionalism, encourages growth, and embraces diversity. By maintaining financial strength and focusing on continual innovation, we aim to lead the industry with pioneering advancements.

Join RealManage and contribute to a company dedicated to excellence, innovation, and delivering unparalleled service in community management.

RealManage is a values-based company with the following values as our guiding principles:

* **Integrity**: we always do the right thing.
* **Respect**: for our customers, employees and company; mutual respect is the cornerstone for every RealManage relationship.
* **Selflessness**: more than teamwork; we are part of something special and much larger than any of us.
* **Personal Relationships**: we are a professional services company; people do business with people they like.
* **Always Improving**: never satisfied, always learning and always growing; one is either getting worse or getting better...never staying the same. At RealManage, we are always getting better.

### 

### **Position Summary**

RealManage is seeking an experienced, highly organized, and results-driven **Facilities Manager** to oversee the maintenance, operation, safety, and overall condition of facilities and common areas within a homeowners association (HOA) community.

The Facilities Manager is responsible for managing daily facility operations, preventive maintenance programs, building systems, vendor relationships, capital improvement projects, and maintenance personnel. This position ensures that community buildings, amenities, equipment, and infrastructure are maintained to the highest standards of safety, functionality, cleanliness, and appearance.

The Facilities Manager works closely with the General Manager, HOA Board of Directors, community staff, contractors, and vendors to ensure efficient operations, effective resource management, and exceptional resident service.

The ideal candidate demonstrates strong technical knowledge, leadership abilities, financial accountability, and a proactive approach to facility maintenance while upholding the service standards of **The RM Way**.

### 

### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Facilities Operations and Maintenance**

* Oversee the daily maintenance and operation of community buildings, amenities, grounds, and common-area facilities.
* Ensure the proper functioning and upkeep of clubhouses, fitness centers, swimming pools, recreational facilities, meeting rooms, and other association-owned amenities.
* Develop, implement, and manage comprehensive preventive maintenance programs.
* Conduct routine inspections of facilities, equipment, and common areas to identify maintenance needs and potential safety hazards.
* Oversee repairs, renovations, and general facility improvements.
* Ensure maintenance requests and work orders are completed accurately and within established service expectations.

Title: Senior Program Manager, Strategy and Expansion, MEATR DSP Strategy, Planning and Expansion
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Customers want what they need in minutes, not days. Join Amazon's Last Mile team in the Middle East, Africa and Turkey to shape how our fastest delivery services, including Amazon Now and Amazon Rush, grow and run for customers, delivery associates, Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) and Amazon.  
  
As Senior Program Manager, you will own and lead the strategic programmes that set how our Speed last mile network runs across the region. At the core is flexible capacity: designing models that let DSP capacity move up and down with demand, setting how they fit into annual and weekly planning, and getting Operations, Finance, People teams and DSP partners behind them. Your portfolio may also cover partner commercials, compliance and training, and it will change as priorities change.  
  
Many problems won't arrive well defined. You will frame them, find the ones worth solving, align senior stakeholders on a path forward and build mechanisms that make the answers scale across countries. You will also help shape the team's wider strategy and roadmap.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Set the strategy: own the multi-year capacity and growth plan for Quick Commerce and Speed, and the region's input to annual planning.
* Plan capacity: within the regional plan, build short, mid and long range plans that match DSP and delivery associate supply to demand by hour, day and season.
* Build flexible capacity: design, launch and scale flexible models alongside the fixed DSP network, with the operating, commercial and compliance framework to run them.
* Grow the channel: launch new cities, stores and countries with capacity ready before go-live.
* Improve efficiency: raise utilisation and lower cost per delivery without moving cost onto DSPs or associates.
* Build partner economics: shape DSP commercial models with Finance that work at every volume level, and lead the trade-off decisions.
* Look after delivery associates: design fair, safe, compliant schedules and lead the regional response to labour rule changes.
* Align and lead change: bring Operations, Finance, People, Legal, Tech and DSPs behind one plan, and run readiness and approvals.
* Build mechanisms: set planning tool requirements with Tech, and the metrics, guardrails and reviews that run the channel, using automation and AI.
* Lead and write: influence senior leaders, mentor PMs and analysts, and write documents that drive decisions.

  
A day in the life  
You start with yesterday's Quick Commerce and Speed performance: where capacity matched demand, where routes ran short or associates sat idle, and what it cost. Mid-morning, you join the weekly planning review to agree where flexible capacity steps in next week. You then meet a DSP owner to test a new flexible model against their margin and their associates' hours. After lunch, you work with Finance and Legal on the case for scaling it to a second country. You end the day writing for senior leaders: what the pilot showed, what you recommend and what you need from them.  
  
About the team  
This is a new role reporting to the Senior Manager, Strategy and Expansion, MEATr DSP. Quick Commerce and Speed, including Amazon Now and Amazon Rush, are delivered by DSPs, and flexible capacity is a lead theme in the region's 2027 plan. You will own Speed capacity and flexible capacity programmes across the region, planning inside the regional capacity plan and working with the Network Optimisation team, who own rate cards. You will mentor PMs and analysts and write planning papers reviewed at Director and VP level.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

* Experience serving government, semi-government and private-sector clients, with a solid understanding of the Qatar business environment and regional consulting market.
* Experience managing CXO and department-head stakeholders, and leading multicultural, geographically distributed teams.

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* Professional certifications such as PMP/PgMP, and OEM certifications in UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Microsoft Power Platform, ARIS, Signavio or Celonis.
* Prior consulting experience in Qatar or the wider GCC, including large national transformation programs.
* Exposure to AI/GenAI-enabled automation use cases (e.g., intelligent document processing, AI agents).
* Proven experience in establishing or scaling BPM or automation practices, including Centers of Excellence (CoEs), is preferred.

* Promote a collaborative, accountable, and service-oriented PMO culture

* Build effective relationships with senior stakeholders, initiative owners, scope owners, and cross-functional teams

* Manage governance interactions with external agencies, consultants, and delivery partners where applicable
* Influence outcomes through evidence, structured analysis, and constructive challenge

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Engineering, Management, Marketing, Finance, or a related discipline

* Proven experience governing complex, multi-stakeholder portfolios and providing decision support to senior executives

**What You Will Do**

The Senior Manager, Fulfillment is responsible for managing day-to-day fulfillment execution and the customer service function to ensure Chomps' fulfillment network operates with accuracy, accountability, cost discipline, and scalability. This role translates established fulfillment priorities into clear operating routines and partner expectations across multiple distribution locations and 3PL partners. The ideal candidate brings strong fulfillment and 3PL management experience, understands order execution and customer service operations, and can turn complex operational priorities into practical processes, measurable results, and clear cross-functional communication.

**Role Expectations:** This role is expected to independently manage recurring fulfillment and customer service cadences, 3PL partner follow-up, KPI reporting, process controls, order exception management, and customer escalations. This role will also provide operational inputs, data analysis, customer and service insights, risk visibility, and execution support to leadership for network planning, budget development, partner governance, and material service, cost, compliance, or performance escalations.

**Responsibilities**

* **Fulfillment Network Operations & 3PL Management**
  + Support daily fulfillment operations across a growing multi-node distribution network, ensuring accurate order execution, capacity readiness, inventory flow, cost discipline, and consistent partner follow-through.
  + Manage weekly and monthly 3PL operating cadences, including partner meetings, KPI reviews, action-item tracking, QBR content preparation, performance follow-up, corrective action tracking, SLA monitoring, root-cause analysis, and readiness checkpoints.
  + Create, maintain, and continuously improve scalable SOPs, process controls, compliance requirements, and partner playbooks covering receiving, inventory control, order release, allocation, pick/pack/ship execution, exception management, and partner escalation paths, ensuring consistent execution across distribution nodes and customer channels.
  + Support fulfillment budget management by preparing invoice audits, spend analysis, productivity tracking, cost-per-order or cost-per-case reporting, and cost-reduction recommendations across the partner network.
* **Order Management & Allocation**
  + Manage order allocation across wholesale, retail, eCommerce, and other channels, balancing customer requirements, inventory availability, freight efficiency, production constraints, and service commitments.
  + Partner with Sales, Planning, Transportation, Finance, Customer Supply Chain, and Operations to execute customer requirements, manage order flow constraints, support inventory positioning decisions, and provide cost-to-serve inputs.
  + Drive proactive exception management for constrained inventory, customer allocation decisions, backorder risk, order holds, shipment readiness, and cross-functional communication.
* **Customer Service**

Oversee order status and shipment inquiries, the shared Customer Service inbox, and open-order review, catching PO issues (pricing errors, MOQ shortfalls, unapproved NetSuite POs, missed ship-by dates) before shipment.
  + Set the team's structure and standards, including priorities, ownership boundaries, escalation paths, channel coverage, backup plans, a shared tracker, and an SOP library. Define and monitor KPIs such as inbox response time, on-time weekly PO updates, PO issue resolution time, OTIF, and fill rate.
  + Serve as the primary supply chain point of contact for key customers, supporting business reviews and new-customer onboarding. Partner with Sales, Account Management, Planning, and Quality to resolve customer issues and deliver weekly PO status updates, cut and delay notices, post-allocation ETAs, key-account update files, and customer portal PO approvals.
  + Own processes for PO revisions, cancellations, and expedites; UDRs, shortages, damages, and returns; and chargebacks, deductions, and disputes, with clear ownership from intake through resolution. Manage retailer compliance (routing guides, vendor manuals, labeling mandates, ASN accuracy, EDI readiness, and appointment scheduling) to protect OTIF and minimize penalties.
  + Turn customer feedback and performance trends into process improvements, driving root-cause analysis and corrective action with 3PLs, carriers, and internal teams to reduce chargebacks, shorten PO-to-delivery cycle time, and manage cost-to-serve. Partner with Planning on retailer demand signals, In-Stock %, Weeks of Supply, and CPFR with key accounts.
* **Technology, Reporting & KPIs**
  + Support business-side execution of order management and fulfillment automation improvements, including reducing manual touches, improving order accuracy, strengthening exception workflows, supporting UAT, driving adoption, and increasing visibility across systems and 3PL partners.
  + Partner with Digital Transformation, Business Analytics, Sales Operations, and 3PL technology teams on NetSuite and partner-system improvements, including requirements, EDI/API integrations, order routing logic, reporting, issue tracking, and operational controls.
  + Own fulfillment scorecards and KPI reporting across service, cost, compliance, productivity, inventory flow, automation adoption, customer requirements, and partner performance, converting recurring issues into corrective action plans, partner follow-up, leadership-ready updates, and prioritized improvement recommendations.
  + Build ad hoc analyses that identify service risks, cost drivers, recurring partner issues, customer compliance exposure, inventory constraints, and opportunities for process improvement.
* **Launch Readiness**
  + Manage operational readiness for fulfillment, ensuring 3PL processes, documentation flows, lot traceability, shipment readiness, customer requirements, and exception management are defined and consistently executed.
  + Coordinate operational launch readiness for new customers, channels, facilities, lanes, and market launches by confirming people, processes, systems, inventory, documentation, partner capabilities, and escalation paths are aligned before go-live.
* **People & Cross-Functional Leadership**
  + Guide, coach, and develop customer service and fulfillment team members as applicable, and influence cross-functional stakeholders, by reinforcing clear ownership, operating rhythms, priorities, and expectations and building a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and disciplined follow-through.
  + Partner with cross-functional teams and external partners to align on execution priorities, resolve constraints, and support fulfillment growth.
  + Translate business growth priorities into practical execution plans, partner requirements, system needs, process controls, and team readiness actions.
  + Provide operational insights, data-backed recommendations, implementation support, and disciplined follow-through to support leadership decisions related to network planning, transportation, contracts, budgets, partner performance, and risk response.

**Who You Are**

* 7+ years of progressive experience in fulfillment, distribution planning, customer supply chain, logistics, or 3PL operations, including experience managing complex multi-node distribution networks and customer-facing operational process.
* Demonstrated ability to manage 3PL partners, operational KPIs, QBRs, corrective actions, SLA follow-up, and fulfillment performance across multiple facilities or business channels.
* Experience with ERP, WMS, TMS, EDI, API, and order management systems; NetSuite experience strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to identify, design, and implement automation or process improvement opportunities that improve order accuracy, reduce manual work, accelerate cycle times, and strengthen operational visibility.
* Highly analytical and comfortable using data to make recommendations on allocation, cost-to-serve, service risk, inventory positioning, readiness gaps, and partner performance.
* Strong understanding of fulfillment and supply chain metrics, including OTIF, fill rate, order cycle time, inventory accuracy, warehouse productivity, cost-per-order or cost-per-case, 3PL SLA performance, chargeback exposure, and capacity utilization.
* Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to influence Sales, Planning, Finance, Operations, Quality, Digital Transformation, and external partners without always having direct authority.

You have strong knowledge of SAP solutions and enterprise business processes, with the ability to evaluate how SAP capabilities address customer and mission needs. You will define and drive the roadmap for SAP capabilities in classified environments. You will evaluate new SAP offerings, translate mission needs into product priorities, and oversee security readiness, deployment, and lifecycle planning. You will lead Product Managers and work closely with product, engineering, architecture, security, compliance, operations, sales, and customer delivery teams to bring secure and mission-ready capabilities to customers. You will ensure customers receive solutions that are practical, secure, and aligned to operational requirements.

**Where you’ll Belong**

You will join a team focused on delivering SAP technology for national security and critical infrastructure missions. Your work will connect customer needs, product strategy, and secure operations in environments with unique requirements. You will collaborate with experienced leaders across SAP and government-focused teams while helping shape how SAP solutions reach highly secure customer environments.

*Budget and commercial management*

* Own event budgets, forecasts and operating costs, controlling spend and improving profitability

*Team leadership*

Title: Head of Enterprise Architecture
Description:
Medica is a nonprofit health plan with more than a million members that serves communities in Minnesota, Nebraska, Wisconsin, Missouri, and beyond. We deliver personalized health care experiences and partner closely with providers to ensure members are genuinely cared for.

We're a team that owns our work with accountability, makes data-driven decisions, embraces continuous learning, and celebrates collaboration — because success is a team sport. It's our mission to be there in the moments that matter most for our members and employees. Join us in creating a community of connected care, where coordinated, quality service is the norm and every member feels valued.

The Head of Enterprise Architecture (HEA) is responsible for establishing and leading Medica's enterprise architecture organization and ensuring Medica’s enterprise architecture aligns and enables, our business strategy, operating capabilities, technology, data, and processes, resulting in measurable and increasing enterprise value. Reporting directly to the Chief Information Officer, the HEA serves as a strategic advisor to the CIO and senior business and technology leaders and leads a multidisciplinary architecture organization spanning enterprise, business, security, data, integration, and related architecture disciplines. The HEA also leads an enterprise-wide Architecture Community of Practice to align architects and architecture-adjacent roles around common principles, standards, methods, patterns, and decision practices.

Business Architecture is a foundational discipline of the practice. The HEA ensures a clear understanding of enterprise business objectives, the current and required state of business capabilities, and the value-aligned roadmaps needed to move from current to target state. These roadmaps integrate changes across technology, data, processes, organization, skills, and operating models. The role partners closely with the Office of the CIO, Enterprise Transformation, Business Process Re-engineering, Product Ownership, Engineering, Data, Security, and business leadership to translate strategy into executable change.

The HEA will evolve Enterprise Architecture from a traditional, centralized governance model toward an enabling, embedded, and delivery-oriented practice. Architecture will engage earlier and more deeply in strategic and day-to-day delivery, using reusable standards, reference architectures, patterns, guardrails, and risk-based decision frameworks to accelerate sound decisions. The HEA will also advance AI-enabled architecture practices to automate routine documentation, analysis, standards validation, knowledge management, and governance activities so architects can focus on solving critical business problems, transformation, complex design decisions, and delivery enablement.

**Key Accountabilities**

**Structure and Advance Enterprise Architecture Practices**

* Establish and continuously evolve the enterprise architecture strategy, operating model, principles, standards, methods, and practices.
* Establish Business Architecture as the connective layer between enterprise strategy, transformation, product portfolios, business processes, organizational design, data, and technology.
* Ensure development and maintenance of enterprise business capability models; partner to assess current-state maturity and identify capability gaps, dependencies, duplication, and investment needs.
* Translate enterprise strategy and business objectives into target states, transition states, and value-aligned capability roadmaps integrating changes to people, process, technology, data, organization, skills, and operating models.
* Provide enterprise leaders with clear views of strategic dependencies, tradeoffs, sequencing, technical health, and investment implications.
* Ensure technology strategy is traceable to business strategy and capability requirements.

**Deliver Enterprise Transformation & Strategy through Architecture**

* Serve as a strategic architecture advisor to the CIO, executive leadership, Transformation, Product, and business leaders.
* Partner with Enterprise Transformation and Business Process Re-engineering to connect strategic objectives, transformation portfolios, and process redesign to required business-capability changes.
* Partner with Product Owners and Product Management to connect enterprise capability roadmaps with product strategies, investment priorities, and delivery roadmaps.
* Ensure architecture strategy reflects the operating, regulatory, data, and interoperability requirements of a healthcare organization, with particular emphasis on the health plan/payer environment.
* Provide architectural leadership for healthcare interoperability and industry standards, including X12 EDI, HL7 FHIR, USCDI, and other applicable healthcare information-exchange standards.
* Translate regulatory and interoperability requirements into enterprise capabilities and strategic roadmaps in partnership with Compliance, Legal, Security, Privacy, Product, Data, and business leaders.

**Architecture Enablement & Governance**

* Modernize the Architecture Review process from a primarily centralized approval mechanism into a risk-based architecture enablement model embedded earlier in strategy, discovery, design, and delivery.
* Establish reference architectures, reusable patterns, standards, guardrails, decision frameworks, and architecture decision records that increase delivery autonomy while maintaining enterprise alignment.
* Define clear decision rights across Enterprise Architecture, domain architecture, solution architecture, Engineering, Product, Security, Data, and related functions.
* Partner with engineering and technology leaders to evaluate and select strategic platforms, core technologies, architectural patterns, and engineering approaches.
* Guide modernization of core capabilities including Cloud, APIs, integration, data platforms, automation, AI, SaaS, and digital capabilities while reducing unnecessary complexity, duplication, and technical debt.
* Use AI and automation to improve architecture knowledge discovery, documentation, standards validation, impact analysis, dependency identification, and governance workflows, freeing architects for higher-value work.
* Measure architecture effectiveness through business outcomes, delivery enablement, reuse, simplification, risk reduction, technology health, and decision quality.

**Architecture Team Leadership**

* Lead, develop, and mentor a multidisciplinary architecture organization spanning enterprise, business, security, data, integration, and related architecture disciplines.
* Establish and lead an enterprise-wide Architecture Community of Practice encompassing architects and architecture-adjacent roles across centralized and distributed teams.
* Define common architecture principles, terminology, methods, artifacts, modeling approaches, standards, and expectations across the organization.
* Create mechanisms for knowledge sharing, reusable solutions, emerging practices, and lessons learned across the architecture community.
* Develop architecture talent, competency models, career paths, succession plans, and leadership capability across the enterprise.
* Build an architecture culture based on influence, transparency, collaboration, practical guidance, and accountability rather than centralized control.
* Operate effectively from executive strategy through delivery-level architecture, communicating complex business and technology concepts to technical and nontechnical audiences.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 15+ years of progressively responsible experience across enterprise technology, architecture, business transformation, engineering, or related disciplines; significant leadership experience building and leading enterprise or domain architecture functions in complex organizations.
* 5+ years of people management experience leading highly technical roles in direct, indirect, and contractor roles.
* Business capability modeling and capability-based planning; strategy-to-execution alignment; value-stream and operating-model analysis; enterprise transformation and roadmap development; architecture governance and operating models; modern cloud, API, integration, data, security, SaaS, automation, and AI architectures; healthcare interoperability; executive communication, facilitation, organizational change, stakeholder influence, and talent development

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline preferred.
* Experience managing vendor relationships.
* Healthcare payer / managed care experience strongly preferred; broader healthcare experience considered.
