Title: Senior Manager, JSOC & Threat Hunting
Description:
Questrade is on a mission to help Canadians to become much more financially successful and secure.

For nearly 30 years, Questrade Financial Group has been delivering on that mission through investing, banking, mortgages, and real estate. Together, we tilt finance in favour of ambitious Canadians, creating new ways for them to seize the financial future they deserve.

We're looking for people who are ready to enter their career inflection point. Mission-driven, exceptional folks that never settle. The work here is hard because the responsibility is real. If that's the standard you've been looking for, keep reading.

Req #4265

**The return on your career investment**

* Compensation and incentives built to reward the value you bring.
* RRSP matching of up to 6%.
* Health and wellness resources and programs, including $5,000 in mental health practitioner coverage.
* $5,000 in tuition subsidies for job-related courses, every year.
* 100% parental top-up, up to 26 weeks for birthing parents and 18 weeks for non-birthing parents.
* A hybrid environment, with at least three days in the office built for working together.
* Paid vacation, personal, and sick days.
* A community care day to give back to the causes you care about.

*This job posting is for an existing vacancy.*

**We're looking for our next Senior Manager, JSOC & Threat Hunting**

The Senior Manager, JSOC & Threat Hunting is a hands-on technical leader accountable for security monitoring, incident response, threat hunting and intelligence, detection and security engineering, vulnerability management and DevSecOps across Questrade Financial Group's regulated entities. She/he leads the Joint Security Operations Centre (JSOC) as a 24x7, multi-shift operation spanning three teams (SOC and Incident Response, Threat Operations and Engineering, and DevSecOps), owns the JSOC service catalogue, and remains directly involved in major incidents, complex investigations, detection design, SIEM optimization and security tooling decisions. This is not a coordination-only leadership role. The role operates in a dual regulatory environment covering CIRO regulated dealer and wealth entities and OSFI regulated federal financial institutions, and is the senior escalation point for cyber incident detection, containment and the incident inputs required for regulator reporting.

**The mandate**

In this role, you will:

* Lead the Joint Security Operations Centre as a highly technical, hands-on leader across three teams: SOC and Incident Response, Threat Operations and Engineering, and DevSecOps. Remain directly involved in complex investigations, high-severity incidents, detection design, SIEM optimization and security tooling decisions, and challenge technical assumptions rather than rely on tool-generated conclusions.
* Own and maintain the JSOC service catalogue across three service lines (SOC/IR, Threat Operations, and DevSecOps), with defined service levels, a named owner and a named backup for every service line.
* Run alert monitoring and response as a continuous, multi-shift operation across five countries, ensuring coverage, shift handover discipline and consistent investigation quality across regions and time zones.
* Own the incident management lifecycle end to end, including severity classification, escalation paths, playbooks, evidence handling and chain of custody, containment, remediation, recovery and lessons learned. Provide technical direction from triage through closure on major incidents and lead cross-functional coordination with engineering, infrastructure, cloud, identity, fraud, privacy, legal and business teams.
* Ensure incident detection, classification and evidence are sufficient to meet OSFI technology and cyber security incident reporting expectations, including the 24-hour initial notification, and CIRO cybersecurity incident reporting obligations. Label every incident to the correct entity and regime and provide timely, accurate inputs to the Global Security Office, Legal, Privacy and Compliance.
* Oversee the design, testing, tuning and lifecycle management of detection rules and alerts mapped to MITRE ATT&CK. Improve SIEM effectiveness by reducing noise and false positives, optimising queries and ensuring alerts are actionable, and maintain a measured view of detection coverage and known gaps.
* Develop and run a proactive threat hunting program covering employee-facing and client-facing threats, informed by threat intelligence, attacker behaviours, environmental risk and observed detection gaps. Convert hunt findings into durable detections and control improvements.
* Own CTI tooling configuration, alert set-up, monitoring and response, and feed intelligence into detection, hunting, vulnerability prioritisation and fraud use cases.
* Own enterprise vulnerability management and external attack surface management, including EASM configuration and inventory, prioritisation by exploitability and entity exposure, and remediation tracking with named owners and committed dates in partnership with technology owners.
* Provide technical leadership for Elastic Security, including log source onboarding, parsing and configuration, data ingestion, query development, dashboards, detection rules, integrations and platform optimisation. Ensure logging and telemetry across applications, APIs, endpoints, identity systems, networks, cloud platforms and third-party services provide the visibility required to detect and investigate activity.
* Own deployment, administration and lifecycle management of JSOC security solutions, including Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA, ZDX) and email security, and evaluate and improve tools, integrations and workflows on measurable operational value.
* Direct security and fraud research and development within the JSOC, including AI-assisted triage and automation, in line with enterprise AI governance requirements. Apply change control and independent review before any internally built tooling enters production, maintaining segregation between building a control and monitoring it.
* Lead the DevSecOps team in SAST and DAST configuration, application vulnerability management and application security advisory, prioritised by regulated-entity exposure. Partner with engineering and platform teams to integrate security controls and testing into CI/CD pipelines, investigate application-layer threats and strengthen detection across the software development lifecycle.
* Support integrity investigations for Compliance, HR, Fraud and Legal under evidence-handling standards, and partner with Enterprise Fraud on account takeover, abuse and fraud-adjacent detection and response affecting online financial services.
* Define and monitor operational metrics including detection coverage, alert quality, time to detect and respond, investigation outcomes, recurring incident patterns and control gaps, and prepare quarterly executive and Board committee reporting content for the Global Security Office.
* Participate in and facilitate incident simulations, technical tabletop exercises and post-incident reviews, ensuring lessons result in concrete improvements to controls, detections and response procedures.
* Hire, coach, develop and manage the JSOC leadership layer and, through them, the wider team. Raise the team's technical depth, set clear expectations for investigation quality and operational ownership, and manage span of control, shift staffing and succession so that no service line depends on a single person.
* Partner with Cyber Strategy, Risk and GRC, Offensive Security, Identity and Access Management, Enterprise Fraud, Enterprise Architecture, Cloud and Infrastructure, Privacy, Legal, Internal Audit and entity compliance officers. Provide evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF and regulator reviews covering detection and response controls.
* Review complex technical findings and communicate business impact, evidence and recommended actions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executive and Board committee audiences.
* Stay current with attacker techniques, application security risks, security operations practices, cloud-native security operations and technologies relevant to a Canadian regulated financial group.

**You're ready for this mandate if you have the following qualifications**

* 10+ years of relevant cybersecurity experience, including substantial experience in security operations, incident response, detection engineering or threat hunting, with 5+ years leading technical security professionals and at least 2 years leading managers or team leads.
* Strong hands-on incident response experience, including investigation, scoping, containment, remediation, recovery and post-incident analysis, with major incident leadership in a regulated financial services environment.
* Demonstrated experience running a 24x7 or follow-the-sun security operations function across multiple countries and shifts.
* Demonstrated experience conducting threat hunts and converting findings into durable detections or security improvements.
* Deep knowledge of SIEM operations, including alert development, query optimisation, data onboarding, false-positive reduction and detection coverage measurement.
* Strong practical experience with Elastic Security, Elasticsearch, Kibana, Elastic Query Language (EQL) and Kibana Query Language (KQL), or equivalent query and detection capabilities.
* Solid understanding of application security concepts, including common web and API attack techniques, secure development practices, vulnerability management and application-layer telemetry.
* Strong knowledge of endpoint, network, identity, cloud and application security data sources, and the ability to analyse logs, network activity, authentication events, endpoint telemetry and application behaviour without relying solely on tool-generated conclusions.
* Experience with MITRE ATT&CK and the Cyber Kill Chain, and with developing security automation, scripts, integrations or repeatable investigation workflows.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical risk clearly, make sound decisions in high-pressure situations and present to executive and Board committee audiences.
* A leadership style grounded in technical credibility, accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement, with proven ability to build a leadership layer and manage span of control across a geographically distributed team.
* Experience in a regulated financial services environment such as banking, brokerage, wealth management, payments or fintech.
* CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, GNFA, OSED, CPTS, Security+ or equivalent practical experience.
* Familiarity with OSFI B-13, B-10 and E-21, OSFI technology and cyber security incident reporting expectations and CIRO cybersecurity incident reporting obligations, or demonstrated ability to learn a new prudential regime quickly.
* Deep expertise with Zscaler products, including ZIA, ZPA, ZDX and related integrations and telemetry.
* Familiarity with CrowdStrike Falcon, Wiz, Aikido and cloud-native security operations in Google Cloud Platform or another major cloud provider.
* Experience integrating security controls and testing into CI/CD pipelines, and familiarity with SOAR platforms and AI-assisted triage and automation workflows.
* Experience investigating fraud, account takeover, abuse or other threats affecting online financial services.
* Experience with scripting or development in Python, JavaScript, Bash or another relevant language.

**Additional Information**

* Lead a globally distributed team operating a follow-the-sun model across Canada, Brazil, Armenia, Israel and Argentina, with shift-based SOC coverage (Shifts A, B and C) and flexible Eastern Time coverage.
* Working day anchored to the Toronto Eastern Time business day for executive, entity, auditor and regulator-facing engagement.
* Available for major incident escalation outside business hours, with a named deputy arrangement in place for planned absences so that incident command never depends on a single person.

The Senior Manager, Joy & Listening Strategy is responsible for leading PG&E’s enterprise Joy at Work listening, measurement, and improvement strategy to advance the coworker experience and drive achievement of the enterprise Joy at Work L1 metric. This role oversees the collection, analysis, and translation of coworker feedback into actionable insights, strategic priorities, and measurable improvements, with a particular focus on frontline coworkers and organizations with the greatest opportunity for improvement.

This role leads a team of analysts and program professionals and partners with functional area leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen accountability, accelerate improvement and embed data-informed decision-making into enterprise operating rhythms.
  
  
The role is hybrid working from your remote office and in-person at Oakland General Office, 1-2x weekly based on business needs.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
Lead the development and execution of PG&E’s enterprise Joy at Work listening and measurement strategy, establishing priorities, performance expectations and improvement opportunities that drive achievement of the enterprise L1 Joy at Work metric. Partner with functional areas to identify performance gaps, evaluate improvement plans, and accelerate progress toward enterprise targets. Oversee the enterprise listening ecosystem, including Joy at Work surveys, Joy Pulse, Joy Daily and other feedback mechanisms. Lead the integration of Joy insights and performance measures into enterprise operating rhythms, including Joy Councils, monthly operating reviews, leadership forums, and structured problem-solving. Establish clear performance expectations, escalation processes, and follow-up mechanisms to drive accountability and continuous improvement. Lead, coach, and develop a team of analysts and program professionals responsible for survey execution, data analytics, strategic insights, and program delivery. Partner with enterprise leaders, functional areas, and cross-functional teams to align priorities, strengthen execution and deliver measurable improvements in the coworker experience. Oversee complex and unique strategic planning projects and initiatives that are of highest visibility and impact. Create and implement long-term research and analytical strategies, ensuring effective execution to apply insights across product, marketing, customer, and integration strategies on a daily basis. Act as an advocate for coworkers to all areas of the Company. Lead identification of new and existing technologies and processes. Develop and manage budgets, across multiple funding sources and identify innovations and cost-reduction potential of new and existing technologies and processes and implement contract management process improvement.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
**Minimum:**  
Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Economics, Statistics, or equivalent experience. 6 years of experience in utilities, retail, financial services, consumer products, or telecommunications including supervisory/managerial experience. 4 years’ experience in customer strategy work in the utility, financial services, telecommunications, or consumer products sectors.

Strong experience in implementing and using customer qualitative/quantitative research methods, tools, and applications of statistical analysis. Proven track record in defining strategic objectives and setting metrics and performance measures. Experience in successfully managing vendor relationships. Experience developing and implementing customer experience tools, i.e., journey maps, service blueprints, etc. Experience applying Lean methodology. Competency in developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences. Ability to create graphics, maps, schematics, or diagrams to present information as needed to perform at the job level. Competency in making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems. Competency in adapting approach and demeanor in real time to match the shifting demands of different situations. Competency in building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. Knowledge of concepts, best practices, tools, techniques, and strategies related to intelligence data gathering, analysis, and decision-making as needed to perform at the job level.

Title: AIR FREIGHT PRICING AND OPERATIONS MANAGER
Description:
Air Freight Operations & Pricing Manager

**Company:** Unique Courier Cargo Services LLC  
**Location:** Dubai, UAE  
**Department:** Air Freight Operations & Pricing  
**Position Level:** Senior Management  
**Reports To:** Directors & Management

Job Overview

Unique Courier Cargo Services LLC is seeking a **highly experienced, commercially driven, and result-oriented Air Freight Operations & Pricing Manager** to take complete ownership of the company's air freight operations, pricing, airline relationships, and business development opportunities.

We are looking for a strong leader with extensive knowledge of international air freight, transshipment operations, airline pricing, and CMC (Cargo Mega Terminal) facilities and their potential business opportunities.

The selected candidate must be capable of independently managing the entire operations and pricing team, maintaining strong airline relationships, maximizing enquiry conversions, ensuring operational excellence, and taking full accountability for departmental performance.

**This is an ownership-driven leadership position, not merely an operational supervisory role.**

Key Responsibilities

**1. Complete Operations Management & Accountability**

* Take full responsibility for the day-to-day performance of the Air Freight Operations and Pricing Department.
* Lead, supervise, train, and guide the entire operations and pricing team.
* Ensure every customer enquiry is properly reviewed, priced, followed up, and converted wherever commercially feasible.
* Take complete accountability for all enquiries, quotations, bookings, shipment execution, and operational escalations.
* Establish clear responsibilities, productivity standards, and performance expectations for each team member.
* Ensure timely shipment execution, accurate documentation, regulatory compliance, and effective coordination with all stakeholders.
* Independently resolve operational challenges and implement preventive measures.

**2. Airline Relationships & Pricing Management**

* Maintain excellent working relationships with major airlines, GSAs, cargo terminals, and handling agents.
* Negotiate competitive freight rates, special rates, allotments, and commercial arrangements.
* Possess strong knowledge of airline networks, routing options, capacity availability, and international cargo regulations.
* Develop effective pricing strategies to improve both conversion rates and gross profitability.
* Build direct relationships with airline decision-makers to secure commercially advantageous opportunities.
* Continuously monitor market rates, competitor pricing, and airline developments.

**3. Transshipment & CMC Business Development**

* Demonstrate extensive knowledge of international cargo transshipment operations through Dubai and other major hubs.
* Identify and develop business opportunities involving CMC facilities, cargo consolidation, transit cargo, and cross-border freight movements.
* Develop commercially viable solutions for cargo movements through Dubai, including documentation, handling, routing, and regulatory requirements.
* Establish relationships with international freight forwarding agents and overseas business partners.
* Identify new trade lanes, airline partnerships, and transshipment business opportunities.
* Present practical business development proposals to management, including revenue potential, expected margins, operational requirements, and implementation plans.

**4. Enquiry Management & 95% Conversion Target**

* Drive the department toward a **target of 95% conversion of qualified, commercially viable enquiries**.
* Ensure 100% of enquiries are recorded, assigned, monitored, and followed up.
* Implement a structured quotation and follow-up system to minimize lost business.
* Analyze unsuccessful quotations and identify the reasons for lost business.
* Ensure quotations are competitive, accurate, profitable, and delivered within established turnaround times.
* Work closely with the Sales Department to convert enquiries into confirmed shipments.
* Take ownership of improving enquiry quality, quotation efficiency, customer retention, and shipment volumes.

**5. Weekly Management Reporting**

Submit a detailed weekly performance report to management covering:

* Total enquiries received, quotations submitted, and shipments confirmed.
* Enquiry conversion percentage and comparison against the 95% target.
* Total sales revenue and gross profit generated.
* Shipment volumes, chargeable weight, and major trade lanes.
* Lost enquiries, reasons for non-conversion, and corrective actions.
* Airline rate developments and negotiated commercial benefits.
* Individual team performance, productivity, and accountability.
* Operational issues, shipment delays, and resolutions.
* New business opportunities, particularly in transshipment and CMC operations.
* Action plan for the coming week with measurable targets.

The Manager must be able to **explain departmental performance, identify shortcomings, and present actionable solutions rather than merely report figures.**

**6. Leadership & Professional Representation**

* Represent the company professionally in meetings with airlines, customers, international agents, and business partners.
* Maintain excellent personal presentation, professional grooming, communication, and business etiquette.
* Demonstrate confidence, strong negotiation capabilities, commercial awareness, and sound decision-making.
* Conduct regular departmental performance meetings and ensure effective team coordination.
* Develop employees through training, mentoring, and practical operational guidance.
* Demonstrate leadership through ownership, discipline, accountability, and consistent performance.
* Act as the primary escalation point for air freight operational and pricing matters.

Candidate Requirements

* Minimum **8–10 years of relevant experience** in air freight forwarding, operations, and pricing, preferably within the UAE market.
* At least 3–5 years in a managerial or senior leadership position.
* Established professional relationships with airlines, GSAs, and air cargo handling agents in the UAE.
* Strong expertise in transshipment operations, Dubai air cargo facilities, CMC-related opportunities, and cargo handling procedures.
* Excellent knowledge of import, export, transit cargo, customs procedures, AWB documentation, and airline regulations.
* Working knowledge of IATA regulations, dangerous goods procedures, and international freight forwarding practices.
* Proven ability to negotiate competitive airline rates and develop profitable freight solutions.
* Demonstrated experience managing operational teams and improving enquiry conversion rates.
* Strong analytical, reporting, communication, and commercial negotiation skills.
* Excellent command of English, both written and spoken.
* Professional appearance, leadership presence, and ability to represent the company at senior-level meetings.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership, and deliver measurable results with minimal supervision.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)Performance AreaExpected TargetEnquiry accountability100% enquiries tracked and assignedEnquiry conversion95% of qualified, commercially viable enquiriesQuotation turnaroundWithin approved service-specific timelinesWeekly reporting100% on-time submissionOperational executionMinimum delays and avoidable errorsGross profitConsistent monthly growth against approved targetsAirline relationshipsCompetitive rates and measurable commercial improvementsTransshipment businessNew profitable opportunities and confirmed shipmentsTeam managementClear accountability, training, and continuous improvementCustomer satisfactionTimely resolutions and professional serviceManagement Expectations

The successful candidate will be expected to operate with the mindset of a **Department Head and Business Leader**, taking responsibility not only for completing shipments but also for building a highly efficient, profitable, and commercially competitive Air Freight Department.

Management expects someone who can independently identify problems, provide solutions, generate opportunities, develop the team, and deliver measurable improvements in operational performance and profitability.

**We are looking for a strong, decisive, hands-on leader who takes complete ownership of the department, builds lasting airline relationships, drives business growth, and is accountable for results.**

Title: Senior Manager, People & Culture
Description:
American Tall is a thriving e-commerce brand, dedicated to producing world-class quality clothing for tall men, and women, up to 7’1. Founded by a father and son duo in 2015, the business has grown to a level that seemed almost unimaginable just a few years ago and is now a leading brand in the tall community. The growth can be attributed to the excellent leadership team and family values that drive the business – respect, passion, support, and empowerment.

  

We believe the best ideas come from a diverse group of people. This is a special opportunity to join an innovative business with tremendous upside, and a work culture built on the foundation of respect, inclusiveness, and continued learning.

**The Role:**

  

We are looking for a strategic, hands-on, and forward-thinking **Senior Manager, People & Culture** to help shape the next chapter of American Tall.

Reporting to the Director of Business Operations, you will lead our People & Culture function, with an opportunity to take it well beyond traditional HR administration and employee support. We're looking for someone who sees the potential for HR to be a meaningful driver of business performance – helping us build stronger leaders, more effective teams, and better ways of working.

This is a role for a builder. Someone who enjoys creating programs, improving processes, challenging the status quo, and turning good ideas into reality. You will work closely with senior leadership and department heads, acting as a trusted advisor and sounding board on everything from organizational design and workforce planning to leadership development and employee performance.

We're also excited about the opportunity to modernize how HR operates. We want someone who is curious about AI and emerging technologies, and who sees the potential to use automation and AI agents to simplify processes and create more time for meaningful work.

You will have the opportunity to put your own stamp on the function, build programs that make a real difference, and influence how our organization grows. We're looking for someone with strong HR fundamentals, great people instincts, sound business judgment, and the drive to make things happen.

### **Job Duties & Responsibilities**

PEOPLE & CULTURE STRATEGY & BUSINESS PARTNERSHIP

* Partner with senior leadership to develop and execute a People & Culture strategy that supports the company's business objectives and long-term growth.

* Act as a trusted advisor and sounding board to department leaders, providing practical guidance on organizational challenges, people decisions, and team effectiveness.

* Partner with leaders on workforce planning, organizational design, role clarity, resource allocation, and succession planning.

* Proactively identify opportunities to improve organizational effectiveness, strengthen leadership capabilities, and get more out of our people and resources.

* Develop meaningful HR reporting and analytics that help leadership understand workforce trends, identify risks, and make better decisions.

HR PROGRAM DEVELOPMENT & LEADERSHIP

* Build, implement, and continuously improve HR programs and processes, including performance management, compensation and rewards, employee development, succession planning, and engagement.

* Lead the evolution of our performance management approach, helping managers establish clear expectations, provide meaningful feedback, and develop their teams.

* Coach and support leaders through people-related challenges, difficult conversations, performance concerns, and employee development.

* Partner with Finance and leadership on compensation structures, salary bands, merit reviews, bonus programs, and workforce budgeting, balancing market competitiveness with financial sustainability.

* Establish clear processes and governance around key HR programs to promote consistency, fairness, and accountability.

* Identify opportunities to improve employee retention, develop internal talent, and reduce unnecessary people-related costs.

EMPLOYEE EXPERIENCE & CULTURE

* Lead initiatives that strengthen employee engagement, collaboration, communication, and connection across the organization, including the American Tall Summit and the Social Committee.

* Gather and analyze employee feedback, identifying opportunities to improve the employee experience and translate insights into meaningful action.

* Partner with leaders to foster a culture of accountability, continuous learning, high performance, and employee empowerment.

* Oversee onboarding, employee development, career progression, and other initiatives that support the employee lifecycle.

* Serve as an approachable and trusted resource for employees, ensuring people-related matters are handled thoughtfully, fairly, and with discretion.

PEOPLE OPERATIONS, TECHNOLOGY & TEAM LEADERSHIP

* Oversee day-to-day HR operations, employee relations, HRIS administration, benefits, employee documentation, onboarding, offboarding, and compliance.

* Review existing HR processes and workflows, identifying opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve efficiency.

* Explore and implement AI tools and agents that help the team work smarter, improve service delivery, and free up capacity for more strategic priorities.

* Ensure HR policies, practices, and processes remain compliant with applicable employment legislation and workplace requirements.

* Manage relationships with external HR partners, employment counsel, benefits providers, and other service providers.

### **Experience, Education, & Designations**

* Post-secondary education in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

* CHRP or CHRL designation, or working towards designation, is considered an asset.

* 6+ years of progressive HR experience, including experience leading HR programs and initiatives.

* 3+ years of people leadership or team management experience.

* Demonstrated experience building and implementing HR programs, policies, processes, and systems.

* Experience partnering with senior leaders on organizational design, workforce planning, compensation, performance management, and employee development.

* Strong understanding of employment legislation, employee relations, and HR best practices.

* Experience with HRIS platforms, process automation, and HR reporting.

* A genuine interest in AI and emerging technologies, with hands-on experience using AI tools to improve workflows considered a strong asset.

* Experience in a growing, entrepreneurial, or e-commerce business is an asset.

### **Knowledge, Skills, & Attributes**

**Builder Mentality**: Enjoys creating, improving, and implementing programs and processes. Sees opportunities and takes ownership of bringing ideas to life.

**Business Acumen**: Understands how people, organizational structure, and HR practices influence business performance and financial outcomes.

**Strong People Instincts**: Approachable, personable, and emotionally intelligent. Builds trust and strong relationships with people at all levels of the organization.

**Strategic Thinker**: Comfortable looking beyond day-to-day HR needs, challenging existing practices, and bringing forward new ideas and perspectives.

**Innovative & Curious**: Excited about AI, automation, and technology, and eager to find better ways of working.

**Strong Communicator**: Articulate, thoughtful, and confident. Comfortable having difficult conversations and influencing decisions.

**Hands-On & Accountable**: Equally comfortable developing a strategy and rolling up their sleeves to get things done.

**Sound Judgment & Integrity**: Handles sensitive matters with discretion, fairness, and professionalism.

**Adaptable**: Thrives in a growing business where priorities evolve and there's always something new to tackle.

**Our Compensation Philosophy**

We are a meritocracy and believe in rewarding impact, accountability, and strong performance. Our compensation approach is designed to be fair, consistent, and aligned with the scope and responsibilities of each role, while supporting the attraction and retention of high-performers.

The typical hiring range for this position is $100,000 -$130,000 annually. Final compensation may vary based on job-related factors such as skills, experience, and demonstrated capabilities, as well as internal equity and total rewards considerations.

**Why Join Us?**

At American Tall, we take care of our employees and strive to create an environment where you can flourish. When you join our team, you'll enjoy a comprehensive range of benefits designed to support your personal and professional development.

**Healthy Lunch Program** (onsite only): Enjoy delicious and nutritious meals curated by our personal chef, promoting a healthy lifestyle. Meals are $2 a day and all proceeds go to charity. Vegan and gluten free options are available.

**Annual Performance Bonus:** Your hard work and dedication are rewarded with an annual bonus, reflecting your contributions to our success.

**RRSP Matching:** Plan for your future with our RRSP matching program, helping you build your retirement savings.

Title: Directeur principal ou directrice principal, Technologies, Stratégie et opérations
Description:
**Aperçu**
Chez KPMG au Canada, les employés sont appelés à mettre à profit leurs perspectives pour relever les plus grands défis du Canada. Ici, vous pouvez créer un élan qui dépasse notre organisation, développer des compétences de demain et prendre votre carrière en main, et ce, avec du soutien à chaque étape. Joignez-vous à un cabinet où votre carrière peut vraiment faire une différence.
  
  
La personne titulaire du poste de directeur ou directrice principal·e, Technologies, Stratégie et opérations collabore étroitement avec le directeur général, Architecture technologique et le directeur de la Technologie du STI. Elle traduit la stratégie, les priorités et les feuilles de route en activités coordonnées à l’échelle de l’équipe. Elle assure la coordination centrale de l’architecture technologique et veille à ce que les activités liées à l’architecture, à la mise en œuvre et aux opérations soient harmonisées et bien coordonnées et progressent efficacement. De plus, elle structure les priorités de la fonction, en assure la visibilité et en suit l’avancement, tout en respectant les responsabilités établies à l’égard de la stratégie technologique, des décisions relatives à l’architecture et de la gouvernance officielle des projets et des programmes.
  
  
**Ce que vous ferez**

* Soutenir la direction de l’architecture technologique dans la mise en œuvre des stratégies, des priorités et des feuilles de route établies en les traduisant en activités et jalons, et en définissant clairement les dépendances et les responsabilités à l’échelle de la fonction
* Maintenir une vue d’ensemble des priorités et des activités de l’architecture technologique pour soutenir la planification et la prise de décisions de la direction
* Appuyer l’analyse, la planification et la coordination des priorités émergentes et des initiatives spéciales en reliant les plans d’architecture technologique aux priorités globales du STI et du cabinet
* Servir de point de coordination central entre les activités liées à l’architecture, au développement, à la mise en œuvre et aux opérations, y compris pour ce qui touche les dépendances, le séquencement des tâches, les décisions et les transferts entre les architectes, les responsables techniques et les équipes de mise en œuvre
* Veiller à ce que les décisions et les priorités en matière d’architecture soient prises en compte dans la planification et l’exécution de la mise en œuvre
* Participer à la coordination des activités d’architecture technologique entre les différentes fonctions, ainsi qu’à l’échelle du cabinet canadien et de l’organisation mondiale
* Établir des modes de fonctionnement efficaces qui aident l’équipe à gérer les priorités, les décisions, les risques, les mesures à prendre et les dépendances, et à assurer le suivi des mesures et des engagements convenus
* Repérer les occasions de simplifier les processus, d’améliorer les méthodes de travail et de renforcer la coordination au sein de l’équipe
* Fournir à la direction une vision intégrée des besoins, des activités et des dépendances pour appuyer une planification efficace des ressources et des priorités
* Appuyer la coordination et la réalisation des initiatives d’architecture technologique en établissant clairement les résultats, les jalons, les responsables, les dépendances et les risques, en particulier lorsque le travail nécessite la collaboration des équipes d’architecture et de mise en œuvre
* Travailler de concert avec le bureau de gestion de projets et les gestionnaires de projet désignés pour les initiatives nécessitant une gouvernance officielle, et porter à l’attention de la direction les risques, les contraintes et les décisions exigeant son intervention
* Fournir à la direction de l’architecture technologique des mises à jour concises axées sur la prise de décisions concernant les priorités, les progrès, les risques et les enjeux
* Assurer la coordination avec les autres équipes du STI au pays et ailleurs dans le monde, les directeurs de la Technologie des différentes fonctions et les parties prenantes concernées pour atteindre les objectifs en matière d’architecture technologique
* Préparer et animer des séances de planification d’équipe, des revues de direction, des séances de travail et d’autres rencontres de coordination; communiquer clairement les questions techniques et les enjeux liés à la réalisation des initiatives aux parties prenantes techniques et non techniques

**Ce que vous apportez au rôle**

* Baccalauréat en informatique, en génie, en systèmes d’information, en gestion des technologies, en affaires ou dans un domaine connexe (ou expérience pratique équivalente)
* Expérience considérable dans des environnements technologiques, idéalement dans les domaines de la prestation de services technologiques, de l’optimisation de l’architecture, des opérations technologiques ou des domaines connexes
* Compréhension approfondie des environnements technologiques d’entreprise et de la relation entre l’architecture, la mise en œuvre et les activités courantes, ainsi que des connaissances techniques suffisantes pour comprendre les concepts d’architecture, les dépendances, les considérations relatives à la mise en œuvre et les risques liés à la prestation, sans nécessairement être spécialiste technique
* Solides compétences en stratégie et en opérations, notamment en matière de planification, de priorisation, de coordination, d’analyse et de présentation de l’information aux dirigeants.
* Expérience de la coordination d’initiatives technologiques complexes faisant intervenir plusieurs équipes, parties prenantes et dépendances
* Grand sens de l’organisation, excellent jugement et fortes aptitudes en communication; capacité à structurer, à clarifier et à faire progresser des travaux complexes ou ambigus, et à travailler efficacement avec des leaders en technologie, des architectes, des spécialistes techniques et des professionnels de la gestion de projet

Title: Associate Portfolio Manager, Public Credit
Description:
At IMCO, our talent is among the best! IMCO offers a uniquely stimulating and rewarding environment where you can help build and drive organizational transformation, all while seeking to challenge yourself, learn, and grow your career.

Our culture is built on collaboration and passion, with a shared commitment to delivering lasting value to the clients we serve. Located in downtown Toronto, our vision is to be the partner of choice for Ontario’s public sector funds and to build a high-performing, value-driven asset management firm.

This job posting is for an existing vacancy. If you are ready to deliver best-in-class service and join a collaborative, motivated and fun team of professionals, IMCO offers the opportunity to do impactful work and broaden your expertise.

If you’re looking to use your expertise to drive strategic outcomes, we’d love to hear from you.

‎

IMCO’s actively managed Global Credit strategy (~$10.1B AUM) delivers higher risk-adjusted returns through a unified approach to credit investing, integrating public and private credit within a single, globally diversified portfolio. The strategy adopts a holistic approach to portfolio construction, allocating across public credit segments, including investment grade, high yield, leveraged loans, and structured credit, alongside private credit segments to capture relative value opportunities, enhance diversification, and optimize liquidity and return outcomes across market cycles.

Our collaborative culture and value-add approach to strategic partnerships makes us a preferred partner to some of the largest investors in the world. We have a targeted strategy to grow our highly diversified Global Credit portfolio and are looking for a highly motivated Associate Portfolio Manager to join our Global Credit team with a focus on public credit!

The Associate Portfolio Manager, Public Credit will play a key role in managing IMCO’s externally managed Public Credit portfolio, with responsibilities spanning manager selection and due diligence, portfolio strategy and construction, and ongoing monitoring and oversight. The role combines rigorous investment analysis with active portfolio management, while also contributing to ongoing initiatives to enhance the Global Credit platform and target operating model, including the implementation of investment systems and processes and the development of advanced analytics and AI capabilities to improve portfolio insights and support investment decision-making.

**As a Member of Our Global Credit Team, You Will Contribute Across Three Core Areas: Manager Selection & Oversight, Portfolio Management and Strategy, and Platform Enhancement:**

* Provide analytical and portfolio management support to the Managing Director in overseeing externally managed public credit portfolios on a day-to-day basis, including ad hoc analysis and strategic initiatives.
* Source, screen, and conduct due diligence on external public credit managers across strategies (e.g., investment grade, high yield, loans and structured credit), utilizing data platforms and AI-enabled tools to analyze performance, identify risks, and support manager screening and ongoing evaluation.
* Lead and support the preparation of investment recommendations, including drafting investment memos and presentations for internal Investment Committee approval.
* Assist in structuring and negotiating investment mandates, guidelines, and negotiating fee arrangements with external managers in collaboration with risk, legal and other internal teams.

Title: Carrier Certification Manager
Description:
**About Eagle Wireless**
Eagle Wireless is building the connective tissue of the physical world.
  
  
Every connected car, every industrial sensor, every IoT device that needs to talk to the cloud reliably and securely — that’s where we come in. We design and deliver cellular modules and connectivity solutions that automotive, and IoT companies trust to work for years, in the field, without compromise.
  
  
Our teams span North America, Europe, and APAC, giving you the chance to collaborate with world-class engineers and go-to-market experts solving hard problems at global scale — from cybersecurity and supply chain resilience to regulatory compliance across dozens of markets.
  
  
If you want your work to matter in a world that’s rapidly connecting everything, and you want to do it alongside people obsessed with getting the hard stuff right, Eagle Wireless is where that happens.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Carrier Certification Manager will own Eagle's end-to-end carrier certification program across the US and Canada. This includes managing active certification projects, building and maintaining carrier relationships, and working cross-functionally with product, engineering, and sales to ensure Eagle's modules achieve and maintain certification across all major networks. This role is essential to Eagle's product commercialization timeline and go-to-market readiness.
  
  
**Key Requirements**

* Manage active carrier certification programs across AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile (US), and Telus, Rogers, Bell (Canada), ensuring on-time completion.
* Serve as Eagle's primary point of contact with carrier certification teams and labs; build and maintain trusted relationships with carrier ecosystem managers.
* Coordinate pre-certification activities: lab selection, test plan development, sample preparation, and firmware readiness in collaboration with engineering and product teams.
* Own the certification project tracker and communicate progress, risks, and timelines to product management and executive leadership.
* Manage certification costs, budgets, and vendor relationships (third-party test labs, certification bodies).
* Oversee PTCRB, GCF, FCC/IC, and ISED submissions that feed into carrier certification eligibility.
* Monitor carrier certification policy changes, new requirements, and network evolution (e.g., 5G Standalone, Network Slicing) and proactively update Eagle's certification strategy.
* Support the sales team by clearly communicating certification status and timelines for customer RFQs and design-in decisions.
* Develop and maintain certification documentation, including test reports and compliance records.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in carrier certification, regulatory compliance, or technical program management within the wireless, module, or device ecosystem.
* Direct experience managing AT&T, Verizon, or T-Mobile certification processes; Canadian carrier experience is a plus.
* Understanding of PTCRB, GCF, FCC/IC certification frameworks and their interplay with carrier certification.
* Strong project management skills; ability to run multiple certification programs in parallel.
* Excellent cross-functional communication skills with engineering, product, and sales stakeholders.
* Experience with cellular module certification specifically (as opposed to device/handset only).
* Familiarity with 5G NR certification requirements and how they differ from LTE.
* Knowledge of ISED (Canada), FirstNet, and MVNO certification requirements.
* Experience working with third-party test labs.
* Flexible to attend occasional early-morning or evening calls to coordinate with teams in Asia (UTC+8).
* Willing to travel occasionally to carrier or third-party laboratories to provide on-site support as needed.

**What We Offer**
**Our work environment is collaborative, and we offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, which includes medical/dental/vision, generous PTO and paid parental leave programs.**
**Eagle Wireless recognizes the importance of forming inclusive teams to foster an environment where creative solutions are made for our clients, and all have the opportunity to thrive and succeed. We encourage candidates from a variety of backgrounds to apply to be a part of our team.**

Title: Corporate Project Manager
Description:
**Votorantim Cement North America**

**Job Description**

  

**SUMMARY/JOB SCOPE:**

We are seeking a results-driven Corporate Project Manager to manage capital projects within our cement operations. The successful candidate will be responsible for assigned projects through the full project lifecycle, from conceptual development and engineering through procurement, construction, commissioning, startup, and final turnover to Operations.

The ideal candidate will have a solid technical foundation, preferably in mechanical engineering, combined with practical experience in project and construction management within an industrial environment. The role requires the ability to translate operational and business needs into practical project solutions and to effectively coordinate engineering partners, equipment suppliers, contractors, and internal stakeholders.

This position requires effective project coordination, sound technical judgment, construction management experience, and the ability to work independently with guidance from the Director, Engineering and CapEx, as needed. The successful candidate must be comfortable making timely decisions within established authority, taking ownership of assigned projects, and maintaining a strong focus on safety, quality, schedule, and cost.

The CapEx team supports the operating businesses by delivering projects safely, efficiently, and with minimal disruption to ongoing operations.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Manage assigned capital projects through the full project lifecycle, from initial concept and feasibility through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, startup, and turnover to Operations.
* Work with Operations and other stakeholders to define project requirements, evaluate alternatives, develop practical solutions, and establish project scope, budget, schedule, and execution strategy.
* Manage internal and external engineering resources through conceptual, preliminary, and final engineering, including layouts, technical specifications, equipment requirements, constructability reviews, and design coordination.
* Develop and manage project execution plans, schedules, budgets, cost controls, forecasts, contingencies, change management, construction sequencing, and project risk, with input on contracting strategy from the Director, Engineering and CapEx, and Procurement.
* Develop and maintain project schedules, monitor key milestones and critical path activities, and implement mitigation or recovery plans when required.
* Develop technical documentation for equipment and construction procurement, including equipment data sheets, technical specifications, scopes of work, RFPs, and tender packages.
* Coordinate technical evaluations with engineering and Operations and support the selection and procurement of mechanical and process equipment, contractors, consultants, and other project services.
* Manage tendering and contract award activities in collaboration with Procurement, including bidder clarifications, scope alignment, technical evaluations, and recommendations for award.
* Manage construction activities for assigned projects following contract award, coordinating contractors, consultants, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure safe and effective project execution.
* Champion a strong safety culture throughout project development and execution, ensuring safety is incorporated into design, planning, contractor selection, construction, commissioning, and turnover.
* Ensure compliance with applicable health and safety, environmental, regulatory, permitting, engineering, and company requirements.
* Take ownership of project issues, evaluate alternatives, and make timely decisions within established authority, seeking technical or management input and escalating matters when appropriate.
* Proactively manage project performance and risks related to safety, cost, schedule, quality, constructability, procurement, and operational integration, and provide clear reporting to management on project status and key decisions.
* Coordinate commissioning, startup, training, documentation, and turnover to ensure projects are successfully transitioned to Operations, and maintain complete and accurate project documentation throughout the project lifecycle.
  

**AUTHORITY/DECISION MAKING:**

The Corporate Project Manager manages assigned projects within established company policies, project governance, approved budgets, and delegated authority, with guidance from the Director, Engineering and CapEx, as needed. The position is responsible for day-to-day project decisions related to engineering, procurement, contractor management, construction execution, schedule, cost, and project priorities. The successful candidate is expected to resolve routine project issues and bring forward recommendations on matters requiring leadership or stakeholder approval, including significant changes to scope, budget, schedule, or risk.

  

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

The Corporate Project Manager coordinates and provides day-to-day project direction to multidisciplinary teams, including internal resources, engineering consultants, contractors, equipment suppliers, and other project partners. The role works with functional leaders to align resources, clarify responsibilities, and support delivery of assigned projects.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS:**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

**Education/Experience Requirements:**

* Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Technology, Construction Management, or a related technical discipline preferred.
* Experience managing capital projects in heavy industrial, manufacturing, cement, mining, aggregates, materials handling, or similar environments.
* Practical experience across project lifecycle phases, including project development, engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and turnover.
* Experience with industrial construction, contractor coordination, equipment procurement, cost control, scheduling, and project execution.

**Job Knowledge:**

* Working knowledge of industrial project development and construction practices.
* Knowledge of mechanical and process equipment, industrial facilities, and general construction methods.
* Working knowledge of project controls, including budgeting, forecasting, scheduling, change management, and risk management.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, technical documentation, contracts, and construction documents.
* Understanding of contractor and equipment procurement processes.

**Language Skills:**

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical procedures, specifications, contracts, and governmental regulations. Ability to prepare clear reports, business correspondence, scopes of work, and project documentation, and to communicate effectively with employees, contractors, suppliers, consultants, and management.

**Computer Skills:**

* Proficiency with standard Microsoft Office applications and project management/scheduling tools such as Microsoft Project.
* Experience with project controls, document management, and construction management systems.
* Experience with Procore is considered an asset.

**Soft Skills:**

* Effective project leadership, coordination, and communication skills.
* High degree of initiative, ownership, and accountability.
* Ability to work independently within established priorities and authority, and to recognize when guidance or escalation is needed.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced project environment.
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively with Operations, contractors, consultants, suppliers, and senior management.
  

**OTHER REQUIREMENTS:**

**Travel Requirement:**

Regular travel is an important part of the role and will include visits to company facilities and the company’s head offices in Toronto. Travel frequency will vary depending on project needs and will typically consist of short-duration trips scheduled around key project activities.

The role is not intended to require extended assignments away from the employee’s home location. Travel will generally support project development, construction activities, meetings, commissioning, and other project needs rather than prolonged stays of several weeks or months.

**Physical Demands:**

When visiting project or construction sites, the employee may be required to walk through active industrial environments and use appropriate personal protective equipment.

**Work Environment:**

This position is primarily performed in an office or remote-work environment. The role also includes periodic travel to company facilities and active project or construction sites.

Site visits may involve exposure to typical industrial and construction conditions, including noise, dust, outdoor weather conditions, moving equipment, and areas requiring personal protective equipment.

  

**NOTE:**

This position description is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements. Employees may be required to perform any other job-related instructions as requested by their supervisor.

Title: Head of Software Architecture
Description:
**ABOUT POWER FACTORS**

Power Factors is a software and solutions provider leading the next generation of clean energy with Unity, one of the most extensive and widely deployed renewable energy management suites (REMS) in the market. With over 300 GW of wind, solar, and energy storage assets managed worldwide across more than 600 customers and 18,000 sites, Power Factors manages 25% of the world’s renewable energy data.\*

Power Factors’ Unity REMS supports the entire energy value chain, from monitoring and controls to market analytics. The company’s suite of open, data-driven applications empowers renewable energy stakeholders to collaborate, automate critical workflows, and make more informed decisions to maximize asset returns. Energy stakeholders receive end-to-end support, including solutions for SCADA & PPC, centralized monitoring, performance management, commercial asset management, and field service management.

With deep domain expertise, AI-powered insights are delivered at scale so businesses can optimize assets, unlock growth, and make smarter decisions as the world rapidly transitions to clean energy. Power Factors fights climate change with code.

* Outside China and India

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Power Factors is scaling in complexity — more products, more platforms, more sophisticated buyers, and rapidly rising expectations for AI-native capability across our renewable energy software suite. In that context, the absence of a single, accountable technical vision creates real risk: divergent architectural patterns across verticals, inconsistent approaches to AI and data platform investment, and technical debt that compounds faster than it can be paid down.

The Head of Software Architecture exists to close that gap. This is a hands-on, deeply technical leadership role responsible for defining and enforcing enterprise architecture standards across Power Factors' Product & Technology organization — spanning Platform, SCADA, EMS, APM, CloudOps, and CAM/FSM/Product Ops — while personally architecting and prototyping the hardest problems the organization faces, particularly around AI-based product introductions, IoT data acquisition, and multi-tenant SaaS scalability.

This role combines the strategic scope of an enterprise architect with the credibility of a builder who still writes code, reviews pull requests, and is comfortable being the most technical person in the room.

### **Purpose of the Role**

The Head of Software Architecture acts to define, evangelize, and enforce a coherent technical architecture strategy that allows Power Factors to scale product complexity without sacrificing reliability, security, or development velocity.

* **Enterprise-wide architectural coherence:** Technical decisions across verticals are grounded in shared architectural principles, not siloed team preferences.
* **AI-native product development:** New AI-based product capabilities are architected end-to-end — from data pipeline to model integration to user-facing experience — rather than bolted on.
* **Development velocity multiplication:** Engineering teams are equipped with modern AI-assisted development tooling and workflows that materially increase throughput.
* **Deep technical credibility:** Engineering leaders and individual contributors alike see this role as a working architect, not a slide-deck strategist.
* **Domain-informed design:** Architecture decisions reflect genuine understanding of renewable energy operations — SCADA, EMS, PPC, edge devices, and grid-facing data systems.

This role acts as the connective tissue between the CPTO's organizational strategy and the day-to-day technical decisions made by vertical engineering teams.

### **Core Responsibilities**

### **1. Enterprise Architecture & Complex System Design**

* Define and maintain Power Factors' enterprise architecture standards, reference architectures, and technical guardrails across all verticals
* Lead architectural reviews for major initiatives, ensuring consistency, scalability, and long-term maintainability
* Own the technical roadmap for cross-cutting platform capabilities (data platform, integration layer, identity, observability)
* Design for complex, high-availability systems where correctness, latency, and data integrity carry real operational and commercial consequences
* Partner with vertical leaders (SCADA, EMS, APM, Platform, CloudOps) to ensure local architecture decisions align with enterprise direction

### **2. Technical Team Leadership**

* Build and lead a distributed architecture function that operates as a trusted technical authority across Greece, Montreal, and other regions
* Mentor senior engineers and engineering leaders on architectural judgment, system design, and technical tradeoff analysis
* Establish and run architecture governance forums (design reviews, RFC processes, technical steering committees)
* Act as a technical escalation point for the highest-stakes design decisions across the organization

### **3. AI-Based Product Architecture & Delivery**

* Architect and personally help build end-to-end AI-based product capabilities — from data acquisition and model selection through deployment and monitoring
* Define Power Factors' architectural approach to LLM-based products, including use of Model Context Protocol (MCP), retrieval architectures, and agentic workflows
* Evaluate and select development LLMs and AI platforms appropriate for embedding into commercial products
* Own the technical bridge between REMI and other AI-native initiatives and the broader platform architecture
* Bring machine learning and data science expertise to bear on product decisions — model selection, feature engineering, data pipeline design, and MLOps practices

### **4. Hands-On Development**

* Write production code, prototype new architectural patterns, and directly contribute to the hardest technical problems facing the organization
* Lead by example on code quality, testing discipline, and engineering craftsmanship
* Stay close enough to the codebase to make credible, current architectural judgments rather than relying on secondhand reporting
* Build proof-of-concept implementations to de-risk major architectural bets before full team investment

### **5. IoT, Edge, and Industrial Systems Architecture**

* Architect scalable IoT data acquisition systems capable of ingesting, normalizing, and processing high-volume telemetry from distributed renewable energy assets
* Design architecture for edge devices and Power Plant Controllers (PPC), balancing on-site computation, latency constraints, and cloud connectivity
* Ensure architectural approaches account for grid code compliance, real-time control requirements, and the operational realities of SCADA and EMS environments
* Apply renewables and energy industry domain knowledge to inform data model, integration, and control system design decisions

### **6. Cloud, SaaS, and Multi-Tenant Architecture**

* Own cloud architecture strategy across GCP and/or AWS, including cost, resilience, and security posture
* Advance Power Factors' multi-tenant SaaS architecture to support scale, tenant isolation, and configurability without fragmenting the codebase
* Define architectural standards for mobile app development where products extend to field and operations use cases
* Evaluate build-vs-buy and platform consolidation decisions across the technology stack

### **7. Engineering Productivity & AI-Enabled Development**

* Identify, evaluate, and roll out AI development tools that enable a 3–4x productivity improvement across engineering teams
* Define best practices for AI-assisted coding, testing, and code review, balancing speed with quality and security
* Partner with engineering leadership to measure and report on productivity gains from AI tooling adoption

### **Reporting & Operating Model**

### **Reporting Line**

* Reports to: Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO)

Embedded collaboration with:

* Vertical engineering leaders (Platform, SCADA, EMS, APM, CloudOps, CAM/FSM/Product Ops)
* Product Management and Product Marketing on AI-based product introductions
* CloudOps and Security on infrastructure and compliance posture

### **Operating Principles**

* Architecture in service of the business, not architecture for its own sake
* Hands-on credibility over theoretical authority
* Pragmatic standardization — enough consistency to scale, not so much it stifles teams
* AI-first thinking applied responsibly, with attention to data quality, safety, and reliability

### **Skills & Profile**

### **Required Experience**

* **15–20 years** of progressive experience in software engineering, with significant time spent in architecture and technical leadership roles
* **Enterprise Architecture & Complex System Design:** demonstrated experience architecting large-scale, high-complexity systems with significant operational stakes
* **Technical Team Leadership:** proven ability to lead and mentor senior engineers and architects across distributed teams
* **Trading/Transactional Systems:** experience building high-throughput, high-integrity trading or transactional systems where correctness and performance are non-negotiable
* **AI Product Delivery:** track record architecting and shipping end-to-end AI-based product introductions, from concept to production launch

Own the operational performance of laundry partners and end-to-end laundry order flow.

Own the operational execution of ticketing services, events, bookings, and related customer experiences.

For flowers, pharmacies, electronics, beauty, gifts, fashion, and general retail partners.
  
  

* Improving item accuracy, merchant readiness, fulfillment time, packaging, and delivery handover.
* Reducing cancellations, unavailable items, wrong items, and poor packaging complaints.
* Building SOPs for sensitive categories such as pharmacy, flowers, electronics, and gifts.
* Supporting category-specific service standards.

Own the overall marketplace health across multiple verticals.
  
  

* Monitor supply availability across merchants and categories.
* Ensure strong coordination between merchant operations, logistics, product, and customer support.
* Improve operational KPIs across all marketplace verticals.
* Identify marketplace gaps such as low availability, weak fulfillment, poor merchant compliance, or high complaint rates.
* Support new vertical launches with proper operating models and readiness checks.

Lead operational readiness for new Snoonu verticals before launch.
  
  

* Define the operating model for each new vertical.
* Build SOPs, SLAs, partner requirements, customer support flows, and escalation rules.
* Run pilot launches before scaling.
* Identify operational risks before public launch.
* Work with product to ensure the customer journey is ready.
* Work with finance to validate pricing, commission, refunds, and settlement processes.
* Ensure logistics capacity and delivery requirements are clear.

* Own service desk documentation in IT Glue: keep SOPs, runbooks and escalation procedures accurate and current, and make sure engineers document their work

* Experience working in a managed service provider (MSP) environment
* Previous management experience
* Direct experience managing a team of helpdesk engineers
* Demonstrated ability to manage team workload, queues and SLAs
* Experience tracking and reporting service desk KPIs and presenting results to senior leadership
* Hands-on experience with an MSP PSA, RMM and documentation platform
* Strong documentation habits, with experience maintaining SOPs, runbooks and knowledge base articles
* Strong hands-on technical skills across Microsoft 365, Windows, networking and common end-user and small business IT support, with a proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues and serve as the technical escalation point for a support team

**Preferred qualifications**

* Direct experience with Autotask, IT Glue and N-able RMM

* Microsoft certifications

Title: Director, Project Management
Description:
**About SH/FT**

Shift Paradigm is an execution-led strategic consultancy that bridges the gap between enterprise strategy and technical reality. We partner with Fortune 500 brands and emerging leaders to solve the inherent complexity of modern digital marketing. As partners to the world’s leading MarTech platforms, including Adobe, Salesforce, Optimizely, and Braze, we deploy integrated experts across data analytics, marketing strategy, technology development, engineering, and revenue operations to ensure our clients’ tech stacks don't just exist, but perform.

**The Role**

Reporting to COO/CFO, the Director, Project Management leads Shift Paradigm's Project Management practice. They also own the delivery operations that keep the business running: resourcing, forecasting, tooling and process.

This role leads a combined team of Strategic Project Managers and Technical Project Managers across campaign delivery, web development, CMS migration, martech implementation and managed-services engagements. It protects both client outcomes and company margin.

You will set the standard for how work is scoped, planned, resourced and delivered at Shift. In practice, PMs "manage the micro with a macro mindset." They are the single point of contact for delivery teams, the early warning system for risk and scope creep, and the owners of financial accuracy on their engagements.

You will be a trusted partner to Client Partners, Department Heads, Finance and executive leadership. You will be the escalation point when delivery gets hard.

**What You'll Accomplish**
--------------------------

**Practice Leadership & People Management**

* Lead, coach and grow a team of Project Managers at various levels of seniority and with expertise areas. You will own hiring, onboarding, performance management, career pathing and day-to-day escalations.
* Define clear roles and responsibilities between PM, Client Partner and delivery leads, and reinforce them across the organization.
* Build team rituals that keep the practice connected and accountable while working remotely.

**Delivery Excellence & Margin Protection**

* Oversee delivery health across the portfolio: scope, timeline, budget burn, risk and client satisfaction.
* Hold PMs accountable for accurate data, written client approvals and clean change control. These are the basis of margin protection.
* Partner with Client Partners and Finance on monthly reviews, revenue recognition notes, invoice approvals and project/retainer closeouts.
* Step in on high-risk or escalated engagements. Lead recovery plans and hard client conversations when needed.

**Scoping, Pre-Sales & SOW Readiness**

* Bring delivery into the sales cycle. Partner with Client Partners and Department Heads during discovery and scoping so SOWs are realistic and staffable.
* Own and evolve scoping templates and estimation standards. Review SOWs for risk, dependencies, assumptions and timeline feasibility before signature.

**Resource Management & Capacity Planning**

* Oversee the Resource Management function. Direct report: Resource Manager.
* Own the resourcing playbook. It covers resource alerts, pre-resourcing (hiring) triggers, Workfront resource requests and fulfillment.
* Deliver utilization and forecasting insights to leadership. Flag capacity risks early and translate pipeline demand into hiring and contractor recommendations.
* Sponsor skills management and skills-matrix work so staffing decisions are based on real capability data.

**Operations, Tooling & Process Improvement**

* Own Workfront as the system of record for delivery: project templates, timesheets, dashboards, reporting and automation.
* Lead internal operations initiatives such as forecasting dashboards, scope-to-Workfront automation and job aid overhauls. Drive adoption through training and change management.
* Evaluate and introduce new tools, including AI-assisted workflows, that reduce PM administrative load and improve forecasting accuracy.
* Maintain PMO documentation, job aids and standards, and keep them current as the business changes.

**Cross-Functional & Executive Partnership**

* Partner with Client Success, Delivery leadership, Finance and People Ops on operating rhythms, pipeline reviews and planning.
* Present delivery, utilization and margin performance to executive leadership with clear recommendations.

**What You Bring**
------------------

Experience & Expertise

* 10+ years in project, program or delivery management, with 3+ years leading PM teams. Agency or professional services experience required.
* Proven track record delivering web development, CMS migration and/or marketing technology implementations (e.g., Adobe Experience Manager, Salesforce, Marketo, AEP).
* Deep experience in highly billable environments: scoping, burn tracking, utilization, margin management and revenue forecasting.
* Advanced Workfront experience (or comparable PPM tool), including configuration, reporting and resource management.
* Experience building or running resource management, capacity planning and forecasting processes.
* Track record of operational change: designing processes, building job aids and training, and driving adoption across teams.

Skills & Capabilities

* Experience with Waterfall, Agile/Scrum and hybrid delivery. Experience leading Product Owners or backlog-driven delivery is strongly preferred.
* Executive presence. Able to influence peers and leadership, and to be diplomatic or firm as needed to protect the team and the business.
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication with clients, delivery teams and executives.
* Comfort using AI tools to improve team efficiency is a plus.
* PMP, CSM/CSPO or equivalent certification is a plus.

Mindset

* You are a builder. You are comfortable walking into a team that needs structure and creating it rather than waiting for it to arrive.
* You lead through clarity. Colleagues and teammates know where things stand with you. You surface recommendations early and outline the process to bring resolutions to life.
* You are flexible without being formless. You have strong opinions about how good delivery works, and you can adapt how you apply them to different clients, platforms, and team dynamics.
* You do not need a large team or a fully defined playbook to be effective. You are energized by building the thing, not just running it.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive compensation aligned with your experience and impact
* Remote flexibility
* Collaborative culture that values diverse perspectives and innovative thinking
* Work that makes a measurable difference for your clients

**Why SHIFT:**
--------------

SHIFT is a consultancy built for transformation. We bridge the gap between marketing, data, and technology to unlock growth for some of the world's most recognized brands. At SHIFT you'll shape the future of how organizations connect with their customers through intelligent architecture, scalable systems, and the power of data-driven strategy.

**Comp & Benefits**
-------------------

The salary range for this role is $145,000 to $160,000 USD. Salary is based on several factors including but not limited to skillset, relevant education, level of experience, certifications, and scope of responsibilities.

In addition to base salary, SHIFT offers benefits such as medical, dental, vision, STD/LTD, Life/AD&D, Flexible Paid Time Off, and various other ancillary benefits and perks.

Position Overview

DTX Aerospace is seeking an experienced and commercially driven
**General Manager**
to lead its commercial aircraft engine maintenance facility in the Middle East.

The successful candidate will oversee facility operations, engine maintenance activities, financial performance, regulatory compliance, business development, and customer relationships while ensuring operational efficiency, profitability, and the highest safety and quality standards.

The facility specializes in CFM56 engine shop visits, performance restoration, troubleshooting, module repairs, minor repairs, and component replacement.
